Berakhot 33a:3-10: Afillu nachash karuch al akevo, lo yafsik. amar rav sheshet: lo shanu ella nachash. aval akrav — posek.
Metivi: nafal legov arayot — en meidin alav shemmet. nafal lachafira melea nechashim veakrabbim — meidin alav shemmet!
Amar rabbi yitzchak: raa shevavrim — posek. detane rav hoshaya: marchikin mishshor tam chamishshim amma, umishshor muad — kimlo enav.
Tana mishshemeh derabbi meir: resh tora bedikkula — selek leagra ushedi darga mittutach. amar shemuel: hane mille beshor shachor uveyome nisan, mippene shehassatan merakked lo ben karnav.

Tanu rabbanan: maase bemakom echad shehaya arvad, vehaya mazzik et habberiyyot. bau vehodiu lo lerabbi chanina ben dosa. amar lahem: hareu li et choro! heruhu et choro. natan akevo al pi hachor, yatza uneshacho — umet oto arvad.
Netalo al ketefo vehevio levet hammidrash. amar lahem: reu banay, en arvad memit, ella hachet memit.
Beotah shaa amru: oy lo laadam sheppaga bo arvad, veoy lo laarvad sheppaga bo rabbi chanina ben dosa.
Chullin 105a:6-12: Bea minneh rav assi merabbi yochanan: kamma yishhe ben basar ligvina? amar lo: velo kelum. ini? veha amar rav chisda: achal basar – asur leechol gevina, gevina – muttar leechol basar! ella kamma yishhe ben gevina levasar? amar leh: velo kelum.
Gufa, amar rav chisda: achal basar – asur leechol gevina, gevina – muttar leechol basar. amar leh rav acha bar yosef lerav chisda: basar shebben hashshinnayim mahu?

Amar mar ukeva: ana, leha milleta, challa bar chamra legabbe abba, deillu abba ki hava achel bisra haiddana, la hava achel gevina ad limchar ad hasheta, veillu ana – beha seodta hu dela achelna, lisodta achrita – achelna.

Amar shemuel: ana, leha milleta, challa bar chamra legabbe abba, deillu abba hava sayayr nichseh tere zimne beyoma, vaana la sayayrna ella chada zimna. shemuel letameh, deamar shemuel: man desayayr nichseh kol yoma mashkach istera.
Abbaye hava sayayr nichseh kol yoma veyoma. yoma chad pega baariseh dedare pitka deufe. amar leh: hane lehecha? amar leh: leve mar. amar leh: kevar kadmuch rabbanan.

Rav assi hava sayayr nichseh kol yoma, amar: hecha ninhu kol hane istire demar shemuel? yoma chad chaza tzinnora devidka beareh, shakleh liglimeh, karcheh otveh begavva, rema kala, ato inashe sachru, [amar]: ashkachtinhu lechullehu istere demar shemuel.
Gittin 23a:16-23b:5: Gemara bishlama cheresh, shote vekatan – delav bene dea ninhu; goy name – delav bar hettera hu; ella some, ammay la? amar rav sheshet: lefi sheeno yodea mimmi notlo ulemi notno.
Matkef la rav yosef: heach some muttar beishto? heach bene adam muttarim binshotehem ballayla? ella bitviut ena dekala, hacha name bitviut ena dekala!
Ella amar rav yosef: hacha bechutza laaretz askinan; devae lememar: "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam", vela matze lememar.

Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, patuach venistamme, dematze amar, hachi name dechasher?! veha katane: patuach venistamme vechazar venitpatteach, kasher – chazar venitpatteach, in; lo chazar venitpatteach, lo!

Hu haddin deaf al gav delo chazar venitpatteach; veayyeyde dekatane shafuy venishtatta vechazar venishtappa – tama dechazar venishtappa, ha lo chazar venishtappa – la; tena name patuach venistamme vechazar venitpatteach.
Amar rav ashe: dayka name – dekatane, ze hakkelal: kol shettechillato vesofo bedaat – kasher; vela katane: kol shettechillato vesofo bechashrut – kasher; shema minna.
Beo minneh merabbi amme: eved, mahu sheyyease shaliach lekabbel get ishsha miyyad balah? amar lehu: middeka pasel leh legoy,
Mikkelal deeved kasher. amar rav assi, amar rabbi yochanan: en haeved naase shaliach lekabbel get leishsha miyyad balah, lefi sheeno betorat gittin vekiddushin.
Matkef la rabbi elazar: tama bemilleta deleteh, ha bemilleta deiteh – kasher?!
Veha goy veha kuti; deitanhu betorat teruma denafshayyhu, ditnan: haggoy vehakkuti shettarmu mishshellahem – terumatam teruma; utenan: goy shettaram shel yisrael, afillu birshut – en terumato teruma!
May tama? lav mishshum dichtiv: (attem) "gam attem" – ma attem yisrael, af sheluchachem yisrael?!
Amri deve rabbi yannay: lo; ma attem bene berit, af sheluchachem bene berit.

Mishnah Eruvin 10:10-13:
Neger sheyyesh berosho gelustera, rabbi eliezer oser, verabbi yose mattir. amar rabbi eliezer, maase vakkeneset shebbitverya shehayu nohagin bo hetter, ad shebba rabban gamliel vehazzekenim veasru lahen. rabbi yose omer, issur nahagu vah, ba rabban gamliel vehazzekenim vehittiru lahen: 
Neger hannigrar, noalim bo vammikdash, aval lo vammedina. vehammunnach, kan vachan asur. rabbi yehuda omer, hammunnach muttar bammikdash, vehannigrar bammedina: 
Machazirin tzir hattachton bammikdash, aval lo vammedina. vehaelyon, kan vechan asur. rabbi yehuda omer, haelyon bammikdash, vehattachton bammedina: 
Machazirin retiyya vammikdash, aval lo vammedina. im battechilla, kan vechan asur. koshrin nima vammikdash, aval lo vammedina. im battechilla, kan vechan asur. chotchin yabbelet bammikdash, aval lo vammedina. veim bichli, kan vechan asur:
Mishnah Eruvin 10:14-15:
Kohen shellaka veetzbao, korech aleha gemi vammikdash, aval lo vammedina. im lehotzi dam, kan vechan asur. bozkin melach al gabbe chevesh bishvil shello yachaliku, umemalleim mibbor haggola umibbor haggadol baggalgal beshabbat, umibbeer hakkar beyom tov: 
Sheretz shennimtza vammikdash, kohen motzio vehemyano, shello leshahot et hattuma, divre rabbi yochanan ben beroka. rabbi yehuda omer, bitzvat shel etz, shello lerabbot et hattuma. mehechan motziin oto, min hahechol umin haulam umibben haulam velammizbeach, divre rabbi shimon ben nannas. rabbi akiva omer, mekom shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat, mishsham motziin oto, ushear kol hammekomot kofin alav pesachter. rabbi shimon omer, mekom shehittiru lecha chachamim, mishshellecha natnu lecha, shello hittiru lecha ella mishshum shevut:
Mishnah Eruvin 10:5-9:
Lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid veyashtin birshut harabbim, birshut harabbim veyashtin birshut hayyachid. vechen lo yarok. rabbi yehuda omer, af mishshennitlash rukko befiv, lo yehallech arba ammot ad sheyarok: 
Lo yaamod adam birshut hayachid veyishte virshut harabbim, birshut harabbim veyishte virshut hayachid, ella im ken hichnis rosho verubbo limkom shehu shote. vechen begat. kolet adam min hammazchela lematta measara tefachim. umin hatztzinnor, mikkol makom shote: 
Bor birshut harabbim, vechulyato gevoha asara tefachim, challon sheal gabbav memallein hemennu veshabbat. ashpa virshut harabbim gevoha asara tefachim, challon sheal gabbah shofchin letochah mayim beshabbat: 
Ilan shehu mesech al haaretz, im en nofo gavoah min haaretz shelosha tefachim, metaltelin tachtav. sharashav gevohin min haaretz shelosha tefachim, lo yeshev alehen. haddelet shebbammuktze vachadakim shebbappirtza umachatzalot, en noalin bahen, ella im ken gevohim min haaretz: 
Lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid veyiftach birshut harabbim, birshut harabbim veyiftach birshut hayyachid, ella im ken asa mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim, divre rabbi meir. amru lo, maase veshuk shel pattamin shehaya virushalayim, shehayu noalin umannichin et hammafteach bachallon sheal gabbe happetach. rabbi yose omer, shuk shel tzammarim haya:
Mishnah Makkot 3:13-16:
Yadah tefach verachbah tefach, veroshah maggaat al pi chereso. umakke oto shelish millefanav ushete yadot milleacharav. veeno makke oto lo omed velo yoshev ella mutte, shenneemar (Devarim 25) vehippilo hashshofet. vehammakke makke veyado achat bechol kocho: 
Vehakkore kore (sham 28) im lo tishmor laasot vegomer vehifla Adonai et makkotcha veet makkot vegomer, vechozer litchillat hammikra (sham 29) ushemartem et divre habberit hazzot vegomer, vechotem (tehillim 78) vehu rachum yechapper avon vegomer, vechozer litchillat hammikra. veim met tachat yado, patur. hosif lo od retzua achat vamet, hare ze gole al yado. nitkalkel ben berei ben bemayim, patur. rabbi yehuda omer, haish berei vehaishsha bemayim: 
Kol chayyave cheretot shellaku, nifteru yede cheretatan, sheneemar (Devarim 25) venikla achicha leenecha, keshellaka hare hu cheachicha, divre rabbi chananya ben gamliel. amar rabbi chananya ben gamliel, ma im haover avera achat, notel nafsho aleha, haose mitzva achat, al achat kamma vechamma shettinnaten lo nafsho. rabbi shimon omer, mimmekomo hu lamed, shenneemar (Vayikra 18) venichretu hannefashot haosot vegomer, veomer (sham) asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem. ha, kol hayyoshev velo avar avera, notnin lo sachar keose mitzva. rabbi shimon bar rabbi omer, hare hu omer (Devarim 12) rak chazak levilti achol haddam ki haddam hu hannafesh vegomer, uma im haddam shennafsho shel adam katza mimmennu, happoresh mimmennu mekabbel sachar, gazel vaarayot shennafsho shel adam mitavva lahen umechammadtan, happoresh mehen al achat kamma vechamma sheyyizke lo uledorotav uledorot dorotav ad sof kol haddorot: 
Rabbi chananya ben akashya omer, ratza hakkadosh baruch hu lezakkot et yisrael, lefichach hirba lahem tora umitzvot, shenneemar (yeshaya 42) Adonai chafetz lemaan tzidko yagdil tora veyadir:
Mishnah Makkot 3:9-12:
Yesh choresh telem echad vechayyav alav mishshum shemona lavin, hachoresh beshor vachamor, vehen mukdashim, bechilayim bakkerem, uvashsheviit, veyom tov, vechohen venazir bevet hattuma. chananya ben chachinay omer, af hallovesh kilayim. amru lo, eno hashshem. amar lahem, af lo hannazir hu hashshem: 
Kamma malkin oto, arbaim chaser achat. shenneemar (Devarim 25) bemispar arbaim, minyan shehu samuch learbaim. rabbi yehuda omer, arbaim shelemot hu loke. vehechan hu loke et hayetera, ben ketefav: 
En omdin oto ella vemakkot haruyot lehishtallesh. amaduhu lekabbel arbaim, laka miktzat veamru sheeno yachol lekabbel arbaim, patur. amaduhu lekabbel shemone esre, mishshellaka amru sheyyachol hu lekabbel arbaim, patur. avar avera sheyyesh bah shene lavin, amaduhu omed echad, loke ufatur. veim lav, loke umitrappe vechozer veloke: 
Ketzad malkin oto, kofet shete yadav al haammud helach vehelach, vechazzan hakkeneset ochez bivgadav, im nikreu nikrau, veim nifremu niframu, ad shehu megalle et libbo. vehaeven netuna meacharav, chazzan hakkeneset omed aleha. uretzua shel egel beyado, kefula echad lishnayim ushenayim learbaa, ushete retzuot olot veyordot bah:
Mishnah Negaim 13:12-14:4:
Nichnas levet hakkeneset, osim lo mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim al rochav arba ammot. nichnas rishon, veyotze acharon. kol hammatztzil tzamid patil beohel hammet, matztzil tzamid patil bevayit hamenugga. vechol hammatztzil mechusse veohel hammet, matztzil mechusse bevayit hamenugga, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, kol hammatztzil tzamid patil beohel hammet, matztzil mechusse bevayit hamenugga. kol hammatztzil mechusse veohel hammet, afillu megulle bevayit hamenugga, tahor: 
Ketzad metaharin et hammetzora. haya mevi feyali shel cheres chadasha venoten letochah reviit mayim chayyim, umevi shete tzipporim deror. shachat et achat mehen al keli cheres veal mayim chayyim. chafar vekovrah befanav. natal etz erez veezov usheni tolaat ucherachan bishyare hallashon, vehikkif lahem rashe agappayim verosh hazzanav shel sheniyya. taval vehizza sheva peamim leachar yado shel metzora, veyesh omrim, al mitzcho. vechach haya mazze al hashshekof shebbabbayit mibbachutz: 
Ba lo leshalleach et hatztzippor hachayya, eno hofech panav lo layyam velo lair velo lammidbar, shenneemar (Vayikra 14), veshillach et hatztzippor hachayya el michutz lair el pene hassade. ba legalleach et hammetzora, heevir taar al kol besaro, vechibbes begadav, vetaval, tahor milletamme bevia, vahare hu metamme chashsheretz. nichnas lifnim min hachoma, menudde mibbeto shivat yamim, veasur betashmish hammitta: 
Bayyom hashshevii megalleach tiglachat sheniyya kattiglachat harishona, kibbes begadav vetaval, tahor milletamme chashsheretz, vahare hu tevul yom, ochel bammaaser. heeriv shimsho, ochel batteruma. hevi chapparato, ochel bakkadashim. nimtzeu shalosh teharot bammetzora veshalosh teharot bayyoledet: 
Shelosha megallechin vetiglachtan mitzva, hannazir vehammetzora vehaleviyyim. vechullan sheggillechu shello vetaar o sheshshiyyeru shete searot, lo asu chelum:
Mishnah Negaim 13:8-11:
Tahor shehichnis rosho verubbo levayit tame, nitma. vetame shehichnis rosho verubbo levayit tahor, timmeahu. tallit tehora shehichnis mimmenna shalosh al shalosh levayit tame, nitmea. utemea shehichnis mimmenna afillu chazzayit levayit tahor, timmeattu: 
Mi shennichnas levayit hamenugga vechelav al ketefo vesandalav vetabbeotav beyadav, hu vahen temein miyyad. haya lavush bechelav vesandalav beraglav vetabbeotav beyadav, hu tame miyyad, vehen tehorin ad sheyyishhe chede achilat peras. pat chittin velo fat seorim, mesev veochlan beliftan: 
Haya omed bifnim ufashat yado lachutz vetabbeotav beyadav, im shaha chede achilat peras, temeot. haya omed bachutz ufashat yado lifnim vetabbeotav beyadav, rabbi yehuda metamme miyyad. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyishhe chede achilat peras. amru lo lerabbi yehuda, ma im bizman shekkol gufo tame, lo timme et ma shealav ad sheyyishhe chede achilat peras, bizman sheen kol gufo tame, eno din shello yetamme et ma shealav ad sheyyishhe chede achilat peras: 
Metzora shennichnas levayit, kol hakkelim sheyyesh sham temein, afillu ad hakkorot. rabbi shimon omer, ad arba ammot. kelim, miyyad temein. rabbi yehuda omer, im shaha chede hadelakat hanner:
Mishnah Negaim 14:13: Shene metzoraim shennitarvu karbenotehem, karav karbano shel achad mehem, umet achad mehem, zo sheshshaalu anshe alekkesanderiyya et rabbi yehoshua. amar lahem, yichtov nechasav leacher veyavi karban ani:
Mishnah Negaim 14:5-8:
Shete tzipporim mitzvatan sheyyehu shavot bammare uvakkoma uvaddamim, ulekichatan keechat. af al pi sheenam shavot, kesherot. lakach achat hayyom veachat lemachar, kesherot. shachat achat mehen venimtzet shello deror, yikkach zug lashsheniyya. harishona mutteret baachila. shechatah venimtzet terefa, yikkach zug lashsheniyya. harishona mutteret bahanaa. nishpach haddam, tamut hammishtallachat. meta hammishtallachat, yishshafech haddam: 
Mitzvat etz erez, arko amma veavyo chirvia kera hammitta. echad lishnayim, ushenayim learbaa. mitzvat ezov, lo ezov yavan, lo ezov kochali, lo ezov romi, lo ezov midbarit, velo chol ezov sheyyesh lo shem levay: 
Bayyom hashshemini mevi shalosh behemot, chattat veasham veola. vehaddal haya mevi chattat haof veolat haof: 
Ba lo etzel haasham, vesamach shete yadav alav, ushechato, vekibbelu shene chohanim et damo, echad bichli, veechad bayyad. ze shekkibbel bakkeli, ba uzerako al kir hammizbeach. veze shekkibbel bayyad, ba lo etzel hammetzora. vehammetzora taval belishkat hammetzoraim. ba veamad beshaar nikkanor. rabbi yehuda omer, lo haya tzarich tevila:
Mishnah Negaim 14:9-12:
Hichnis rosho, venatan al tenuch azno. yado, venatan al bohen yado. raglo, venatan al bohen raglo. rabbi yehuda omer, shelashtam haya machnis keechad. en lo bohen yad, bohen regel, ozen yemanit, en lo tohora olamit. rabbi eliezer omer, noten hu al mekoman. rabbi shimon omer, im natan al shel semol, yatza: 
Natal millog hashshemen veyatzak letoch kappo shel chavero. veim yatzak letoch kaf atzmo, yatza. taval vehizza sheva peamim keneged bet kodesh hakkodashim, al kol hazzaya tevila. ba lo etzel hammetzora, mekom shehu noten et haddam, sham hu noten et hashshemen, shenneemar (Vayikra 14), al mekom dam haasham. vehannotar min hashshemen asher al kaf hakkohen yitten al rosh hammittaher lechapper. im natan, kipper. veim lo natan, lo chipper, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, sheyare mitzva hen, ben shennatan ben shello natan, kipper, umaalin alav keillu lo chipper. chasar hallog ad shello yatzak, yemalennu. mishsheyyatzak, yavi acher battechilla, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi shimon omer, chasar hallog ad shello natan, yemalennu. mishshennatan, yavi acher battechilla: 
Metzora shehevi karbano ani veheeshir, o ashir veheeni, hakkol holech achar chattat, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yehuda omer, achar haasham: 
Metzora ani shehevi karban ashir, yatza. veashir shehevi karban ani, lo yatza. mevi adam al yede veno, al yede vitto, al yede avdo veshifchato karban ani, umaachilan bazzevachim. rabbi yehuda omer, af al yede ishto mevi karban ashir, vechen kol karban shehi chayyavet:
Mishnah Parah 1:1-4:
Rabbi eliezer omer, egla, bat shenatah. ufara, bat shetayim. vachachamim omrim, egla, bat shetayim. ufara, bat shalosh o vat arba. rabbi meir omer, af bat chamesh. keshera hazzekena, ella sheen mamtinin lah, shemma tashchir, shello tippasel. amar rabbi yehoshua, lo shamati ella shelashit. amru lo, ma hallashon shelashit. amar lahem, kach shamati setam. amar ben azzay, ani afaresh. im omer atta, shelishit, laacherot beminyan. uchesheatta omer, shelashit, bat shalosh shanim. kayyotze vo amru, kerem revai. amru lo, ma hallashon revai. amar lahem, kach shamati setam. amar ben azzay, ani afaresh. im omer atta, revii, laacherim beminyan. uchesheatta omer, revai, ben arba shanim. kayyotze vo amru, haochel bevayit hamenugga peras, mishshalosh lekav. amru lo, emor mishshemone esre lisa. amar lahem, kach shamati setam. amar ben azzay, ani afaresh. im omer atta mishshalosh lekav, en bo challa. uchesheatta omer, mishshemone esre lisa, miatattu challato: 
Rabbi yose haggelili omer, parim, bene shetayim, shenneemar (Bamidbar 8), ufar sheni ven bakar tikkach lechattat. vachachamim omrim, af bene shalosh. rabbi meir omer, af bene arba uvene chamesh kesherim, ella sheen meviim zekenim, mippene hakkavod: 
Kevasim, bene shana. veelim, bene shetayim. vechullam miyyom leyom. ben shelosha asar chodesh eno chasher lo leayil velo lecheves. rabbi tarfon korehu palgas. ben azzay korehu noked. rabbi yishmael korehu parchadigma. hikrivo, mevi alav niske ayil, velo ala lo mizzivcho. ben shelosha asar chodesh veyom echad, hare ze ayil: 
Chattot hatztzibbur veolotehen, chattat hayyachid vaasham nazir vaasham metzora, kesherin miyyom sheloshim vahala, veaf beyom sheloshim. veim hikrivum beyom shemini, kesherim. nedarim unedavot, habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach, kesherim miyyom hashshemini vahala, veaf bayyom hashshemini:
Mishnah Parah 2:1-4:
Rabbi eliezer omer, parat chattat hameubberet, keshera. vachachamim poslin. rabbi eliezer omer, enah nilkachat min hannachrim. vachachamim machshirim. velo zo vilvad, ella chol karbenot hatztzibbur vehayyachid bain mehaaretz umichutz laaretz, min hechadash umin hayyashan, chutz min haomer ushete hallechem sheenan bain ella min hechadash umin haaretz: 
Para shekkarneha utelafeha shechorim, yagod. galgal haayin vehashshinnayim vehallashon enam poslim bappara. vehannanneset, keshera. hayta vah yabbelet vachatachah, rabbi yehuda fosel. rabbi shimon omer, kol mekom shennittal velo heela mekomo sear adom, pesula: 
Yotze dofen veetnan umechir, pesula. rabbi eliezer machshir, shenneemar (Devarim 23), lo tavi etnan zona umechir kelev bet Adonai elohecha, veen zo vaa labbayit. kol hammumim happoslim bammukdashim, poslim bappara. rachav aleha, nishan aleha, nitla viznavah, avar bah et hannahar, kippel aleha et hammosera, natan tallito aleha, pesula. aval kesharah bammosera, asa lah sandal bishvil shello tachalik, paras tallito aleha mippene hazzevuvim, keshera. ze hakkelal, kol shehu letzarkah, keshera. letzorech acher, pesula: 
Shachan aleha of, keshera. ala aleha zachar, pesula. rabbi yehuda omer, im heelahu, pesula. veim meatzmo, keshera:
Mishnah Pesachim 1:1-2:
Or learbaa asar, bodkin et hechametz leor hanner. kol makom sheen machnisin bo chametz en tzarich bedika. velama amru shete shurot bammartef, makom shemmachnisin bo chametz. bet shammay omrim, shete shurot al pene chol hammartef. uvet hillel omrim, shete shurot hachitzonot shehen haelyonot: 
En choshshin shemma garra chulda mibbayit levayit umimmakom lemakom, deim ken, mechatzer lechatzer umeir leir, en laddavar sof:
Mishnah Pesachim 1:3-7:
Rabbi yehuda omer, bodkin or arbaa asar uvearbaa asar shacharit uvishat habbiur. vachachamim omrim, lo vadak or arbaa asar, yivdok bearbaa asar. lo vadak bearbaa asar, yivdok betoch hammoed. lo vadak betoch hammoed, yivdok leachar hammoed. uma shemmeshayyer, yannichennu vetzina, kede shello yehe tzarich bedika acharav: 
Rabbi meir omer, ochlin kol chamesh, vesorfin bitchillat shesh. verabbi yehuda omer, ochlin kol arba, vetolin kol chamesh, vesorfin bitchillat shesh: 
Veod amar rabbi yehuda, shete challot shel toda fesulot munnachot al gag haitztabba. kol zeman shemmunnachot, kol haam ochlim. nittela achat, tolin, lo ochlin velo sorfin. nittelu shetehen, hitchilu chol haam sorfin. rabban gamliel omer, chullin neechalin kol arba, uteruma kol chamesh, vesorfin bitchillat shesh: 
Rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer, mimehem shel kohanim lo nimneu millisrof et habbasar shennitma vivlad hattuma im habbasar shennitma veav hattuma, af al pi shemmosifin tuma al tumato. hosif rabbi akiva veamar, mimehem shel kohanim lo nimneu millehadlik et hashshemen shennifsal bitvul yom bener shennitma vitme met, af al pi shemmosifin tuma al tumato: 
Amar rabbi meir, middivrehem lamadnu, shessorfin teruma tehora im hattemea befesach. amar lo rabbi yose, enah hi hammidda. umodim rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua, shessorfin zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah. al ma nechelku, al hatteluya veal hattemea, sherabbi eliezer omer, tissaref zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah, verabbi yehoshua omer, shetehen keechat:
Mishnah Pesachim 2:1-4:
Kol shaa shemmuttar leechol, maachil labbehema lachayya velaofot, umochro lannachri, umuttar bahanaato. avar zemanno, asur bahanaato, velo yassik bo tannur vechirayim. rabbi yehuda omer, en biur chametz ella serefa. vachachamim omrim, af mefarer vezore laruach o mattil layyam: 
Chametz shel nachri sheavar alav happesach, muttar bahanaa. veshel yisrael, asur bahanaa. shenneemar (Shemot 13) lo yerae lecha seor: 
Nachri shehilva et yisrael al chametzo, achar happesach muttar bahanaa. veyisrael shehilva et hannachri al chametzo, achar happesach asur bahanaa. chametz shennafla alav mappolet, hare hu chimvoar. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kol sheen hakkelev yachol lechappes acharav: 
Haochel terumat chametz befesach beshogeg, meshallem keren vechomesh. bemezid, patur mittashlumim umiddeme etzim:
Mishnah Pesachim 2:5-8:
Ellu devarim sheadam yotze vahen yede chovato befesach, bechittim, bisorim, bechussemin uveshifon uveshibbolet shual. veyotzin bidmay uvemaaser rishon shennittela terumato, uvemaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu, vehakkohanim bechalla uvitruma. aval lo vetevel, velo vemaaser rishon shello nittela terumato, velo vemaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu. challot toda urekike nazir, asaan leatzmo, en yotzin bahen. asaan limkor bashshuk, yotzin bahen: 
Veellu yerakot sheadam yotze vahen yede chovato befesach, bachazeret uveulashin uvetamcha uvecharchavina uvemaror. yotzin bahen ben lachin ben yeveshin, aval lo chevushin velo shelukin velo mevushshalin. umitztarfin lechazzayit. veyotzin bakkelach shellahen, uvidmay, uvemaaser rishon shennittela terumato, uvemaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu: 
En shorin et hammursan lattarnegolim, aval choltin. haishsha lo tishre et hammursan shettolich beyadah lammerchatz, aval shafa hi bivsarah yavesh. lo yilos adam chittin veyanniach al makkato befesach, mippene shehen machamitzot: 
En notnin kemach letoch hacharoset o letoch hachardal, veim natan, yochal miyyad, verabbi meir oser. en mevashshelin et happesach lo vemashkin velo veme ferot, aval sachin umatbilin oto vahen. me tashmisho shel nachtom, yishshafchu, mippene shehen machamitzin:
Mishnah Shevuot 1:1-5:
Shevuot shetayim shehen arba, yediot hattuma shetayim shehen arba, yetziot hashshabbat shetayim shehen arba, marot negaim shenayim shehem arbaa: 
Kol sheyyesh bah yedia vattechilla vidia vassof vehelem bentayim, hare ze beole veyored. yesh bah yedia vattechilla veen bah yedia vassof, sair shennaase vifnim veyom hakkippurim tole, ad sheyyivvada lo veyavi veole veyored: 
En bah yedia vattechilla aval yesh bah yedia vassof, sair hannaase vachutz veyom hakkippurim mechapper, shenneemar (Bamidbar 29) millevad chattat hakkippurim, al ma shezze mechapper, ze mechapper. ma happenimi en mechapper ella al davar sheyyesh bo yedia, af hachitzon en mechapper ella al davar sheyyesh bo yedia: 
Veal sheen bah yedia lo vattechilla velo vassof, seire hargalim useire rashe chodashim mechapperim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer, seire hargalim mechapperin, aval lo seire rashe chodashim. veal ma seire rashe chodashim mechapperin, al hattahor sheachal et hattame. rabbi meir omer, kol hasseirim kapparatan shava al tumat mikdash vekadashav. haya rabbi shimon omer, seire rashe chodashim mechapperin al hattahor sheachal et hattame, veshel regalim mechapperin al sheen bah yedia lo vattechilla velo vassof, veshel yom hakkippurim mechapper al sheen bah yedia vattechilla aval yesh bah yedia vassof. amru lo, mahu sheyyikrevu ze vaze. amar lahem, yikravu. amru lo, hoil veen kapparatan shava, heach kerevin ze vaze. amar lahen, kullan bain lechapper al tumat mikdash vekadashav: 
Rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshemo, seire rashe chodashim mechapperin al tahor sheachal et hattame. mosif alehem shel regalim, shemmechapperin al tahor sheachal et hattame veal sheen bah yedia lo vattechilla velo vassof. mosif alehem shel yom hakkippurim, shehen mechapperin al hattahor sheachal et hattame, veal sheen bah yedia lo vattechilla velo vassof, veal sheen bah yedia vattechilla aval yesh bah yedia vassof. amru lo, mahu sheyyikrevu ze vaze. amar lahem, hen. amru lo, im ken, yihyu shel yom hakkippurim kerevin berashe chodashim, aval heach shel rashe chodashim kerevin beyom hakkippurim lechapper kappara sheenah shellah. amar lahen, kullan bain lechapper al tumat mikdash vekadashav:
Mishnah Shevuot 1:6-2:2:
Veal zedon tumat mikdash vekadashav, sair hannaase vifnim veyom hakkippurim mechapperin. veal shear averot shebbattora, hakkallot vehachamurot, hazzedonot vehashshegagot, hoda velo hoda, ase velo taase, keretot umitot bet din, sair hammishtalleach mechapper: 
Echad yisreelim, veechad kohanim, veechad kohen mashuach. ma ben yisreelim lechohanim ulechohen mashuach, ella sheddam happar mechapper al hakkohanim al tumat mikdash vekadashav. rabbi shimon omer, keshem sheddam hassair hannaase vifnim mechapper al yisrael, kach dam happar mechapper al hakkohanim. keshem shevvidduyo shel sair hammishtalleach mechapper al yisrael, kach vidduyo shel par mechapper al hakkohanim: 
Yediot hattuma shetayim shehen arba. nitma veyada veneelma mimmennu hattuma vezachur et hakkodesh, nelam mimmennu hakkodesh vezachur et hattuma, neelmu mimmennu ze vaze veachal et hakkodesh velo yada, umishsheachal yada, hare ze veole veyored. nitma veyada veneelma mimmennu tuma vezachur et hammikdash, nelam mimmennu mikdash vezachur et hattuma, neelmu mimmennu ze vaze venichnas lammikdash velo yada, umishsheyyatza yada, hare ze veole veyored: 
Echad hannichnas laazara veechad hannichnas letosefet haazara, sheen mosifin al hair veal haazarot ella vemelech venavi veurim vetummim uvesanhedrin shel shivim veechad uvishte todot uveshir. uvet din mehallechin ushete todot acharehem, vechol yisrael acharehem. happenimit neechelet vehachitzona nisrafet. vechol shello naasa vechol ellu, hannichnas lesham en chayyavin aleha:
Mishnah Shevuot 2:3-3:1:
Nitma vaazara veneelma mimmennu tuma vezachur et hammikdash, nelam mimmennu mikdash vezachur lattuma, nelam mimmennu ze vaze, vehishtachava o sheshshaha vichde hishtachavaa, ba lo vaarukka, chayyav. bakketzara, patur. zo hi mitzvat ase shebbammikdash, sheen chayyavin aleha: 
Veezo hi mitzvat ase shebbannidda shechayyavin aleha, haya meshammesh im hattehora veamra lo nitmeti, uferash miyyad, chayyav, mippene sheyyetziato hanaa lo keviato: 
Rabbi eliezer omer, hashsheretz vegomer venelam mimmennu (Vayikra 5), al helem sheretz chayyav, veeno chayyav al helem mikdash. rabbi akiva omer, venelam mimmennu vehu tame (sham), al helem tuma chayyav, veeno chayyav al helem mikdash. rabbi yishmael omer, venelam venelam shete feamim, lechayyev al helem tuma veal helem mikdash: 
Shevuot shetayim shehen arba, shevua sheochal veshello ochal, sheachalti veshello achalti. shevua shello ochal veachal kol shehu, chayyav, divre rabbi akiva. amru lo lerabbi akiva, hechan matzinu beochel kol shehu shehu chayyav, shezze chayyav. amar lahen rabbi akiva, vechi hechan matzinu bimdabber umevi karban, shezze medabber umevi karban. shevua shello ochal veachal veshata, eno chayyav ella achat. shevua shello ochal veshello eshte veachal veshata, chayyav shetayim:
Mishnah Shevuot 3:2-6:
Shevua shello ochal, veachal pat chittin ufat seorin ufat kussemin, eno chayyav ella achat. shevua shello ochal pat chittin ufat seorin ufat kussemin, veachal, chayyav al kol achat veechat: 
Shevua shello eshte veshata mashkin harebe, eno chayyav ella achat. shevua shello eshte yayin vashemen udevash veshata, chayyav al kol achat veechat: 
Shevua shello ochal, veachal ochalim sheenan reuyin laachila veshata mashkin sheenan reuyin lishtiyya, patur. shevua shello ochal, veachal nevelot uterefot shekatzim uremasim, chayyav. rabbi shimon poter. amar, konam ishti nehenet li im achalti hayyom, vehu achal nevelot uterefot shekatzim uremasim, hare ishto asura: 
Echad devarim shel atzmo, veechad devarim shel acherim, veechad devarim sheyyesh bahen mammash, veechad devarim sheen bahem mammash. ketzad. amar, shevua sheetten leish peloni veshello etten, shennatatti veshello natatti, sheishan veshello ishan, sheyyashanti veshello yashanti, sheezrok tzeror layyam veshello ezrok, shezzarakti veshello zarakti. rabbi yishmael omer, eno chayyav ella al heatid lavo, shenneemar (Vayikra 5) lehara o lehetiv. amar lo rabbi akiva, im ken en li ella devarim sheyyesh bahen haraa vahatava, devarim sheen bahen haraa vahatava minnayin. amar lo, meribbuy hakkatuv. amar lo, im ribba hakkatuv lechach, ribba hakkatuv lechach: 
Nishba levattel et hammitzva velo vittel, patur. lekayyem velo kiyyem, patur. shehaya vaddin, sheyyehe chayyav, kedivre rabbi yehuda ben betera. amar rabbi yehuda ben betera, ma im harshut sheeno mushba aleha mehar sinay, hare hu chayyav aleha, mitzva shehu mushba aleha mehar sinay, eno din sheyyehe chayyav aleha. amru lo, lo, im amarta vishvuat harshut, shekken asa vah lav kehen, tomar bishvuat mitzva shello asa vah lav kehen, sheim nishba levattel velo vittel, patur:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Veshibbechu chachamim lemi shekkore zemirot missefer tehillim bechol yom vayom mi<small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" ad sof hassefer. uchevar nahagu likrot pesukim lifnehem uleacharehem vetikkenu beracha lifne hazzemirot vehi baruch sheamar uveracha leacharehem vehi yishtabbach. veachar kach mevarech al keriat shema vekore keriat shema:

Yesh mekomot shennahagu bahen likrot bechol yom achar shemmevarchin yishtabbach <small>(Shemot 15 1 19)</small> "shirat hayyam" veachar kach mevarchin al shema. veyesh mekomot shekkorin <small>(Devarim 32 1 43)</small> "shirat haazinu". veyesh yechidim shekkorin shete hashshirot hakkol lefi hamminhag:

Chayyav adam levarech mea berachot ben hayyom vehallayla. uma hen mea berachot ellu. 23 berachot shemmaninu beferek ze. vesheva berachot shel keriat shema shel shacharit vearvit lefaneha uleachareha. ucheshemmitattef batztzitzit mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehitattef betzitzit. ucheshellovesh tefillin mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehaniach tefillin. veshalosh tefillot shebbechol tefilla mehen shemone esre berachot hare shemonim veshesh berachot. ucheshehu ochel shete seuddot shel yom vehallayla mevarech arba esre berachot. sheva bechol seudda. achat kesheyyittol yadav techilla. veal hammazon achat battechilla veshalosh bassof veal hayyayin lefanav uleacharav hare sheva berachot hare mea berachot ben hakkol:

Bazzeman hazze shettikkenu birkat haeppikorosin battefilla vehosifu hattov vehammetiv bevirkat hammazon nimtzeu chamesh berachot yeterot. beshabbatot veyamim tovim shehattefilla sheva berachot, vechen im lo nitchayyev bishar hayyamim bechol habberachot haellu kegon shello yashan kol hallayla velo hittir chagoro velo nichnas levet hakkisse vechayyotze beellu, tzarich lehashelim mea berachot min happerot:
Ketzad. ochel meat yarak umevarech lefanav uleacharav vechozer veochel meat mipperi ze umevarech lefanav uleacharav umone kol habberachot ad shemmashlim mea bechol yom:

Kesheshshomea kol hattarnegolim mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hannoten lassechvi vina lehavechin ben yom uven layla. keshellovesh begadav mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam malbish arumim. keshemmanniach sedino al rosho mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam oter yisrael betifara. keshemmaavir yadav al enav mevarech pokeach ivrim. kesheyyeshev al mittato mevarech mattir asurim. keshemmorid raglav min hammitta umannicham al gabbe karka mevarech roka haaretz al hammayim. kesheomed mevarech zokef kefufim. keshennotel yadav mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al netilat yadayim. kesherochetz panav mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hammaavir chevle shena meenay utenuma meafappay, yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay velohe avotay shettargileni lidvar mitzva veal targileni lidvar avera veavon vetashlet bi yetzer tov veal yishlot bi yetzer ra utechazzekeni bemitzvotecha veten chelki betoratecha vetitteneni lechen ulechesed ulerachamim beenecha uveene chol roay vetigmeleni chasadim tovim, baruch atta Adonai gomel chasadim tovim:

Vechol zeman sheyyikkanes levet hakkisse omer kodem sheyyikkanes hitkabbedu mechubbadim kedoshim mesharte elyon izruni izruni shimruni shimruni hametinu li ad sheekkanes veetze shezze darkan shel bene adam. veachar sheyyatza mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher yatzar et haadam bechachma uvara vo nekavim nekavim chalulim chalulim galuy veyadua lifne chisse chevodecha sheim yissatem echad mehem o im yippateach echad mehem i efshar lehitkayyem afillu shaa achat baruch atta Adonai rofe chol basar umafli laasot:

Keshchoger chagoro mevarech ozer yisrael bigvura. keshellovesh nealav mevarech sheasita li kol tzarki. keshemmehallech latzet ladderech mevarech hammechin mitzade gaver. umevarech adam bechol yom baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shello asani goy. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shello asani ishsha. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shello asani aved:

Shemone esre berachot ellu en lahem seder ella mevarech kol achat mehen al davar shehabberacha bishvilo bishato. ketzad. hare shechagar chagoro vehu al mittato mevarech ozer yisrael bigvura. shama kol hattarnegol mevarech hannoten lassechvi vina. vechol beracha mehen shello nitchayyev bah eno mevarech otah:

Ketzad. lan bichsuto eno mevarech kesheomed malbish arumim. halach yachef eno mevarech sheasita li kol tzarki. beyom hakkippurim uvetisha beav sheen sham rechitza eno mevarech al netilat yadayim velo hammaavir chevle shena. im lo nichnas levet hakkisse eno mevarech asher yatzar et haadam. vechen shear berachot ellu:

Nahagu haam berov arenu levarech berachot ellu zo achar zo bevet hakkeneset ben nitchayyevu bahen ben lo nitchayyevu bahen. vetaut hu veen rauy laasot ken velo yevarech beracha ella im ken nitchayyev bah:

Hammashkim likro battora kodem sheyyikra keriat shema ben kara battora shebbichtav ben kara battora shebbeal pe notel yadav techilla umevarech shalosh berachot veachar kach kore. veellu hen. asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al divre tora. vehaarev na Adonai elohenu et divre toratcha befinu uvefippiyyot ammecha kol bet yisrael venihye anachnu vetzeetzaenu vetzeetzae ammecha yode shemecha veoske toratecha lishmah baruch atta Adonai hamelammed tora leammo yisrael. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bachar banu mikkol haammim venatan lanu et torato baruch atta Adonai noten hattora:

Bechol yom chayyav adam levarech shalosh berachot ellu veachar kach kore meat middivre tora. venahagu haam likro <small>(Bamidbar 6 22 27)</small> "birkat kohanim". veyesh mekomot shekkorin <small>(Bamidbar 28 b)</small> "tzav et bene yisrael". veyesh mekomot shekkorin shetehen. vekorin perakim o halachot min hammishna umin habberaytot:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 9:1-3:
Haofe kigrogeret chayyav. echad haofe et happat o hamevashshel et hammaachol o et hassammanin o hamechammem et hammayim hakkol inyan echad hu. shiur hamechammem et hammayim kede lirchotz bahen evar katan. veshiur mevashshel sammanin kede sheyyihyu reuyin ledavar shemmevashshelin otan lo: 
Hannoten betza betzad hammecham bishvil shettitgalgel venitgalgela chayyav. shehamevashshel betoledet haur kimvashshel baur atzmah. vechen hammediach bechammin dag maliach hayyashan o kuleyays haispanin vehu dag dak verach beyoter hare ze chayyav. shehadachatan bechammin ze hu gemar bishshulan. vechen kol kayyotze bahen:

Niddah 21b:10-15: Tanu rabbanan: hammappelet chaticha, somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir, vechen haya rabbi shimon ben menasya omer kidvarav: korah, im yesh dam betochah — temea, veim lav — tehora.
Kerabbanan, vaadifa midderabbanan. kerabbanan — deamri: efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam. vaadifa midderabbanan — deinhu savri: immah — in, betochah — la, vesomchos savar: afillu betochah.
Vetanya iddach: hammappelet chaticha, rabbi acha omer: korah, im tochah maadim — temea, veim lav — tehora.

Vetanya iddach: hammappelet chaticha, rabbi binyamin omer: korah, im yesh bah etzem — immo temea leda. amar rav chisda: uvachaticha levana. vechen ki ata zuga demin chadyayv, ata veayyti matnita bideh: hammappelet chaticha levana — korah, im yesh bah etzem — immo temea leda.
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: hammappelet chaticha — korah, im yesh bah dam agur — temea, veim lav — tehora, kesomchos, vekilla mikkullehu.
Pesachim 7b:13-8a:5: Leor hanner vechulei. mena hane mille? amar rav chisda: lamadnu metzia mimmetzia, umetzia mechippus, vechippus mechippus, vechippus minnerot, venerot minner.
Metzia mimmetzia — ketiv hacha: "shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem", uchetiv hatam: "vaychappes baggadol hechel uvakkaton killa vayyimmatze". umetzia mechippus dideh.
Vechippus minnerot, dichtiv: "baet hahi achappes et yerushalaym bannerot", venerot minner, dichtiv: "ner (elohim) [Adonai] nishmat adam chofes kol chadre vaten".

Tana deve rabbi yishmael: lele arbaa asar bodkim et hechametz leor hanner. af al pi sheen reaya ledavar, zecher laddavar, shenneemar: "shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze", veomer: "vaychappes baggadol hechel uvakkaton killa", veomer: "baet hahi achappes et yerushalaym bannerot", veomer: "ner (elohim) [Adonai] nishmat adam chofes".

Vechi tema: hay "baet hahi" — kulla hu dekaamar rachamana: la badekna la birushalayim binhora daavuka — dinfish nehora tuva, ella binhora dishraga — dezutar nehora tefe, deavon rabba mishtechach veavon zutar la mishtechach, ta shema: "ner Adonai nishmat adam".
Tanu rabbanan: en bodkin lo leor hachamma, velo leor hallevana, velo leor haavuka, ella leor hanner,

Mippene sheor hanner yafe labbedika. veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar — zecher laddavar, shenneemar: "shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem", veomer: "vaychappes baggadol hechel", veomer: "baet hahi achappes et yerushalaym bannerot", veomer: "ner Adonai nishmat adam chofes kol chadre vaten".
Hay or hachamma hechi dame? i nema bechatzer, haamar rava: chatzer enah tzericha bedika, mippene shehaorvin metzuyin sham. ella beachsadra, haamar rava: achsadra leorah nivdeket!
La tzericha, laarubba divcheder. udehecha? i levahade arubba — hayeynu achsadra. ella litzdadin.

Vaavuka la? vehaamar rava, may dichtiv: "venoga kaor tihye karnayim miyyado lo vesham chevyon uzzo", lema tzaddikim domin bifne shechina — kanner bifne haavuka. veamar rava: avuka lehavedala mitzva min hammuvechar!

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ze — yachol lehacheniso lechorin velisdakin, veze — eno yachol lehacheniso lechorin velisdakin. rav zevid amar: ze — oro lefanav, vaze — oro leacharav. rav pappa amar: hay — beit, vehay — la beit. ravina amar: hay — meshich nehora, vehay — mikkattaf ikkattofe.
