Sanhedrin 41b:12-42a:5: Veamar rabbi acha bar chanina amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: ad kamma mevarchin al hachodesh? ad shettitmalle pegimatah. vechamma? amar rav yaakov bar idi amar rav yehuda: ad shiva. nehardae amri: ad shishsha asar.
Vetarvayyhu kerabbi yochanan sevira lehu: ha lemihve ki yitra, ha lemihve ki nafya.

Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: velivarech "hattov vehammetiv"! amar leh: attu ki chasar mi mevarchinan "dayyayn haemet", dilvarech "hattov vehammetiv"? velivarchinhu letarvayyhu? kevan dehayynu orcheh, la mevarchinan.

Veamar rabbi acha bar chanina amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: kol hamevarech al hachodesh bizmanno keillu mekabbel pene shechina. ketiv hacha "hachodesh hazze", uchetiv hatam "ze eli veanvehu". tana deve rabbi yishmael: ilmale lo zachu yisrael ella lehakebil pene avihen shebbashshamayim kol chodesh vachodesh, dayyaym. amar abbaye: hilkach nemrinhu meummad.
Marimar umar zutera mechattefi ahadade umevarchi. amar leh rav acha lerav ashe: bemareva mevarchi "baruch mechaddesh chodashim". amar leh: hay neshe didan name mevarchi.

Ella kidrav yehuda, deamar rav yehuda: "baruch [vechulei] asher bemaamaro bara shechakem, uveruach piv kol tzevaam. chok uzeman natan lahem shello yeshannu et tafkidam, sasim usemechim laasot retzon konam. poale emet sheppeullatan emet. velallevana amar shettitchaddesh ateret tiferet laamuse vaten, shehen atidin lehitchaddesh kemotah ulefaer leyotzram al shem kevod malchuto. baruch atta Adonai mechaddesh chodashim".
Zohar, Nasso 19: (Bamidbar 6:27) vesamu et shemi. mahu vesamu et shemi. amar ribbi yehuda, yetakkenu. kema dichtiv, (Bamidbar 4:19) vesamu otam ish ish al avodato veel massao. leatkkena bevirchathon kitrin dimina limina, vechitrin dismala lismala, kaddeka chaze. devaya dela yitun behon, leatkkena kolla, begin deyitbarchun illain vetattain.

Vei yaavdun hachi, ma ketiv. vaani avarachem. leman. leinnun kahane, dichtiv, (Bereshit 27:29) umevarachecha baruch. uchetiv (Bereshit 12:3) vaavarcha mevarachecha. innun mevarchin leamma, vaana avarech lehu. ulefichach ketiv vesamu, vela ketiv yomru, o yizkeru.

Tana, kol kohen dela rachamin leh amma, la yifros yedoy. veovada hava bechad kohen dekam ufaris yedoy, vead dela ashlim, itavid tilla degarme. may tama. mishshum dela berich bachavivuta. vekam acher ufaris yedoy uvarich, veittakkan hahu yoma. kol kohen dehu la rachim leamma, o amma la rachamin leh, la yifros yedoy levarcha leamma, dichtiv, (Mishlei 22:9) tov ayin hu yevorach al tikre yevorach, ella yevarech.

Tana, amar ribbi yitzchak, bo uree ma ketiv behahu rasha devilam, beshaata deittemsar leh levarcha leyisrael, hava mashgach beena bisha, begin dela yitkeyyaym birchata, vahava tale milloy behahu ena bisha, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 24:3) neum bilam beno beor. may beno beor. mehahu dehava sane lehu yattir mikkol bene alma. uneum haggever shetum haayin, desatim ena tava minnayyhu, begin dela yitbarchun, vela yitkayyem birchata.

Amar ribbi yehuda, hachi hu vday, deishtechach pekia (sefer acher deishtechachan pekicha) deena levarcha, dichtiv, (Daniel 9) pekach enecha, begin levarcha. uvirchata derav hamenuna sava, hachi amar, kudesha berich hu yifkach enoy alach. uvehahu rasha ketiv, shetum haayin. begin dela yitbarchun al yedoy. veamar ribbi yitzchak, begin kach kahana devarich beena tava, birchateh itkeyyaym. udela mevarech beena tava, ketiv, (Mishlei 23:6) al tilcham et lechem ra ayin veal titav lematammotav, kelomar al tivu minneh birchata kelal.

Amar ribbi yose, ta chaze, ketiv (Devarim 23:6) velo ava Adonai elohecha lishmoa el bilam vegomer. lishmoa el bilam, el balak mibbae leh, deha avid balak kolla, mahu el bilam. ella mishshum dehava satim enoy, begin dela yitbarchun yisrael. tana, amar ribbi yose, amar leh kudesha berich hu levilam, rasha, at satim enach begin dela yitbarchun banay. ana afkach enay, vechol millin detema, ehefoch lehu levirchan. hada hu dichtiv, vayahafoch Adonai elohecha lecha et hakkelala livracha ki ahevcha vegomer.

Veal da ketiv, tov ayin hu yevorach ki natan millachmo laddal. mahu millachmo. kema deokimna, dichtiv, (Vayikra 21:22) lechem elohav mekkadshe hakkodashim vegomer. mashma dekadshe hakodashim lechem elohav nafak minneh. uvegin kach ki natan millachmo laddal. tanya, kama chavivin yisrael kamme kudesha berich hu, deilae la mitbarche ella beginehon deyisrael.

Detanenan, amar ribbi yehuda, amar ribbi chiyyay, amar ribbi yose, nishba hakkadosh baruch hu, shello yikkanes biyrushalam shel maala, ad sheyyikkansu yisrael biyrushala 40 shel matta, shenneemar (Hoshea 11:9) bekirbecha kadosh velo avo beir. kelomar, kol zimna dishchinta hacha begaluta, shema dilella la ishtelim. vechol tikkunin la ittekanu, kivyachol ishtear shema kaddisha chasra.

Ribbi abba hava azil lelud, paga beh ribbi zera bar rav, amar leh ha chamena appe shechinta, uman dechame appe shechinta, bae lemezal ulerahata batraa. hada hu dichtiv, (Hoshea 6:3) veneda nirdefa ladaat et Adonai. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 2:3) vehalchu ammim rabbim veamru lechu venaale el har Adonai vegomer. ki mitztziyyon tetze tora vegomer. vaana baena lemehach batrach, ulemelaf meinnun mille mealleyayta, deattun taamin kol yoma, meiddara kaddisha.
Zohar, Nasso 1:1-8: (Bamidbar 4:21-22) vaydabber Adonai el moshe lemor, naso et rosh bene gershon vegomer. ribbi abba patach, (Tehillim 32:2) ashre adam lo yachashov Adonai lo avon veen berucho remiyya. hay kera, lav resheh sefeh, velav sefeh resheh. veit leistakkela beh, veha ukemuha.

Ta chaze, beshaata ditzlota demincha dina sharya bealma, veyitzchak tikken tzelota demincha, ugevura illaa shalta bealma, ad deate veal lelya, begin lekabbela leh (lelelya), umizzimna deshari tzelota demincha, itperash semala lekabbela (leh) veittear lelya.
Batar deittear kol innun neture pitchin dilvar, kullehu mitarin bealma veitpashatu. vechol bene alma taamin taama demota.

Veha ittemar. befalgut lelya mammash, ittear semala kemillekaddemin, uvarda kaddisha salleka rechin, vehi meshabbachat vaarimat kala, ucheden salleka vesharya resha leella bismala, usemala mekabbel lah.

Keden karoza kare bealma, deha iddan hu leitteara leshabbecha leh lemalka. ucheden tushebchan mitarin, veitbassemuta decholla ishtechach. zakkaa chulakeh man deittear lezavvevga ziuuga da. kad ate tzafra, vimina ittear umechabbeka lah, keden ziuuga decholla ishtechach kachada. (sefer acher lemalka, kad ate tzafra vimina ittear vamechabek la keden ziuuga decholla ishtechach kachada ucheden taveshabechaten mitarin veitbassemuta decholla ishtechach zakkaa chulakeh man deittear lezavvevga ziuuga da)

Ta chaze, beshaata divne nasha demichin, vetaamin taama demota, venishmeta salleka leella, kayyeyma baatar dekayyeyma, veitbechinat al ovadaha deavdat kol yoma, vechatvin lehu al pitka. may tama. begin denishmeta salleka leella, veashidat al ovadoy debar nash, veal kol milla umilla denafik mippumeh.

Vechad hahi milla deappik bar nash mippumeh ihi kedka yaut, milla kaddisha deorayyta utzelota. hahi milla salleka, uvaka rekiin, vekayyeyma beatar dekayyeyma, ad deal lelya, venishmeta salleka veachid lehahi milla, veail lah kamme malka.

Vechad hahi milla lav ihi kedka yaut, veihi milla mimmilin bishin, millishana bisha, hahi milla salleka laatar desalleka, ucheden itreshim hahi milla, vehahu chova aleh debar nash, hada hu dichtiv, (Micha 7:Adonai) mishshochevet chekecha shemor pitche picha. uvegin kach (Tehillim 32:2) ashre adam lo yachashov Adonai lo avon. ematay. kesheen berucho remiyya.
Zohar, Nasso 4: Ribbi yitzchak veribbi yehuda havo azle meusha lelud, amar ribbi yehuda (yitzchak) nema millin deorayyta venezil. patach ribbi yehuda (sefer acher yitzchak) veamar, (Shemot 21:33) ki yiftach ish bor o ki yichre ish bor vegomer. ma ketiv batreh, baal habbor yeshallem vegomer. uma al da kach, man degarim leavasha alma bechovoy al achat kamma vechamma. ella tavvavhna deaf al gav deavish alma, amay it leh teshuva, kema dichtiv ish o isha ki yaasu vegomer vehitvaddu et chattatam veheshiv.

Ella vadday da mehaneya lehu, begin deavid teshuva, kivyachol hu avid leh mammash. deha ma defagim leella, atkin leh, uvema bitshuva. dichtiv ish o ishsha ki yaasu vegomer, vehitvaddu et chattatam veheshiv, uteshuva atkin kolla, atkin leella, atkin letatta, atkin legarmeh, atkin lechol alma.

Patach ribbi yitzchak (sefer acher yehuda) abbatreh veamar, (Devarim 4:30) batztzar lecha umetzaucha kol haddevarim haelle vegomer. batztzar lecha, mikkan ditshuva mealleya mikkolla, ad la yishre dina bealma. devatar dishre dina takkif cheleh man yabar leh mealma visallek leh. deha kevan deshari dina, la istelik ad deyishtelim. batar deishtelim, veavad teshuva, atkin almin kullehu. mashma, dichtiv umetzaucha kol haddevarim haelle beacharit hayyamim, uchetiv veshavta ad Adonai elohecha vegomer. ki el rachum Adonai elohecha vegomer.

Beacharit hayyamim, may ikka hacha. ella leachlela keneset yisrael, deihi begaluta, veishtechachat beaku dilhon, vela shavkat lon lealmin. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu af al gav deashre dina bealma, bae deyahadrun yisrael bitshuva, leotava lehu behay alma, uvealma deate, velet lacha man dekaim kamme teshuva.

Ta chaze, afillu keneset yisrael, teshuva ikre. vei tema (teshuva) illaa (sefer acher mealleya) (nusach acher veet illaa) mikkol atar la shechiach, ella da ikre teshuva, kad ahdar rachame lekavlaha, vehi tavat al kol innun ochlosin veyanka lon. uteshuva mealya, kad itmesar nafsha legabbah, venatil lah bezimna deihi bitshuva, keden kolla ittakkan leella vetatta, veittakkan hu, vechol alma.

Chayyayva chad bealma, kilkula dechamma acharanin begineh. vavy lachayyayva, vavy lishviveh. ta chaze, yona, begin dela baa lemehach bishlichuta demareh, kama bene nasha havo itavidu begineh beyamma, ad dechullehu ahadru aloy, vedainu leh bedina beyamma, ucheden ishtezivu kullehu, vekudesha berich hu chas aleh levatar, vesheziv kama ochlosin bealma. ematay. kad ahdar lemareh miggo akteh. hada hu dichtiv, (Yona 2:3) karati mitztzara li el Adonai vayyaaneni. uchetiv, (Tehillim 118:5) min hammetzar karati yah anani vamerchav yah vegomer.

Raya mehemna pikkuda da, hi mitztzevat teshuva. veda ihi bina. uvaavonotenu middecharav be makdesha, la ishtear lanu ella vidduy devarim levad, veda malchut. umay bina. ben yah. vehay ben, 6 ihu vadday. vechol man dechazar betiyyuveta, keillu chazar at Adonai leat 6, deihu ben yah, veishtelim beh Adonai. veda ihu teshuva, tashuv Adonai vadday legabbe 6.

Deat Adonai vadday ihu vidduy devarim, veraza demilla, (Hoshea 14:3) kechu immachem devarim veshuvu el Adonai imru elav vegomer uneshallema parim sefatenu. devadday kad bar nash ihu chote, garim leitrachaka Adonai meat 6. deistellak ben yah, da Yahu, meat Adonai. uvegin da itcharav be makdesha, veitrachaku yisrael mittamman, veitgelu bene amamya. uvegin da, kol man deavid teshuva, garim leachzera Adonai leat 6, ufurekana beda talyay. uvegin da hakkol taluy bitshuva. dechach amru kadmae, kol hakkitztzim kalu, veen haddavar taluy ella bitshuva, deihu shelimu dishmeh.

Veal da (yechezkel 20:14) vaeese lemaan shemi. veod (Yeshayahu 48:11) lemaani lemaani eese. veim lav chazrin, ana aamid lon malka, shekashin gezirotav mishshel paro, veyachzerun al karchayyeyhu. hada hu dichtiv veshavta ad Adonai elohecha, ad Adonai vadday.

Uteshuva da itkeriat chayyim, (Mishlei 4:23) ki mimmennu totztzeot chayyim, deinnun nishmatin deyisrael. veihu hevel denafak veal befuma debar nash, belo amal uvelo yegia. Adonai dibbehibbaram. vealah ittemar, (Devarim 8:3) ki al kol motztza pi Adonai yichye haadam. vehi al resheh debar nash. ala ittemar, (Bamidbar 12:8) utemunat Adonai yabbit. (Tehillim 39:7) ach betztzelem yithallech ish.
Uvegin deihi al resheh debar nash, asir leh lebar nash lemezal 4 ammot begiluy deresha, deem hi istalakat meal resheh debar nash, miyyad istelaku chayyim minneh.

Vei tema dechach sharya al umin dealma, af al gav dela itbere behon shemaya veara vechol toladin divhon. la sharya vadday, demoshe baa mikudesha berich hu, dela tishre shechina al umin dealma, veyahiv leh. havla dekayyeyma al umin dealma mean nafka. o al chayyayvayya deinnun erev rav meuravin im yisrael. ella vadday let kol appayay shavin, afillu yisrael lav innun shavyan, kol shekken acharanin.

Ella vadday al hay diyyukena deat Adonai ukemuha, mattana tova yish li bevet genazay veshabbat shemah. vechad hay sharya al yisrael, let lon yegia vela shibud. uva nefesh amela vigea (Shemot 31:17) shavat vayyinnafash.

Denefesh achara it al resheh debar nash, deitkeriat eved. veihu diyyukena al bar nash. veihi eved demalka, dimnanea kol evarin debar nash, lemezal bearchin tavin, ulekayyeyma behon 248 pikudin, lesharya alayyhu Adonai dibbehibbaram, dechach salik hibbaram lermch.

Udeyukena achara al resheh, deitkeriat yira, veda 10. vealayyhu ittemar, (Bereshit 1:27) vayyivra elohim et haadam betztzalmo betztzelem elohim. teren diukenin tavin, deinnun dechar venukeba. dechar missitra deat 10. nukeba missitra deat Adonai.

Uteren atvavn attearin leh lebar nash lattora velammitztzeva. 10 yira, veda ihi al resheh debar nash, uminah yeul dechilu lelibba debar nash, lemidchal mekudesha berich hu, ulenatra garmeh dela yevar al pikudin dela taase. Adonai ahava al resheh debar nash, uminneh al rechimu dekudesha berich hu, al 248 evarin dileh, lekayyeyma behon pikudin daase. 6 ihi al resheh debar nash, uminneh yiul al puma debar nash milulin leolfa beorayyta.

Uvehay kechu immachem devarim veshuvu el Adonai. uvehay diyhe bechon hayyira vehaahava vehattora yitchazir Adonai deihu bina teshuva, 6 tashuv legabbe Adonai, deihu ovada divreshit. veihi 32 elohim. veyishtelim yedod uva yehe lechon nayycha mikkolla, uvah shavat vayyinnafash.

Uvah yitkelil 20, uvegin da vaychullu: shelimu decholla. bah, itbere kol alma, vealah kayymin shemaya veara veyamma vechol biryayn deitberun, dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram, baAdonai beraam. veim hi itrachakat mealma afillu riga, kolla itcharev veitbatel, vela havi kiuma bealma.

Hay Adonai la tezil miggufa, uvah kayyma vechad hi tezil minneh, hu sam hammavt tete vetishre aleh, detitkere tumea, nevela, pesula, malach hammavt, choshech, afella, vesharya al gufa debar nash. uvehahu zimna itkere bar nash met. veraza demilla, (yechezkel 18:32) ki lo echpotz bemot hammet neum Adonai elohim vehashivu vichyu.

Kol pikudin daase, dahavo atidin lesharya bermch evarin dileh, kullehu mitabbelin aleh. veraza demilla, (Yeshayahu 57:18) derachav raiti veerpaehu vegomer. velaavelav. may velaavelav. illen 248 evarin, deka mitabbelin aleh, deinnun diyyukena illaa desharya al resheh, devah sharya havaya. dichma deit (vayyishlach 165, Shemot 106 amud bet) diyyukena tava al tzaddik, umanhig leh lechol ovadin tavin, lezakkaa leh lealma deate. kach it diyyukena bisha, al resha dechayyayvayya, leanhaga lon beovadin bishin, deyartun gehinnam. uvegin da it hevel veit hevel, it hevel tav, deittemar beh, (Devarim 8:3) ki al kol motztza fi Adonai yichye haadam. veit hevel bish, deittemar beh (Kohelet 2:26) gam ze hevel ureut ruach.

Veta chaze beovadin debar nash ishtemoda partztzufa, deihi aleh, ufartztzufa deanpoy. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 3:9) hakkarat penehem anta bam. bediyyukena, ishtemoda partztzufa dechayya desharya aleh, im hu aryi, o shor o nesher, o adam. mehammerkava dekudesha berich hu ushechinteh. o mehammerkava demalach sar happanim. o mehammerkava bisha desamael. o mehammerkava dearba yesodin dealma. velet behon la hayitztzer tov, vela hayitztzer hara, ella kivirin dealma. uvegin da kama havalim it bivne nasha, kol chad lemineh. veraza demilla, (Bereshit 1:24) totztze haaretz nefesh chayya leminah. uvegin da, bemmidda sheadam moded bah moddin lo. uvechol partztzufa it memana aleh.

Ta chazi, leshit yome bereshit, lechol chad it leh partztzufeh, dehahu darga deanhig leh, vela tishkach yom delet beh tov. veaf al gav divyoma tinyayna la it beh tov, beyoma telitaa tishkach leh. uvegin da ittemar beh tere zimne tov.

Vechol yoma it leh gader millevar, dela yiul kol bar nash lehahu tov. kegon choshech dechasse linhora. detishkach beyoma kadmaa or, vetishkach beh choshech. bechol yoma tishkach netira. veinnun netirin innun, kegon kotztzim lakkerem. veit netirin acharanin, kegon nechashim veakrabbim userafim, venatrin hahu tov, dela yiul tamman delav ihu rauy lemeal. vei lav, kol chayyayvayya havo alin berazin deorayyta.

Uvegin da man deihu chayayva, veyiul leminda razin deorayyta, kama malache chabbala deitkeriu choshech vaafela, nechashim veakrabbim chevat bara itkeriu, umevalbelin machashavteh, dela yiul laatar delav dileh.

Aval man deihu tov, kol illen netirin innun lememreh, vekategor neesa sanegor, veyialun (leh) letov haganuz, veyemrun leh marana, ha bar nash tov vetztzaddik yere shamayim, bae leaala kodamach, amar lanu, (Tehillim 118:19) pitchu li shaare tzedek avo vam ode yah. hahu tov haganuz yimma lon, pitchu leh behay tara deitkere ahava, o behay tara deihi teshuva. kol tzaddik yiul kefum darga dileh, veraza demilla (Yeshayahu 26:2) pitchu shearim veyavo goy tzaddik vegomer.

Kean tzarich leahaddera al petach hatteshuva. vechi mikkamma minin ihu teshuva deavdin bene nasha, kullehu tavin, aval lav kol appayay shavin. it bar nash deihu rasha gamur kol yamav, veihu over al kama pikudin dela taase, umitcharet umode alayyhu, ulevatar ken la aved la tav vela bish. leda vadday yimchol leh kudesha berich hu, aval la deyizke litshuva illaa. it bar nash levatar deyetuv mechataav, umitkapper leh, ihu azil bederech mitztzeva, umitassek bechol kocho bidchilu urechimu dekudesha berich hu. da zache litshuva tattaa, deitkere Adonai. veda ihu teshuva tattaa.

Veit bar nash levatar demitcharet mechovoy, veyavid teshuva, veyitasak beorayyta bidchilu urechimu dekudesha berich hu, vela al menat lekabbel peras. da zache leat 6, veihu ben yah, veal shemeh itkere bina, veda garim detashuv 6 legabbe Adonai. umillat teshuva kach hi, tashuv 6 laAdonai.

Uleolam la sharya Adonai bevar nash, velo 6, bela dechilu uvela rechimu, deinnun yah, yira veahava karenan leh vadday. umittamman ityeyhivu hattora vehammitztzeva deinnun ben uvat. uvegin deyisrael mekayyeymin hattora vehammitztzeva, itkeriu banim lekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem.

Hannistarot: yira veahava, deinnun bemocha velibba. bachalala degufa. uveresha. vehanniglot: hattora vehammitztzeva, deinnun begufa uveresha levar. veraza demilla hachi hu vadday, dei bar nash dachil lekudesha berich hu, o rachim leh, da la yada bar nash achara, begin deihu milla dela itgalya ella beno leven kono.

Aval bar nash demitasak beorayyta, veazil befikkudin daase, da itgalya lechol bar nash, begin dekudesha berich hu aved leh puma beitgalya, leitasseka beorayyta, veayynin leistakkela bah, veudenin lemishma bah. veavid kudesha berich hu bebar nash, yedin veraglin vegufa, lemebad behon pikudin dease.

Im ken chotama lemay nafka minneh. (Bereshit 2:7) vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim, da ihi diyyukena deal bar nash, deittemar beh (Bereshit 28:12) vayachalom vehinne sullam. sullam vadday ihi nishmat chayyim, kurseyay leshem Adonai deihu hayyira vehaahava hattora vehammitztzeva uva sharya, vehay kurseyay, minnah gezurot kol nishmatin deyisrael, veihi diyyukena al resha debar nash.

Vehinne malache elohim olim veyordim bo. illen havalim desallekin venafkin begufa, behay sullam. ihu chad, sheviaa decholla. veihu mutztzav artztza, teren. verosho maggia hashshamayma, telat. vehinne malache elohim olim, tere. veyordim tere. innun lokovel 4 ruchot vehashshamayim vehaaretz. veraza, demilla (Kohelet 1:2) havel havalim amar kohelet havel havalim hakkol havel. innun shiva, lokovel kuresyay, deihu hassullam, vehashshamayim vehaaretz, ved yesodin dealma, veinnun shiva. lokovel shiva yome bereshit. it kol biryayn dishmayya, veyamma, veara. kegon chayot ofot behemot dagim, vechamma toladin detalyayn minneh.

Uvegin decholla itbere behay tzulema, deal kol yisrael deihi tzaddik, ittemar behon (Bereshit 9:2) umoraachem vechittechem yihye al kol chayyat haaretz veal kol of hashshamayim vegomer. veda memallel al bene nasha, deinnun metilin lechevan bara, veliviran, uleofin, ulenune yamma. deit bar nash demazzaleh shor, umazzaleh aryi, umazzaleh nesher, umazzaleh adam.

Vechol illen, lamma mitpachadin mehay diyyukena deinnun mittamman itberiu. ella mishshum deshem Adonai sharya aleh. raza demilla, (Devarim 28:10) verau kol amme haaretz vegomer. vechol man defagim ovadoy, itpegim diyyukeneh. veshem Adonai la sharya baatar pagim, uvehahu pegimu sharya choshech, begin pegimu desihara desharya beh chashocha. vehay bar nash kema deihu pagim diyyukeneh, kach itpegim ihu letatta, o itavid illem, o cheresh, o suma, o chigger. begin diyyehe rashim leella vetatta.

Vehahu choshech sharya bifgimu dileh, umiyyad ishtemodan beh dargin kaddishin, deinnun cheloy dekudesha berich hu, umitrachakin minneh, dichvar yadin divhahu pegimu la sharya malka. uvegin da cheloy demalka mitrachakin minneh, dechayyaylin demalka la sharyayn, vela mitkarvan, ella beatar demalka sharya, dechach innun mitnahagin abbatreh, keevarin batar gufa.

Uvehahu atar deshare hahu choshech, kama malache chabbala, deitkeriu nechashim veakrabbim, mitkarvin leh, veyahavin leh kama neshichin, veillen innun yissurin. vei it leh mamona deovadin tavin deavid, itmaatun minneh. veech itmaatun minneh, ella kol zechut denachit leh milella, yahiv leh leillen malache chabbala, uvatlin minneh yisurin. vei leh leh zechu, vela chova leella, ella kolla letatta, bechol zechu deavid nachit leh mamonin, veumin dealma mitkarvin leh, lokovel malache chabbala, veyahiv lon mamona, veishteziv minnayyhu.

Uvegin da havo yisrael mekarvin laazazil, legabbe hahu choshech. veshivim parim, lokovel shivim umin, lekayyeyma kera, (Mishlei 25:21) im raev sonaacha haachilehu lachem veim tzame hashekehu mayim. umiyyad dehadrin betiyyuveta, itabbar hahu choshech mehahu pegimu, veyishtelim. veraza demilla, (Shmuel b 12:13) gam Adonai heevir chatatcha lo tamut. umiyyad ithaddar beh shema daAdonai, veitterae (nusach acher vaytarepay) beh, meinnun neshichin deyisurin, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 6:10) veshav verafa lo. uminnayin deithaddar kudesha berich hu miyyad dehadar betiyyuveta veishtelim hahu pegimu. hada hu dichtiv, (Malachi 3:7) shuvu elay veashuva alechem.

Veda ihu bitshuva gemura, degarim leahaddera bina deihu 20, legabbe Adonai deihi malchut. deazla menaddeda min kinaha, deihi hahi diyyukena, demitkatrin bah kol pikudin. uvah mitkatrin eser sefiran. kad bar nash aved pikkuda chada vela yattir, veavid lah bidchilu urechimu dekudesha berich hu. beginah sharyayn aleh 10 sefiran. vechol man dekiyyem pikkuda chad kadka yaut, keillu mekayyem 248 pikkudin daase, delet pikkuda delav ihu kelila mikkullehu 248. (ad kan raya mehemana).
Zohar, Nasso 5: (Bamidbar Adonai:12) ish ish ki tiste ishto vegomer. may hay legabbe hay. ella kema dichtiv, (Bamidbar Adonai:12) limol maal baAdonai. ribbi elazar amar, ish ish, may ish ish, deha bechad sagge, ella ha okmuha, aval ish ish, mashma ish deihu ish, vekiyyem kera dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:15) shete mayim mibborecha vegomer. keden hu ish bealma, ish legabbe itteteh. umaala vo maal, ha bechad sagge, amay tere. ella chad leella vechad letatta. chad likkeneset yisrael, vechad levalah. begin kach vehevi haish et ishto.

Amay el hakkohen. raza demilla, begin dechahana shushevina ihu dematronita. hacha it leistakkela, ha ketiv (Vayikra 1:Adonai) veshachat et ben habbakar, veshachat achara, velav kahana, dechahana asir leh bedina, begin dela yafgim hahu atar deachid beh, veat amrat, vehevi haish et ishto el hakkohen, lemedan dinaha. ella vadday kahana leda chaze, begin deihu shushevina lematronita, vechol neshe alma mitbarchan (nusach acher itachadat) bikkeneset yisrael, veal da itteta diltatta mitbarcha besheva berachot, daachidat bah bichneset yisrael, vechahana kaim leatkena mille dematronita, uleayyeyna bechol ma deitzterich, begin kach kahana leda, vela achara.

Vei tema deihu avid dina, lav hachi, ella leasgaa shelama bealma ka ishtaddal behay, uleasgaa chesed. dei hahi itteta ishtechachat zakkaa, kahana asge shelama behu, velo od ella demitabbera bivra dechar, veitavid shelama al yedeh. vei la ishtechachat zakkaa, ihu la avid dina, ella hahu shema kaddisha deihi ka meshakkerat beh, hu avid dina, vehu badik lah.

Ta chaze, kahana la ayel garmeh lehay, ella kad hi yahavat garmah kammeh, mippea (nusach acher lezakkaa) zimna, uteren shail lah, kevan deihi baya leishtakkecha zakkaa, keden kahana avid ovada, begin leasgaa shelama.

Kahana ketiv shema kaddisha chad zimna beorach meshar, levatar katav leh lemafrea atvavn (nusach acher sareyteyn) terisin bithirin, dina bedina, rachame berachame, rachame bedina, vedina berachame. ishtechachat zakkaa, atvavn rachame ishtechachu, vedinin sallekin. la ishtechachat kaddeka yaut, rachame sallekin, vedinin ishtearu, ucheden dina itavid.

Ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Shemot 15:23) vayavou marata velo yachlu lishtot mayim mimmara ki marim hem, ha ukemuha. amar, tavvavhna ech bene alma la mistakkelin vela mishtaddelin bemillin deorayyta, hacha it leistakkela, amay ketiv hacha sham sam lo chok umishpat vesham nissahu.

Aval vadday raza demilla, dehacha al mayyay hava, begin demitzrae havo amre, divnayyhu deyisrael havo minnayyhu, vahavu kama beyisrael dechashdin leintetayyhu beda. ad dekudesha berich hu mata lon lehay atar, uvae lemivdak lon, ma ketiv vayavou marata vegomer. veyitzak el Adonai vegomer.

Amar kudesha berich hu lemoshe, moshe ma at bae, ha kama chavilin kayymin gabbayychu hacha, vaana baena lemivdak hacha neshehon deyisrael, ketov shema kaddisha, ureme lemayyay, veyibbadkun kullehon, neshe veguverin, vela yishtear laaz al banay. vead deyibbadkun kullehu hacha, la ashre shemi alayyhu, miyyad vayyorehu Adonai etz vayyashlech el hammayim, da shema kaddisha, hahu dehava kotev kahana lemivdak neshehon deyisrael, keden, sham sam lo chok umishpat vesham nissahu.

Vei tema neshehon deyisrael yaut, innun amay. ella uf innun bayayn, dela istaavu binshehon demitzrae. uneshehon deyisrael la istaavu bemitzrae, kol innun shenin dahavo benayyhu, vechullehu nafku guverin venukevin zakkain, veishtechachu zara deyisrael kaddishin, zakkain, keden kudesha berich hu ashre shemeh benayyhu, veal da al mayya vadday, sham sam lo chok umishpat vesham nissahu uf hacha, bemayya badik kahana leitteta, uvishma kaddisha.

(Bamidbar Adonai:17) umin heafar asher yihye bekarka hammishkan. man heafar. ha tanenan, ketiv (Kohelet 3:20) hakkol haya min heafar vehakkol shav el heafar hakkol haya min heafar, afillu galgal chamma, kol shekken bar nash deishtechachu minneh.

Amar ribbi yose, illu ketiv umin heafar vela yattir, havina amar hachi. aval kevan dichtiv umin heafar asher yihye bekarka hammishkan, mashma deachara hu. ella ketiv (Yeshayahu 41:2) yitten keafar charbo, illen marehon dekistin uvalisterain, mare dedina kashya. mashma dichtiv bekarka hammishkan, daachidan letatta. veal da yikkach hakkohen venatan el hammayim.
Me hammarim hamearrim, illen me yamma, deinnun meririn. may hu. da shema kadisha, beshaata deishtechach bedina, keden ikrun me hammarim hamearrim. uvegin kach mayya deyamma diltatta kullehon meririn.

Ta chaze, hay yamma kadisha kama naharin metikin alin begavvav, uvegin deihi dina dealma, memoy meriran, begin deachid bah mota lechol bene alma. veaf al gav deinnun meriran, kad mitpashshetin metikin innun. lezimnin mayin deyamma meriran. lezimnin yamma devala lechol shear memin, veikre yamma dekafa, uvala kol innun acharanin, veshaiv lon begavivy, vela nigarin levar. lezimnin sharan mayyay, venagdin mehahu yamma, kol ma denagid letattae. uvechamma gevavnin kayyeyma hay yamma. hammayim hamearrim, beshaata deate chivya veatil zuhama, keden hammayim hamearrim veal da kahana avid ovada letatta, veome omaa, veitavid dina.

Ta chaze, i itteta ishtechachat zachyyayta, illen mayin alin begavvav, veithappechan metikan, venakan garmah, vekayymin begavvav, ad demitabbera. kevan demitabbera, havo meshappere beshafire leubbara dimaha, venafik bera shappira, naki bela muma dealma. vei lav, innun mayin ayylin begavvav, vearcha recha dezuhama, veinnun mayin mithappechin lechivya bimaha, bema dekilkela itpesat, veitchazze kelana lecholla, veha ukemuha chavrayyay.
Ta chaze, kol innun neshe alma, beatrayyhu kayyme veitdanu, veal da hahu atar mammash deinhu kayyme, beh itdanu. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu itree behu, uvae ledakkea lehu.

Ribbi chizkiyya patach, (Tehillim 128:3) eshtecha kegefen poriyya vegomer, ma gefen la mekabbel aleh ella middideh, kach itteta deyisrael, kayyeyma behay gavvna, dela mekabbela alah ella hahu bar zugah. keshappenina (nusach acher ketora) da, dela mekabbela ella hahu bar zugah. veal da kegefen poriyya beyarkete vetecha. mahu poriyya. kema deat amer (Devarim 29:17) pore rosh. poriyya: porachat, deappikat anafim lechol sitra. vean. beyarkete vetecha, velav levar beshuka, begin dela tete leshakkera bivrit illaa.
Ushelomo amar, (Mishlei 2:17) haozevet alluf neureha veet berit eloheha shachecha. man berit eloheha. hahu atar deikre berit. vehi itkashshera beh, begin kach beyarkete vetecha.

Amar ribbi chizkiyya, tuneva lete al hahu bar nash, deshavak leinteteh detitchaze misaara deresha levar. veda hu chad meinnun tzeniuta deveta. veitteta daappikat misaara deresha levar, leittakkena beh, garim miskenuta leveta. vegarim livnaha dela yitchashshevun bedara. vegarim milla achara desharya beveta. man garim da. hahu saara deitchaze mereshah levar. uma beveta hay, kol shekken beshuka, vekol shekken chatzifuta achara. uvegin kach eshtecha kegefen poriyya beyarkete vetecha.
Amar ribbi yehuda, saara deresha deitteta deitgalyay, garim saara achara leitgalyay, uleafgema lah. begin kach, baya itteta deafillu tesire deveta, la yechomun saara chad meresha, kol shekken levar.

Ta chaze, kema bidchura saara hu chumera decholla, hachi name lenukeba. pok chame, kama pegimu garim hahu saara deitteta. garim leella, garim letatta, garim levalah deitlatteyay, garim miskenuta, garim milla achara beveta, garim deyistelik chashivuta mibbenaha. rachamana lishezvun, mechatzifu dilhon.

Veal da, baya itteta leitkasseyay, bezivote deveta. vei avdat ken ma ketiv, (Tehillim 128:3) banecha kishtile zetim. mahu kishtile zetim. ma zayit da, ben besitvav, ben bekayyta, la itavidu tarpoy, vetadir ishtechach beh chashivut yatir al shear ilanin. kach benaha yistallekun bachashivu al shear bene alma. velo od ella devalah mitbarech becholla, bevirchan dilella, bevirchan diltatta, beutera, bivnin, bivne benin. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 128:4) hinne ki chen yevorach gaver yere Adonai. uchetiv (Tehillim 128:5-6) yevarechcha Adonai mitztziyyon uree betuv yerushalayim kol yeme chayyecha uree banim levanecha shalom al yisrael. (yisrael sava kaddisha)

Raya mehemna eliyyahu, kum aftach ammi befikkudin, deant hu ozir li, bechol sitra. deha alach ittemar bekadmita, pinchas ben elazar ben aharon hakkohen. uven aharon vadday ihu ach dili, (Mishlei 17:17) ach letztzara yivvaled.

Patach veamar, pikkuda ladun bedine sota, hada hu dichtiv veavar alav ruach kina vekinne vegomer. vadday ruach tumea mitteren sitrin ishtechach, chad beshikra, vechad bikshot. begin da, beruach shikra vekinne et ishto, vehi lo nitmaa. vetanena, veavar alav vegomer, vekinne et ishto vehi nitmaa.

Vechi it kusheta beruach misava. ella bevar nash missitra deilana detov vara, tamman yetztzer hara, nachash. bezimna deit lebar nash itteta shappira, bechol ovadin tavin, deittemar bah (Mishlei 12:4) eshet chayil ateret balah. yitztzer hara it leh kina, kegavvna deashkachna dekanne adam al inteteh, ad defatte lah, vegaram lah mita. ulezimnin shallit alah bechovin, umesaav lah, veha itavidat nevela.

Veyitztzer hara, missitra dimina, dileh, darga deyishmael, itkere nachash. umissitra dismala, dargeh deesav samael, itkere kelev, memana degehinnam detztzooach hav hav, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 30:15) laaluka shete vanot hav hav, uviruta dileh lemechal nishmeta misava, benura dileh, gehinnam. veavar alav ruach kina vekinne et ishto bikshot, vehi nitmaa.

Uveginah ittemar, (Vayikra 21:9) uvat ish kohen, da michael, ki techel liznot et aviha hi mechallelet baesh tissaref. vetamman ittokdat hahi zuhama, veitlabbenat ihi minneh, kakkesef deitlabban benura, vehahi oferet dezuhama ittokad, veitavid afar, veitavid.

Kegavvna da beyisrael, kad innun mechallelin orayyta, kudesha berich hu yeul lon begaluta divne esav uvene yishmael, techot shibuda dilhon, dedargayyhu kelev venachash, veittedanu tamman, uvehon yitbarru veyitlabbenu veyitztzorfu kitztzerof hakkesef vechivchon hazzahav, hada hu dichtiv, (zecharya 13:9) utztzeraftim kitztzerof et hakkesef uvechantim kivchon et hazzahav, ad deyitkayyem behu, (Yeshayahu 1:18) im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu.

Veilana detov vara, begineh ittemar, (Shemot 15:25) vayyorehu Adonai etz vayyashlech el hammayim vayyimteku hammayim vegomer. begin dahavo yisrael im erev rav, kullehu havo ilana detov vara, veal da, chetztzeyo matok missitra dimina. vechetztzeyo mar, missitra dismala. uvezimna deerev rav havo machatiin lon leyisrael, havi keillu havo kullehu missitra dera. umaya ithadra kullehu meririn, kehahu etz mar bemayya, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 15:23) vayavou marata velo yachlu lishtot mayim mimmara ki marim hem.

Vehay etz mar, ihu kegavvna denisyona desota, i satat techot balah, innun mayin deashkeyyayn lah ithadaru meririn, uvehon vetztzavta vitnah venafla yerechah, vei la satat ma ketiv, venikketa venizrea zara, veolidat bar. uf hacha vayimteku hammayim.

Kegavvna da, yitavid lenassea lon leyisrael befurekana batrayyta, hada hu dichtiv, (Daniel 12:10) yitbarru veyitlabbenu veyitztzarfu rabbim, deinnun missitra detov, vekayymin benisyona. vehirshiu reshaim innun missitra dera, veyitkayyem behon (yechezkel 13:9) veel admat yisrael lo yavou vekatil lon.
Zohar, Nasso 5:60-89: (Bamidbar Adonai:12) ish ish ki tiste ishto vegomer. may hay legabbe hay. ella kema dichtiv, (Bamidbar Adonai:12) limol maal baAdonai. ribbi elazar amar, ish ish, may ish ish, deha bechad sagge, ella ha okmuha, aval ish ish, mashma ish deihu ish, vekiyyem kera dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:15) shete mayim mibborecha vegomer. keden hu ish bealma, ish legabbe itteteh. umaala vo maal, ha bechad sagge, amay tere. ella chad leella vechad letatta. chad likkeneset yisrael, vechad levalah. begin kach vehevi haish et ishto.

Amay el hakkohen. raza demilla, begin dechahana shushevina ihu dematronita. hacha it leistakkela, ha ketiv (Vayikra 1:Adonai) veshachat et ben habbakar, veshachat achara, velav kahana, dechahana asir leh bedina, begin dela yafgim hahu atar deachid beh, veat amrat, vehevi haish et ishto el hakkohen, lemedan dinaha. ella vadday kahana leda chaze, begin deihu shushevina lematronita, vechol neshe alma mitbarchan (nusach acher itachadat) bikkeneset yisrael, veal da itteta diltatta mitbarcha besheva berachot, daachidat bah bichneset yisrael, vechahana kaim leatkena mille dematronita, uleayyeyna bechol ma deitzterich, begin kach kahana leda, vela achara.

Vei tema deihu avid dina, lav hachi, ella leasgaa shelama bealma ka ishtaddal behay, uleasgaa chesed. dei hahi itteta ishtechachat zakkaa, kahana asge shelama behu, velo od ella demitabbera bivra dechar, veitavid shelama al yedeh. vei la ishtechachat zakkaa, ihu la avid dina, ella hahu shema kaddisha deihi ka meshakkerat beh, hu avid dina, vehu badik lah.

Ta chaze, kahana la ayel garmeh lehay, ella kad hi yahavat garmah kammeh, mippea (nusach acher lezakkaa) zimna, uteren shail lah, kevan deihi baya leishtakkecha zakkaa, keden kahana avid ovada, begin leasgaa shelama.

Kahana ketiv shema kaddisha chad zimna beorach meshar, levatar katav leh lemafrea atvavn (nusach acher sareyteyn) terisin bithirin, dina bedina, rachame berachame, rachame bedina, vedina berachame. ishtechachat zakkaa, atvavn rachame ishtechachu, vedinin sallekin. la ishtechachat kaddeka yaut, rachame sallekin, vedinin ishtearu, ucheden dina itavid.

Ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Shemot 15:23) vayavou marata velo yachlu lishtot mayim mimmara ki marim hem, ha ukemuha. amar, tavvavhna ech bene alma la mistakkelin vela mishtaddelin bemillin deorayyta, hacha it leistakkela, amay ketiv hacha sham sam lo chok umishpat vesham nissahu.

Aval vadday raza demilla, dehacha al mayyay hava, begin demitzrae havo amre, divnayyhu deyisrael havo minnayyhu, vahavu kama beyisrael dechashdin leintetayyhu beda. ad dekudesha berich hu mata lon lehay atar, uvae lemivdak lon, ma ketiv vayavou marata vegomer. veyitzak el Adonai vegomer.

Amar kudesha berich hu lemoshe, moshe ma at bae, ha kama chavilin kayymin gabbayychu hacha, vaana baena lemivdak hacha neshehon deyisrael, ketov shema kaddisha, ureme lemayyay, veyibbadkun kullehon, neshe veguverin, vela yishtear laaz al banay. vead deyibbadkun kullehu hacha, la ashre shemi alayyhu, miyyad vayyorehu Adonai etz vayyashlech el hammayim, da shema kaddisha, hahu dehava kotev kahana lemivdak neshehon deyisrael, keden, sham sam lo chok umishpat vesham nissahu.

Vei tema neshehon deyisrael yaut, innun amay. ella uf innun bayayn, dela istaavu binshehon demitzrae. uneshehon deyisrael la istaavu bemitzrae, kol innun shenin dahavo benayyhu, vechullehu nafku guverin venukevin zakkain, veishtechachu zara deyisrael kaddishin, zakkain, keden kudesha berich hu ashre shemeh benayyhu, veal da al mayya vadday, sham sam lo chok umishpat vesham nissahu uf hacha, bemayya badik kahana leitteta, uvishma kaddisha.

(Bamidbar Adonai:17) umin heafar asher yihye bekarka hammishkan. man heafar. ha tanenan, ketiv (Kohelet 3:20) hakkol haya min heafar vehakkol shav el heafar hakkol haya min heafar, afillu galgal chamma, kol shekken bar nash deishtechachu minneh.

Amar ribbi yose, illu ketiv umin heafar vela yattir, havina amar hachi. aval kevan dichtiv umin heafar asher yihye bekarka hammishkan, mashma deachara hu. ella ketiv (Yeshayahu 41:2) yitten keafar charbo, illen marehon dekistin uvalisterain, mare dedina kashya. mashma dichtiv bekarka hammishkan, daachidan letatta. veal da yikkach hakkohen venatan el hammayim.
Me hammarim hamearrim, illen me yamma, deinnun meririn. may hu. da shema kadisha, beshaata deishtechach bedina, keden ikrun me hammarim hamearrim. uvegin kach mayya deyamma diltatta kullehon meririn.

Ta chaze, hay yamma kadisha kama naharin metikin alin begavvav, uvegin deihi dina dealma, memoy meriran, begin deachid bah mota lechol bene alma. veaf al gav deinnun meriran, kad mitpashshetin metikin innun. lezimnin mayin deyamma meriran. lezimnin yamma devala lechol shear memin, veikre yamma dekafa, uvala kol innun acharanin, veshaiv lon begavivy, vela nigarin levar. lezimnin sharan mayyay, venagdin mehahu yamma, kol ma denagid letattae. uvechamma gevavnin kayyeyma hay yamma. hammayim hamearrim, beshaata deate chivya veatil zuhama, keden hammayim hamearrim veal da kahana avid ovada letatta, veome omaa, veitavid dina.

Ta chaze, i itteta ishtechachat zachyyayta, illen mayin alin begavvav, veithappechan metikan, venakan garmah, vekayymin begavvav, ad demitabbera. kevan demitabbera, havo meshappere beshafire leubbara dimaha, venafik bera shappira, naki bela muma dealma. vei lav, innun mayin ayylin begavvav, vearcha recha dezuhama, veinnun mayin mithappechin lechivya bimaha, bema dekilkela itpesat, veitchazze kelana lecholla, veha ukemuha chavrayyay.
Ta chaze, kol innun neshe alma, beatrayyhu kayyme veitdanu, veal da hahu atar mammash deinhu kayyme, beh itdanu. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu itree behu, uvae ledakkea lehu.

Ribbi chizkiyya patach, (Tehillim 128:3) eshtecha kegefen poriyya vegomer, ma gefen la mekabbel aleh ella middideh, kach itteta deyisrael, kayyeyma behay gavvna, dela mekabbela alah ella hahu bar zugah. keshappenina (nusach acher ketora) da, dela mekabbela ella hahu bar zugah. veal da kegefen poriyya beyarkete vetecha. mahu poriyya. kema deat amer (Devarim 29:17) pore rosh. poriyya: porachat, deappikat anafim lechol sitra. vean. beyarkete vetecha, velav levar beshuka, begin dela tete leshakkera bivrit illaa.
Ushelomo amar, (Mishlei 2:17) haozevet alluf neureha veet berit eloheha shachecha. man berit eloheha. hahu atar deikre berit. vehi itkashshera beh, begin kach beyarkete vetecha.

Amar ribbi chizkiyya, tuneva lete al hahu bar nash, deshavak leinteteh detitchaze misaara deresha levar. veda hu chad meinnun tzeniuta deveta. veitteta daappikat misaara deresha levar, leittakkena beh, garim miskenuta leveta. vegarim livnaha dela yitchashshevun bedara. vegarim milla achara desharya beveta. man garim da. hahu saara deitchaze mereshah levar. uma beveta hay, kol shekken beshuka, vekol shekken chatzifuta achara. uvegin kach eshtecha kegefen poriyya beyarkete vetecha.
Amar ribbi yehuda, saara deresha deitteta deitgalyay, garim saara achara leitgalyay, uleafgema lah. begin kach, baya itteta deafillu tesire deveta, la yechomun saara chad meresha, kol shekken levar.

Ta chaze, kema bidchura saara hu chumera decholla, hachi name lenukeba. pok chame, kama pegimu garim hahu saara deitteta. garim leella, garim letatta, garim levalah deitlatteyay, garim miskenuta, garim milla achara beveta, garim deyistelik chashivuta mibbenaha. rachamana lishezvun, mechatzifu dilhon.

Veal da, baya itteta leitkasseyay, bezivote deveta. vei avdat ken ma ketiv, (Tehillim 128:3) banecha kishtile zetim. mahu kishtile zetim. ma zayit da, ben besitvav, ben bekayyta, la itavidu tarpoy, vetadir ishtechach beh chashivut yatir al shear ilanin. kach benaha yistallekun bachashivu al shear bene alma. velo od ella devalah mitbarech becholla, bevirchan dilella, bevirchan diltatta, beutera, bivnin, bivne benin. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 128:4) hinne ki chen yevorach gaver yere Adonai. uchetiv (Tehillim 128:5-6) yevarechcha Adonai mitztziyyon uree betuv yerushalayim kol yeme chayyecha uree banim levanecha shalom al yisrael. (yisrael sava kaddisha)

Raya mehemna eliyyahu, kum aftach ammi befikkudin, deant hu ozir li, bechol sitra. deha alach ittemar bekadmita, pinchas ben elazar ben aharon hakkohen. uven aharon vadday ihu ach dili, (Mishlei 17:17) ach letztzara yivvaled.

Patach veamar, pikkuda ladun bedine sota, hada hu dichtiv veavar alav ruach kina vekinne vegomer. vadday ruach tumea mitteren sitrin ishtechach, chad beshikra, vechad bikshot. begin da, beruach shikra vekinne et ishto, vehi lo nitmaa. vetanena, veavar alav vegomer, vekinne et ishto vehi nitmaa.

Vechi it kusheta beruach misava. ella bevar nash missitra deilana detov vara, tamman yetztzer hara, nachash. bezimna deit lebar nash itteta shappira, bechol ovadin tavin, deittemar bah (Mishlei 12:4) eshet chayil ateret balah. yitztzer hara it leh kina, kegavvna deashkachna dekanne adam al inteteh, ad defatte lah, vegaram lah mita. ulezimnin shallit alah bechovin, umesaav lah, veha itavidat nevela.

Veyitztzer hara, missitra dimina, dileh, darga deyishmael, itkere nachash. umissitra dismala, dargeh deesav samael, itkere kelev, memana degehinnam detztzooach hav hav, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 30:15) laaluka shete vanot hav hav, uviruta dileh lemechal nishmeta misava, benura dileh, gehinnam. veavar alav ruach kina vekinne et ishto bikshot, vehi nitmaa.

Uveginah ittemar, (Vayikra 21:9) uvat ish kohen, da michael, ki techel liznot et aviha hi mechallelet baesh tissaref. vetamman ittokdat hahi zuhama, veitlabbenat ihi minneh, kakkesef deitlabban benura, vehahi oferet dezuhama ittokad, veitavid afar, veitavid.

Kegavvna da beyisrael, kad innun mechallelin orayyta, kudesha berich hu yeul lon begaluta divne esav uvene yishmael, techot shibuda dilhon, dedargayyhu kelev venachash, veittedanu tamman, uvehon yitbarru veyitlabbenu veyitztzorfu kitztzerof hakkesef vechivchon hazzahav, hada hu dichtiv, (zecharya 13:9) utztzeraftim kitztzerof et hakkesef uvechantim kivchon et hazzahav, ad deyitkayyem behu, (Yeshayahu 1:18) im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu.

Zohar, Terumah 73: Bechullehu sheviaa adif, bar teminaa, deka madbar lechullehu, vekayyeyma al kullehu. ketiv (Tehillim 68:5) sollu larochev baaravot, man rochev baaravot, uman innun aravot. ella, aravot da rekia sheviaa, amay itkere aravot. al deihu kalil meeshsha umaya kachada, umissitra dedarom, umissitra detzafon, veihu meurav mitteren sitrin.

Vei tema, i hachi, shete aravot deka mitchabberan belulav, vetanenan aravot, hada hu dichtiv sollu larochev baaravot. i hachi, man yahiv yarkin begufa, o gufa beyarkin, deha da avid perin veevin, veda (169 amud bet) la avid perin veevin.

Ella, vadday kolla hu raza daaravot devalulav, innun aravot devalulav, chad esh, vechad mayim. beraza da dechullehu, veihu sheviaa ihu esh umayim kalil kachada, beraza chada, uvegin daaravot ihu raza kelala dechullehu shit acharanin, ihu raza dirticha illaa, vekudesha berich hu itree behay rekia, yattir mekullehu rekiin, vetiuveteh tadir leatkena lehahu rekia, bishfiru illaa. veal da, sollu larochev baaravot lehahu derochev baaravot. uman ihu. hahu rakia tamir veganiz, dekayyeyma al gabbe chevata, deihu rochev baaravot.

Veilzu (170 amud bet) lefanav. millefanav la ketiv, ella lefanav, deha let man deyinda beh kelum. aval lefanav, man deayil lekameh dehay rekia, itzterich lemeal bechedva, vela baatzivu kelal, begin dehay rekia garim, detamman la sharya atzivu verugeza kelal, deha tamman kolla ihu bechedva.

Veal da, kohen gadol dekayyeyma lekameh, la hava al leve kudesha, bar bechedva, uleachazaa chedva, deha atra garim. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 100:2) ivdu et Adonai besimcha bou lefanav birnana. deha itzterich dela leachazaa bah atzivu.

Vei tema, i hachi, hay man deihu betzaara uvedochka, dela yachil lemechde libbeh, umiggo dochakeh it leh lemitba rachamin, kame malka illaa, i hachi, la yitzle tzelota kelal, vela yiyiul baatzivu kelal, deha la yachil lemechode libbeh, uleaala kameh bechedva, may tikkuna it leh lehay bar nash.

Ella vadday ha tanenan, kol tarin ninalu veasgiru, vetarin didmain la asgiru, velet dima ella miggo tzaara veatzivu. vechol innun dimmanan al innun tarin, kullehu metabberin gezzizin umanulin, veayylin innun dimin, vehahi tzelota alat kame malka kaddisha.

Keden hahu atar it leh dochaka, mehahu atzivu vedochaka dehahu bar nash, kema deat amer (yeshaya 63) bechol tzaratam lo tzar. tiuveteh dehahu alma illaa, legabbe hay atar, kidchura detiuvete tadir legabbah denukeba. kad malka al legabbe matronita, ashkach lah baatzivu, keden kol ma deihi baat, bidaha itmesar, vehahu bar nash, vehahi tzelota, la ahdar berekanayya, vekudesha berich hu chayyis aleh. zakkaa chulakeh dehahu bar nash, deoshid dimin kame kudesha berich hu, bitzloteh.

Kegavvna da beshabbat, man deyativ betaanita beshabbat, miggo tzareh achze atziva, uveshabbat shalta hahu rekia illaa, hahu deitchaze bechedva, veihu chedva vechadde lecholla. hahu deyativ baatzivu, begin deihu shalta, appik lehahu bar nash mehahu onsha deitgezar aleh, veha ittemar, sollu: havu yekar, verommu lehahu derochev baaravot, deihu chedva vechadde kolla, rekia al gabbe chevata beyah shemo vadday, deha behahu atar shema da itkelil. veilzu lefanav, begin dela itzterich leachazaa kameh atzivu, kema deittemar.

Rabbi elazar amar, hay kera, hachi itzterich lememar, sollu larochev al aravot, may baaravot. beyah shemo, beyah hu mibbae leh, may shemo. ella hay kera, al setima dechol setimin, attika dechol attikin ittemar. hahu dela itgalya, vela ityeda kelal, deihu rochev baaravot. vei tema, deihu atya verachiv beh, i hachi, af al gav desatim hu beatar da kayyeyma leitgalya.

Ella sollu larochev baaravot, da ihu attika dechol attikin, setima dechol setimin, dela yedia. uvamme ihu rochev, baaravot, beyah, deihu raza kadmaa denafik kammeh (davar acher minneh) veda ihu shemeh, mehahu setima, dela yedia, shema (Vayikra 29) dileh hu yah. lav deihu hu, ella ihu hu, begin dehahu parochta (Vayikra 128) deitparsa venafik mikkameh. aval hay parochta ihu shemo, veda ihu reticha dileh, vela ityeda kelal.

Veda ihu shemo haggadol, begin deit shemeh delav ihu kol kach gadol, kehay af al gav deit beh tosefet atvavn. da ihu shema rabba, veal da behay shema, anan mefikin amen, deihu minneh. behay azla amen bechol zimna, uvishma achara lav hachi.

Amen yehe shemeh rabba mevarach, dechad hay shema ittakkan, kolla ihu bishlimu, vechol almin chaddan bechidu. behay shema, kelilan illain vetattain. behay shema, kelilan shit mea utelesar pikkude orayyta, deinnun kelala dechol razin illain vetattain. kelala dealma didchura leella, uchelala dealma denukeba letatta.

Vechullehu pikkudin, kullehu shayyfin veevarin, leitchazaa behu raza dimhemnuta. man dela yashgach vela istakkal berazin defikude orayyta, la yeda, vela istachal, hech metatkenan shayyfin beraza illaa. shayyfin degufa kullehu, mittakkenan al raza defikude orayyta, veaf al gav deit shayyfin, deinnun ravrevin veillain, kullehu zeirin veravrevin, i itnetil chad minnayyhu, afillu zeira devar nash, ikre mareh demuma, kol shekken vekol shekken hahu degara afillu chad pikkuda meinnun pikkude orayyta, deatil muma beatar dela itzterich.

Ta chazi, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 2:15) vayyikkach Adonai elohim et haadam vayyannichehu vegan eden leavdah uleshamrah. vetanenan, leavdah uleshamrah illen karbanin, vecholla chad. aval da raza defikude orayyta, leavdah: illen 248 shayyfin illain. uleshamrah: illen telat mea veshittin vechamesh shayyfin tattain. illen illain dezachor. veillen tattain deshamor, vecholla chad.

Zakkaa ihu man dezache leashlama lon. pikkudin deorayyta, garim levar nash leashlama rucheh venishmateh behay alma, uvealma deate. orayyta mezakka levar nash, leachsena teren almin, alma da vealma deate. kol man deishtaddal beorayyta, ishtedal bachayyim. chayyim behay alma, vechayyim bealma deate. ishteziv mikkol onashin bishin, dela yachlin leshalletaa aleh. i beishtaddeluta hachi. kol shekken man deavid ovada.

Rabbi chiyyay veribbi abba, sharu beve ushepizayyhu, kamu befalgut lelya, leishtaddela beorayyta. berateh deushefiza, kamat veanhirat lon sharga, ulevatar kayyeymat avatrayyhu lemishma millin deorayyta.

ohc: Vehevi haish et ishto vegomer. ad sof kol hainyan. yesh lehair bainyan: 1 ma hi kavvanato bemaamar minchat zikkaron mazkeret avon, lamma hutzrach lezikkaron, uma gam shehammaase eno rachok lehatzerich zikkaron. gam lamma yityaches leminchat seorim shehi mazkeret avon, vahalo roe ani shehu karban mincha chadasha leyisrael mimmochorat happesach. od tzarich ladaat hakkavvana bemaase ze shel mayim kedoshim, ma maasehem shel mayim, velamma nikreu kedoshim, verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (sota 15:, sifre) shennitkavven lomar shekkadshu bichli shehu hakkiyyor, gam laze yesh lehasekil lamma yetzav Adonai al davar ze. gam ma hu peullat hassefer lehashekotah bo, bishlama ma sheasa moshe baegel shehishka et yisrael hu al derech "teyasserech raatech" (Yirmeyahu 2:19). gam lamma min hammikdash. gam dikdek sheyyihye mehammezumman bammikdash (sota sham) velo yachpor, niflaim mimmenni haddevarim. gam amro venatan el hammayim veamru zichronam livracha (sham) shetztzarich sheyyihye heafar tzaf al pene hammayim, verabbanan sovrim sheim hikdim heafar lammayim pasul, ma meakkev davar ze, veroani shello hizkir hakkatuv bemitzva zo chukka listom pi shoel lemor lo tishal. gam amro me hammarim lo yadati lamma yikra lahem marim, verabbotenu zichronam livracha besifre amru: "marim" – nehpachim hammayim lihyot marim, davar acher al shem sofan, memarin et hagguf. uvaggemara (sota 20.) amar avu dishmuel tzarich sheyyitten davar mar letoch hammayim, may tama, dichtiv: "hammarim", shemmarim kevar, ad kan. vehaddevarim temuhim, lamma satam Adonai haddevarim bemitzva zo, nosaf al temihat haddavar bichlaluto.

Veefshar lefaresh hainyan al pi ma shekkadam lanu midia bifnimiyyut hattora, halo hishmaticha befarashat bereshit (Bereshit 2:1) befasuk "vaychullu hashshamayim" vegomer vaychal elohim" vegomer ki chol nivra vehove tichsof vetichle taavato lehiddavek el haelohim chayyim baruch hu, vehergesh teavon ze yeshno gam bevilti noea kol echad kefi shiur haruchaniyyut asher hitbia bo habbore kefi ma shetztzarich lekiyyumo velatet shevach levoro, keamro (Mishlei 16:4) "kol paal Adonai lammaanehu". od matzinu lerazal sheamru (Bereshit Rabba 85) taam shennikreu mayim bochim letzad she pilleg hammayim chetzyam lemala vechetzyam nisharu lematta mittachat layyabbasha, hammayim shennisharu lematta hem bochim umitannechim al shello zachu lehitkarev lelohim chayyim bachatzi haelyon, ki hu ze kosef hannivraim yachad vetikvatam.

Od hen heranu Adonai et asher yachpotz likboa dira battachtonim mime adam, uvecheto nitkallela haadama vegava kisse hammelucha mekor habberacha min haolam (Bereshit Rabba 99), ad et bo devaro beyom mattan tora vayyachshok lemaase yadav ladur battachtonim. veze lecha haot maamaro bammidbar livne yisrael laasot lo mikdash, velo himtin ad boam el eretz noshavet, shehaya nishar zeman muat im lo haya maase hameraggelim. ucheshehitivu avel afillu achar sheyyarda shechina vayyishkon kevodo shanim rabbot, sillek Adonai shechinato veshav limkomo harishon shamayim larum. umeatta zulat hachataim asher yesovvu tihye dirat elohim chayyim battachtonim, uvaze umacha Adonai dimat hammayim habbochim veyusar cherpat haaretz, veyismechu hammayim vetagel haaretz asher errah Adonai verachak mimmenna dod olam, vehinne atta et dodim. veim yesovvu hachataim yashuv haddavar lichmot shehaya veyarum hakkisse, veal ze yidvu haddovim lekol titto mayim. vetzarich lehair ozen belimmudim ellu ki hatavat yisrael kesheamdu al har sinay vehachesharatam haya gam ken rauy lehasherot shechinato yitbarach baaretz umala haaretz dea vedirat Adonai battachtonim kevaelyonim veyitalle mekomenu ze, ki hammaala vehayerida teluya bekarvatam lifne Adonai.

Vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 41,7): cherut mimmalach hammavet vechulei, cherut miyyetzer hara, veal yede avon haegel chazar hakkiur lichmot shehaya vehotzi rosho hassatan, velo hoil hatavatam shel yisrael ella lemakom mugebal toch machanehem, aval kelalut haolam nashammu beyom zaam vechazar kav hammavet laolam. ma sheen ken bazzeman hammekuvve asher yovad kol bechinat hara, keamro (Zecharya 13:2) "veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz", sheaz artzenu tikkare eretz hachayyim ki billa hammavet lanetzach.

Ushemor lecha haddevarim, veal pihem naale bimsillat kavvanat hainyan al nachon, ki yetzav Adonai bekannoot ish ishto ki yivdekenna bemaase ze sheyyevienna el makom asher sham chone haelohim, uchevar hairoticha ki lammakom hahu yikkare "eretz haelyona" letzad sheshshachna sham shechina, veenah bichlal arur asher erra Adonai. gam mayim asher sham lo terad enehem dima, ki lamma yivku velamma yera levavam. vetzivva Adonai sheyyikkach mehammayim hahem kedoshim, yikkaru kedoshim bekarvatam lifne Adonai kadosh venora shemo, uvaze heircha maase hammayim, veen devaray sotrim chas veshalom divre rabbotenu sheamru shehayu mekuddashim bakkiyyor, ella mimma sheddibber Adonai bederech ze nitkavven ledivre gam ken elohim chayyim.

Gam tzivva lakachat min heafar hammikdash davka, letzad shehu karov lakkadosh veelyon baruch hu, vetzivva shello yachpor bedeker ella min heafar hammuchan lifne Adonai belo hefsek binyan, kemaamaram zichronam livracha (sota 15:), letzad heyotam yoter kerovim umargishim behasheraat shechina bahem, ma shehergesh ze eno beafar shehu chutz lammikdash, ki lo taam taam ze ad henna laasot et asher chafetz Adonai asot.

Vetzivva Adonai sheyyitten hammayim techilla veheafar lemala, hattaam kasseder asher hemma baolam. vetimtza shechachamim sheamru sheim hikdim heafar lo asa kelum, amru im hayu meoravim kesherim, vehu hainyan atzmo shehem sedurim mayim veafar, ki yesh chelek shehammayim lematta veheafar lemala veyesh chelek shehammayim etzel heafar, aval afar lematta en dugma zo beseder mayim hachayyim. uler shimon sheamar sham (sota 16.) afillu afar lematta, sover sheen lehakepid ki yesh mayim lemala meheafar, veday sheyyitkaddeshu hammayim bakkeli vezehu chiyyutam leharegish bahergesh hatztzarich lainyan.
Vetzivva Adonai lichtov parashat sota baazkarot shebbah, umochakim kol hakketav bammayim uveafar hahu, vehattaam latet koach bahem laasot maase asher yachpetzu asot.

Vetzivva od sheyyakriv mincha mehasseorim, hattaam dugema lemincha pechuta shehevi kayin bitchillat haolam, veze nisbav mechet adam vechavva, vehu hazekarat avon asher garam bechi lammayim ukelala laadama, vehu maamar minchat zikkaron mazkeret avon, veaz yashke haishsha hammayim. vehinne bevo hammayim hahem bime haishsha bemichuy hashshem betocho, im haishsha temea hinne hashshem hahu al yede hammincha shemmazkeret avon yizkor avon hakkodem veyargishu hammayim, uvaze yihyu marim ki yizkeru yegonam uvechiyyatam vaAdonai macha et dimatam. vehinne haishsha hattemea tesovev maratam uvau vah hammayim hammarim lemarim, yachtechu meeha veyaasu vah nekama, ki zot haishsha haggoremet bechiyyatam, uvechoach hashshem hannatun bahem yinkemu nikmatam mimmenna. vehayyodea chet chavva bezuhamat nachash yeda ki ze hu avon harishon asher heela shechinat or elyon meolam ze hattachton, uchefi ze haim yimtza ish et oyvo vishallechennu, vikayyemu bah habba lehargecha hashekem lehargo, veyaasu nekama bah ben hammayim ben heafar shellishnehem yesh geram raa, vahagam shello hizkir hakkatuv ella mayim yesh bo gam heafar.

Dabber vegomer veamarta vegomer ish ish vegomer. kafal lomar dabber veamarta, gam shinna et leshono, gam kafal lomar ish ish, letzad sheyyesh shete haderagot besotot: achat nekiyya veachat temea. hattemea titzbe bitnah vetippol yerechah vegomer, vehattehora mashbachat venizrea zara. laze amar dibbur vaamira – dibbur lattemea, vaamira rakka lattehora asher yekanne lah balah, ki Adonai yitmoch libbah bayyiudim hanneemarim im lo nitmea haishsha. uletaam ze atzmo kafal lomar "ish ish", vehu al derech amram zichronam livracha (Megila 12:) beamro "umaala vo maal" – im maala bo maal ihu bekare vechulei. umeatta yomar adam im kinne leishto veyodea hu beatzmo sheen bo maal, tihye bedikatah etzlo mimmaasav bimkom hashekaa, veyomar lehachezikah betahara afillu achar kinnuy usetira. laze amar ish ish – ben hayyodea beatzmo ki hu ish tahor ben asher lo tahor, tzarich lahaviah el hakkohen.

Veulay ki laze kivven hakkatuv bechefel dabber veamarta, ben lemi shechoshev shello lehavi mittaam sheyyodea beatzmo shehu tahor, gam kede shello yarea chezkato, veamro veamarta amira rakka lehechafetz baddavar, o lechol echad veechad yeshno bedibbur kashe vaamira rakka: mi sheyyesh bo maal hagam sheyyesh lo dibbur kashe ki tiggale raato vekahal, af al pi chen yesh lo tova leharechiko mimmichshol leval yishkav im temea bitmidut; ulemi shehu naki yesh lo dibbur kashe lehachericho levazzot beishto, veyesh lo amira hassoedet hallev shettinnake haishsha venizrea zera vegomer:

Vayyakrivu hannesiim vegomer. nire ki kullam keechad ratzu lehakeriv beyom rishon lachanukkat hammizbeach, sheratzu sheyyitchannech mikkullam yachad, vaAdonai amar nasi echad layyom vegomer, veamar ki bechol hashshenem asar yamim yechashev chanukkat hammizbeach, velaze achar amro nasi echad vegomer amar paam acheret lachanukkat hammizbeach lomar kemo shekkatavnu. vechan lo amar Adonai lemoshe "kach meittam" kederech sheamar lemala, mashma shello haya tzarich reshut laze, ki vadday sheyyikkach karbanot vechol hammuva bet Adonai zahav vachesef, ella letzad shebbau yachad amar Adonai elav ki yesadderem nasi echad layyom. ella sheraiti lerazal besifre sheamru veze leshonam: maggid shekkeshem shennitnaddevu hannesiim limlechet hammishkan kach nitnaddevu lachanukkat hammizbeach, velo kibbel moshe mehen ad shenneemar lo mippi hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar "yakrivu et karbanam lachanukkat" vegomer, ad kan. razal diyyeku yittur amro yakrivu et karbanam shello haya tzarich lomar, vedarshu shebba lerishshayon, ha lamadta shello kibbel mehem. veyesh lanu lachkor zot, lamma yemaen moshe mikkachat miyyadam nidvat Adonai. veefshar shello ratza lekabbel mehem ad sheyyeda im Adonai chafetz shehem yechannechu hammizbeach o moshe o aharon, uma gam shello raa immahem shevet levi, veayyen bitchillat parashat behaalotcha ma shekkatavnu sham, vehu haddin shehaya mistappek bechol echad sheyyavo lachnoch hammizbeach bekarbano, aval zulat ze bevadday shehaya mekabbel.

Vayyakrivu hannesiim vegomer. amar paam sheniyya vayyakrivu hannesiim, lomar shehem atzmam tarchu bahavaat hannedava ad hammishkan, hagam shehem nesiim lo chashu lichvodam. od yirtze shello heviu hakkarban unetanuhu beyad hammakriv, ella hikrivu otam lifne hammizbeach besamuch lo, lomar ki ellu yakrivu rishona been kodem lahem, uchemo chen yechavven hakkatuv bemaamar vayyakrivu otam lifne hammishkan haamur baagalot, lomar ki hekdesham hu letzarche mishkan laset alehem kerashav vegomer:

rashi: Bakkishor. shekkorin vivyrtoyl belaaz, hammachshir et happelech litvot. falech pushil belaaz:
targum: Yedaha pashta bechuneshira vidaha lavchin mazela:

ohc: Hammakriv bayyom harishon et karbano. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar et karbano? veulay shebba lomar shehevi mishshello velo mishshel hashshevet. uledivrehem zichronam livracha (sifre paysakea moach) sheddiyyeku davar ze mimma shekkafal lomar bechol echad "ze karban nachshon" vegomer "ze karban netanel", melammed sheheviu mishshellahem, taam amro karbano, lefi sheyyesh bo shete bechinot hakerava: 1 hafelagat zechuyyotav vekurvato lifne Adonai kaamur bainyan bedivrehem zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 13,10) niflaim maasav shel nachshon, vehav hakkarban atzmo. laze amar hikriv et karbano, perush, hikriv karban haamur bainyan im karbano hannelam shehu segel maase hattov asher hifli asot. veteda ki im karban haadam yityachadu veyitvaadu kochot hakkedushsha asher subbevu mimmennu vaasher elav. od letzad ki bechinat hakkarban yafil hakeravat anfe hakkedushsha, veheid hakkatuv ki hissiga yad nachshon lehakeriv et karbano, perush hatztzarich lehakeriv minnitzotze hakkedushsha vaanafeha hikriv veyiched yachad kol hatztzarich lehitkarev ulehityached mibbechinato, vehu maamar hammakriv et karbano, veze yaase bechoach uvechavvana bahavaat hakkarban.

Lematte yehuda. velo amar "nasi" kechol haamur bechol hammattot, lomar ki rauy hu nachshon lehakeriv rishon hagam shello haya nasi umaalato mitztzad atzmo, ma sheen ken bechol shear hannesiim ki maalatam hi letzad heyotam nesie hashshevet levad. od yirtze lehafelig mahuto shello haya machshiv atzmo kenasi ella keechad mibbene hashshevet. uletzad shemmatzinu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (tanchuma Bamidbar pasuk 48) shebbikshu lidrosh bishmot hannesiim kol echad kefi maasav, nire ki tzaddik ze shemo gam ken yaggid ki hu ze asher haya yachid shennitnaddev lekaddesh shemo birida layyam, vehu amro nachshon ot nun mitchallefet belamed beotiyyot 493, shehagam shehaya nachshol shel yam gover ben yisrael shennikreu ammi, nadav veyarad layyam, kemaamaram zichronam livracha (sota 37:).

Vechol teruma vegomer lo yihye vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal hakkatuv inyan echad shalosh peamim: vechol teruma vegomer lo yihye, veish et kodashav vegomer, ish asher yitten vegomer. od lamma kafal lomar shalosh peamim lo yihye, verabbotenu zichronam livracha besifre pershu "lo yihye" ba latet habbikkurim shennikreu reshit katteruma hammuvaim bet Adonai sheyyihyu lo lakkohen netunim. "lo yihyu" sheamar befasuk sheni lomar sheim hakkohen hikriv kodashav afillu bemishmara sheenah shello hare hem shello, veamro "vaasher yitten lakkohen lo yihye" im natan lo pidyon bechor beno umet achar sheloshim yom, lakkohen lo yihye velo yachzirem, veharebe derashot kayyotze baze, aval tzerichin anu leyashshev hammikra al pi peshuto.

Venire lefaresh shelosha ketuvim habbaim keechad, shehem melammedim kelalut esrim vearba mattanot asher chalak Adonai lakkohanim, uchetavam rambam beferek 1 mehilchot bikkurim veze leshono: esrim vearba mattanot shennatan lakkohanim nechlakim lachamishsha chalakim, shehem shelosha. ha hem kadashim shezzochim min hammikdash veellu hem: besar chattat, besar asham, shalme tzibbur, motar haomer, sheyare menachot, shete hallechem, lechem happanim, shemen metzora, orot kadashim, chaze vashok shel shelamim, hammuram min hattoda, hammuram meel nazir, bechor behema tehora, vehabbikkurim. hare ellu arba esre mattanot shekkullan tzerichin habbealim lahaviam velittenam lakkohen vechullan kodesh. chaluka 2 hem hatteruma, uterumat maaser, vehachalla. vehag hem hammattanot, vereshit haggez, sede achuzza, pidyon habben, pidyon peter chamor, gezel hagger, vehacharamim, shehem chullin veal hakkohen lechazzer acharehem, ad kan.

Veelle hem divre hakketuvim: keneged chalukka rishona shehem arba esre mattanot sheyyesh bahem shete haderagot, shehem kodesh utzerichin yisrael lahaviam velittenam lakkohen, amar vechol teruma lechol kadshe vene yisrael – hare hizkir alehem shem kodesh, asher yakrivu laAdonai – hare hizkir havaatam shehem yakrivu otam lammakom hammekuddash. ucheneged chaluka sheniyya shehem teruma uterumat maaser vechalla, amar veish et kodashav lo yihyu, hizkir leshon hekdesh lomar ki medabber bammattanot hammekuddashim, velo hizkir bahem hakerava ki hakkohen yechazzer acharehem. ucheneged sheva mattanot amar ish asher yitten lakkohen – lo hizkir shem kedushsha letzad shehem chullin gemurim, vedikdek lomar asher yitten sheen lakkohen zechut bahem ella mishsheat netina kedin hammattanot ad sheyyaggia leyad hammekabbel. veayyen ma shekkatavti behilchot mattenot kehunna (peri toar siman sefer acher). veamar lo yihye sheen hakkohen yachol lemaen shello likkecham kaamur bedivrehem (yore dea 306, 4). umeatta yesh taam nachon bema shechillekam hakkatuv leshalosh haderagot, lomar al kol achat veachat mishshalosh chalukkot "lo yihye", shetztzarich lakachat kol habba lo mehem, velo haya nishma im haya omer al chalukka achat mehem levad.

rashi: Ma yihye mishpat hannaar umaasehu. (targum:) ma chazi lemeevad leulema uma naavid leh:
targum: Vaamar manoach kean yitkaymun pitgamach ma yehe dachaze leravya uma nabed leh:

ohc: Hakkol middabber elav. lefi ma shekkatavnu bimkomot acherim (Shemot 20:1), ki dibbur hayyotze meAdonai haya notzar mimmennu malach vehu hammedabber lannavi, veal pi ze yishshavti kol tevat "lemor" haamur bedibbure Adonai, vehu amro hakkol middabber elav, perush, kolo shel hakkadosh baruch hu medabber lo, vahagam shehatteva degusha kemo mitdabber, letzad shehakkol hu atzmo haddibbur yutzdak leamer keseder ze, vehammaskil yavin:
Chassalat parashat nasha

Dabber vegomer veamarta vegomer. kafal hakkatuv lomar dabber veamarta, gam shinna leshono, ulay sheyyechavven lishne mine nazir sheechad meshubbach mechavero, vehu nezirut kehahu sheamru bindarim (nedarim 9.) sheamar shimon hatztzaddik, miyyamay lo achalti vechulei ella paam vechulei haavoda sheagalleach lashshamayim vechulei, alecha amar kera "nazir lehazzir laAdonai", yeuyyan sham. laze amar dabber keneged shear nezirut, veamarta keneged nezirut hammeulla, velaze kafal lomar nazir lehazzir laAdonai velo amar lehazzir laAdonai, nitkavven lomar keneged shene mine nezirut, nazir keneged kol hannezirut sheyyazzir atzmo, umaamar lehazzir laAdonai keneged nezirut shehi mittechillatah laAdonai kemaase oto adam shehizzir kesheraa bavua shello.

Bayyom hashsheni vegomer. hikdim shevet yissashchar, letzad heyoto ben tora huram shivto vekadam liruven habbechor, velo zo bilvad ella gam zevulun hammachzik beyado lilmod, dichtiv (Devarim 33:18) "semach zevulun betzetecha veyissashchar" vegomer, yashav betzillo vekadam liruven:

Hikriv netanel vegomer nesi yissashchar. hikdim hazekarat shemo lezichron hannesiut, laasot lo geder hammaala gam belo chashivut hannesiut, ma sheen ken kol shear hannesiim shehikdim zichron hannesiut lishmam. uvishmo hizkir zichron hattora veemtzaut kinyanah, zichron hattora netanel – natan el, al derech amro (Mishlei 4:2) "ki lekach tov natatti lachem". emtzaut kinyanah ben tzuar – sheen hattora niknet ella al yede yissurin, kach hi darkah shel tora (gittin 57.) "adam ki yamut beohel". veulay ki letzad ze gam ken hikdim zichron shemo, lomar ki letzad hammifal harashum bishmo shehaya bo zacha lihyot nasi livne yissashchar yode vina laittim.

rashi: Lo tira levetah. livne vetah:
Mishshaleg. mitztzinna:
Levush shanim. bigde tzivonin:
targum: La yidchalun bene baytah min talga metul dechulehon bene vaytah levishin havo zehorita:

rashi: Noda bashshearim balah. nikkar hu ben chaverav mippene malbushav shehem naim:
targum: Yedia hava benat medinata bala kad yetiv hu im save ara:

ohc: Elishama ben ammihud. razal amru (tanchuma) rabbi meir verabbi yehoshua ben karcha hayu dorshim et hashshemot: "elishama ben ammihud" – elay shama velaadonato lo shama, immi haya hodo velo im harshaim, ad kan. nire ki yechavven hakkatuv bemaamar eli shama, shettaam shepperash yosef lo letzad shum mechush asher yesubbav mehammaase, ella letzad yirat Adonai, keamro (Bereshit 39:9): "vechatati lelohim", vehu maamar elay shama. od yirtze al pi divrehem sheamru (sota lo:) shennidma lo deyokno shel aviv vechulei, vehen yadua ki hu mare hashshechina, ki aviv bimkomo lo yada davar vaafillu im odennu chay, ella avir yaakov elohe yisrael, vehu maamar elay shama. vechafal lomar od ammihud lirmoz ma sheamar hakkatuv (sham): "velo shama eleha lishkav etzlah lihyot immah", perush "lishkav" vegomer kifshuto, "lihyot immah" – shettava mimmennu lekeruv besaro livsarah velo ratza, vehu maamar "immi hodo" vechulei. verazal sheamru "im reshaim" leshon rabbim, ulay shekkavvanatam lomar shello meeshet potifar levad nishmar ella mikkamma kayyotze bah.

rashi: Al titten. al tattish:
Lannashim chelecha. kochacha:
targum: La titten linshe chelach vearchatach livnat malchin:

rashi: Lakkenaani. taggar:
targum: Petaga avadat uzevanat vezunaara yehavet lichnaanaa:

rashi: Umora. taar, al shem shemmore umashlich et hassear:
targum: Are ha at meadya veteldin bar umispar la yevar al resheh are nezira dayya yehe ravya min bitna vehu yishre lemifrak yat yisrael mida diflishtae:

ohc: Beyom himmashach oto vegomer. kan hitzdik devarenu shekkatavnu lemala, ki chullan hikrivu yachad beyom echad, ella shennisdera nidvatam echad leyom.

Meet nesie yisrael. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar ken. veulay sheyyeshabbach hakkatuv otam shemmeatzman asu chanukkat hammizbeach, vehu maamar meet nesie perush meittam haya hammaase velo hutzrechu lehaggia mehazzulat. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (sifre 9 53) shebba lomar sheshshavu kullan bemitzva achat uzechut echad, ad kan. perush amro zechut echad hu beinyan hakkarban haamur bainyan, aval yimmatze vahem haderagot ze lemala mizze, ki nachshon gadol mikkullan.

Kach meittam vegomer. amro meittam, lelammed sheadayin hayu birshut hammeviim velo bau lirshuto shel moshe, vetamo shel moshe letzad shello nitztavva sheyyisu hammishkan al haagalot lo ratza lekabbel ki lema hem reuyim, vehannesiim shiaru bedatam ki hakkerashim vehaadanim massa gadol shetztzarich laagalot, vehiskima dato shel hakkadosh baruch hu.

Vekarbano. amar tosefet vav mittechillat hammaase, lefi ma shepperashnu bemaamar hammakriv et karbano ki yechavven lannelam, yutzdak lomar bezichron hannigle vekarbano. gam lishar hadderachim hosif bo vav lirmoz leyitron asher betzaddik ze yarum vegava meod.

Avidan ben gidoni. remez leshaul shehu avi, shekken kara lo david (Shmuel 1 24:12) "veavi ree gam ree", dan shenniddon ligdoa hammalchut mimmennu, keamro (Shmuel 1 15:28) "kara Adonai et mamlechut yisrael mealecha". od yirmoz lemardechay asher ibbed zera amalek.ben gidoni – ben oto shennigdea malchuto shel shaul bishvilo.

Yissa Adonai panav elecha vegomer. perush, im sibbevu maasim ad shehivdilu avonotechem benechem uven elohechem – yissa Adonai hammavdil. veyasem lecha shalom, perush, hu hefech happerud, vehammaskil betevat shalom yeda ki hu ze yesod olam hammachzik baelyonim uvattachtonim, vehu keli hammachzik beracha kesheen mafrid, veze hu sod "vesamu et shemi al bene yisrael" sheggamar omer "vaani avarchem".

Elitzur ben shedeur. ulay sheyyirmoz liruven asher machal lo Adonai avon harashum battora (Bereshit 35:22) "vayyishkav" vegomer, veheela lo tzori lemachalato, vehu amro eli perush elohay, tzur al derech (Yirmeyahu 8:22) "hatztzori en begilad", ben shede ur kan ramaz lainyan harashum battora "vayyishkav" vegomer, vehatztzori hu shettechef lemaamar "vayyishkav" vegomer, amar "vayyihyu vene yaakov shenem asar" baze rippe hannega. uledivre chachamenu zichronam livracha sheamru (shabbat noah.) kol haomer reuven chata vechulei hen hem haddevarim shehera Adonai bismichut "vayyihyu vene yaakov" vegomer:

rashi: Achare ishto. achar atzatah:
targum: Vekam vaazal manoach batar itteteh vaata levat gavra vaamar leh haat gavra di malalta im itteta vaamar ana:

ohc: Yevarechcha Adonai veyishmerecha. hikdim habberacha veachar kach hashshemira, lomar sheyyetzavve Adonai shemirato lahem lefi erech habberacha ugedullatah. od yirtze shekkol kach tihye gedullat habberacha ad sheyyitztarech Adonai lishmarcha. od yirtze yevarechcha velo yesubbav raa mehabberacha kederech "pen tochal vesavata" vegomer (Devarim 8:12).

rashi: Lannaar hayyulad. heatid lehivvaled:
targum: Vetzali manoach kodam Adonai vaamar vevau Adonai neviya dayya dishlachta yete chean od levatana veyalfinana ma nabed leravya deityelid:

rashi: Yayin veshechar. (targum:) chamar chadat veattik:
targum: Uchean istamari chean vela tishtin chamar chadat veattik vela techlin kol mesaav:

ohc: Tifkod otam. kafal lomar tifkod, perashti befarashat bammidbar beinyan bene kehat (Bamidbar 4:20).

Litzvo tzava vegomer. uvivne kehat amar "litzvo" levad, ki hem hayu nosim kele hakkodesh happenimiyyim, laze amar "litzvo", ma sheen ken ma shellefanenu hem tzovim tzava hatztzove kodesh shehem hayyeriot vegomer vehakkerashim vegomer shehem tzeva hakkodesh, laze amar litzvo tzava, meatta hem tzovim hatztzava.

Dabber el aharon vegomer lemor. amar paam sheniyya lemor, ulay ki chash hakkatuv lomar sheeno ella reshut, talmud lomar "lemor" ki mitzvat ase hi lemor. od yirtze shello leaharon uvanav shehayu az bannimtza levad hu metzavve, ella gam ledorot. od nitkavven leshon rommut, lomar ki mitzva zo yesh bah devar melech lekayyem haddavar, gam yesh bah maala lakkohanim ki habberachot mesaram Adonai beyadam, vehu amro "dabber vegomer lemor".

rashi: Leyom acharon. beyom motah nifteret beshem tov:
Vattischak. kol yameha al yom mitatah, sheyyehe nichbad beshem tov:
targum: Ushena vehadera levushah vegachacha veyoma acharayta:

rashi: Natzera na otach. neesof otcha el habbayit:
targum: Vaamar manoach lemalacha dayya nechod kean yatach venabed kodamach gadya bar ize:

ohc: Kol habbakar laola. amar leshon yachid, lomar ki geder echad lechullan. vechen amar bekar zevach hashshelamim leshon yachid letaam ze atzmo.

rashi: Al lammelachim lemoel. en ze davar hagun lammelachim, shehem lehakkadosh baruch hu. lemoel kemo "lemo fi" (Iyov 40:4):
Al lammelachim sheto yayin. en nae lahem lehishtakker:
E shechar. kemo en shechar:
targum: Izdehar min malche lemoel min malche deshatin chamra umin shiltone deshatin shichra:

rashi: Leoved. lemi shessofo leibbud, larshaim (eruvin 65.):
Lemare nafesh. hammitztaarin al anyam veal evlam (Bamidbar Rabba 10:4):
targum: Havun shichra laavele vechamra limrire nafsha:

ohc: Yaer Adonai. perush, shello yihye masach hammavdil ben yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim, shebbaze yair or shechinato al yisrael:
Vichunnekka vegomer. perush, yitten lecha chen vachanina. veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk (Bereshit 39:21) "vayhi Adonai et yosef vayyet elav chesed vayyitten chinno" vegomer:

Beyom kallot moshe. razal amru (Bamidbar Rabba 92) "kallat" ketiv, veroani ki besefer tora ketuva beVav, vaani omer ki divre tora kaellu vechayyotze baellu enam nimsarim lechol merim yad betofse hattora, ki yesovev haddavar hakkefira vehazzilzul bichvod morim. veyesh lecha ladaat ki seder toratenu hakkedosha vetevoteha veotiyyoteha sefurot mezukkakot chatzuvot mimmachtzav kadosh venora, niflaim hemma lammakkir bahem veyoter peliot neelamim meen kol. veaircha gargir echad, vehu halo timtza ki yesh otiyyot nirgashot bemivta hattevot veenam bichtav, kegon "yehoshua" ki bammivta yeshno lehergesh shel ot havvav ben shin laayin veenah bammichtav, veyeshnah bemakom sheenah nirgeshet shehi ben hei leshin. veheara zot techonen daat maskil lehakkir ki otiyyoteha sefurot mezukkakot vei efshar lehosif afillu ot achat, hagam ki titztarech lemivta hakkeria vetihye nikret hagam sheenah ketuva, vetihye keri velo ketiv. vekava hattora havvav shello bimkomah lehair bannistarot. veulay ki mizze hiskilcha shennitkavven letzaref shelosha otiyyot mishshemo yitbarach bishmo shel tzaddik, velismoch shin veayin lehair el 370 nehorin. veim haya mesadder vav bimkomah hayta nifsedet hayyedia baddavar ki lo porash. vehinne mevine maarchot haotiyyot hemma yaskilu mishbetzotam, vehem haomrim ki "kallat" ketiv vehavvav hi mushelet sham behasheala. vehammaskil yavin ki hu sodo shel moshe asher mityachedet lo vekuyyema bo "nekeva tesovev gaver" (Yirmeyahu 31:22). veze shiur haddevarim "kallat" ketiv, perush teva zo shel "kallot" ze perushah: kach mehakkatuv "kallat" kede shettavin asher techavven elav hatteva, veot havvav hi bechinat hechatan, vehu sod nelam vav toch "kallat", vehaven. uderasha zo en adam dorshah middato im lo takdim hahakkara baddevarim al bureyan vaamittutam mippi mekabbele tora vesodoteha uremazeha.

rashi: Lefaamo. lavo bekirbo lifamim:
targum: Usheriat ruach gevura min kodam Adonai letakafuteh bemashiryat dan ben tzara uven eshtaol:

ohc: Shelumiel ben tzurishadday. yirmoz leshimon sheshshillem lo el al chet yosef vayyeesor oto bammishmar, gam ma sheshshillem Adonai bemaase zimri, tzuri shadday she amar lechilyono day, dichtiv (Bamidbar 25:8) "vatteatzar hammaggefa".

Eliav ben chelon. nikra chen letzad shehu davar hammaamid leyissashochar lilmod tora yikkare av, uchemo shemmatzinu shehikdimo moshe leyissashochar, dichtiv (Devarim 33:18) "semach zevulun vegomer veyissashchar" vegomer, vehu maamar eliav perush, li yityaches likrot av, hagam shehu chelon perush chulin, sheeno ben tora veosek bifrakmatya chulin olam hazze, af al pi chen den abba lemalka.

rashi: Mechukkak. hakkatuv battora, vechol shekken ma shehu begirsa:
targum: La tishte vetate havanach uteshane dinhon dechulehon bene aniye:

rashi: Marbaddim. matztzaot naot lammitta, kemo "marbaddim ribbadti" (Mishlei 7:16):
targum: Tashveyata avdat lah butza veargevana levushah:

rashi: Veshalal lo yechsar. kelomar: lo yechsar tov:
targum: Detachel alah libbeh devaalah vela mitbeza vela chasra:

rashi: Ki yavo devarcha. im yavo lanu shelichut davar meittecha, mishshenneda venakkir et shemecha:
Vechibbadnucha. venaase ma shettishlach lanu:
targum: Vaamar manoach lemalacha dayya ma shemach are yitkaymun pitgamach uneyakrinach:

rashi: Vehu feliy. mechusse, tamid hu mishtanne veen yadua lema mishtanne hayyom (sifre nasha 42):
targum: Vaamar leh malacha dayya lema denan at shael lishmi vehu mefarash:

ohc: Gamliel ben pedahtzur. amru razal hannizkarim veze leshonam: gamliel – immi gemulim tovim, ben pedahtzur – pedaani mibbet hassohar, ad kan. veyirmoz od al ze hadderech gamliel sheyyosef amar ki gemalo Adonai chasadim tovim bead hammaase, hagam shehu pedao bema sheherahu deyokno, vehu amro peda tzur.

rashi: Teref. mazon:
Vechok. hu mazon hakkatzuv lahem:
targum: Vekamat belelya vihavat mezona levetah ufulechana letalyataha:

ohc: Veim lo nitmea vegomer utehora vegomer. kafal lomar "utehora", letzad shebba lomar ki millevad shettinnake haishsha mehammayim velo yashchituha, od lah "venikketa venizrea zara". laze hitna utehora, perush, lo nitmet bintinat shechivato shel ish mibbalade ishah, utehora middavar megunne shehu maase hannoafim hakkodmim levia, cheshek hazzulat vechibbuk venishshuk vedome lo. az hiv sheyyetivu lah hammayim kechol hakkatuv. aval im lo nitmea aval lo nithara meanfe hachet, hagam shettinnaki mehaonesh lo yaggiuha tovot haamurot.
