Vetimtza shebbishvuat hakkohen amar ki satit tachat vegomer vechi nitmet vegomer, vekashe, ma hiv kavvanato bemaamar "ki satit", im hiv "ki nitmet" – lo haya lo lomar "vechi nitmet" betosefet vav, ella vadday shennitkavven leinyan devarim hakkodmim lattuma shehu cheshek hazzulat vechulei, vehitna vechi nitmet az hiv sheyyihye lah onesh, veamar behafekiyyut im lo hayu shete hachalukkot tinnake mehara vetatzliach bedavar tov, vachalukka haemtzait muvenet meemtzaut haddevarim. verazal amru (sota 18.) "utehora hi" meish acher, uledarkenu ish acher nichlal bemaamar lo nitmea, ki derech kelal amar ben meish ze ben meacher.

Achira ben enan. yirmoz al derech maamaram zichronam livracha (sifre Devarim 33:23) befasuk "seva ratzon", melammed shehaya naftali sameach bechelko beyammim, bedagim, befargiyyot, "umale birkat Adonai" yam ginosar, ad kan. vehu maamar achi ra, perush shechelek echav haya beenav ra beerech chelko, vehayta eno melea mechelek shennafal begoralo.

rashi: Vechaet. hazzot:
Lo hishmianu kazot. lo haya mashmienu besora zo im reuyim anu lamut:
targum: Vaamarat leh itteteh ilu raava kodam Adonai dinmut la kabbel minana alata uminchata vela achazinana yat kol ilen ucheidan pon la ashmeinana kahada:

ohc: Laavod et avodat ohel moed. ulehallan bivne gershon omer "avoda beohel moed", letzad ki avodat bene gershon hi beohel moed atzmo shennosim yeriot hammishkan veohel moed michsehu vegomer, ma sheen ken bene merari sheavodatam hi hakkerashim vehaadanim vegomer shehem avodat ohel moed shennosim ohel moed, velaze amar laavod et vegomer hakkerashim vegomer shehem avodat ohel moed, velaze lo chash lomar "latztzava" levad, shehare perash hakkatuv devarav, ma sheen ken baavodat bene gershon lehaircha bahefresh shebben avodatam laavodat bene kehat, letzad shebbishnehem amar avoda baohel veen hekker bidvarav lahefresh shebben shenehem, laze katav shinnuy "litzvo tzava" meshunne mimma shekkatav bivne kehat "latztzava", uletzad hefresh shebben bene gershon livne merari heircha beshinnuy acher kemo shekkatavnu.

Ish vegomer ki yaasu mikkol vegomer. amar limol velo amar umaalu maal, yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (sifre; Pesikta 2; bava kamma 110.) sheamru shehakkatuv medabber bimshakker bemamon chavero venishba lo lashsheker, vahagam shekkevar neemar haddavar befarashat vayyikra, chazar venishna lifrate haddinim shennitchaddeshu bo. kefi ze yair hakkatuv ki mishsheat maase hachet shehu haggezel uchefirat mamon yachshov hu limol maal baAdonai lishshava bishmo kesheyyitbeuhu ledin, sheim lo chen hare hu behishshavon, vehu amro ki yaasu mikkol chattot haadam shehu gezelat mamon chavero mishsheat maase hinne hu maskim limol maal baAdonai.

Veashma hannefesh hahiv. letzad shehu chata bishvua baAdonai, yafil haggeraon bannefesh. veshinna Adonai lomar leshon yachid, vechol ma shellefanav uma shelleacharav leshon rabbim. millefanav amar: ki yaasu vegomer, milleacharav: vehitvaddu, vetimtza sheamru baggemara ki kesheyyargishcha hakkatuv bichgon ze hu hergesh gadol, veayyen ma shekkatavnu mizze befarashat vayyikra (Vayikra 7:21). gam dikdek lomar tevat hahu lelo tzorech, yeorer hakkatuv shehappegam hallaz yaase roshem limkor nafshot am bene yisrael shettikkare nefesh, uchede shello tavin sheal hammoel hu medabber laze amar hahu velo amar "veashma nafsho". veayyen ma shekkatuv bazzohar (achare mot 67.) beferush pasuk "nafshi ivviticha ballayla" (Yeshayahu 26:9) bediyyuk nachon:

Veheshiv et ashamo. shinna ledabber leshon yachid, hagam shehitchil ledabber leshon rabbim "vehitvaddu", letzad shehavvidduy shavim hem bo, ma sheen ken haasham eno behashevaa, letzad shehu beole veyored kaamur befarashat vayyikra (Vayikra 5:7-13), vegamar hakkatuv ledabber beshiur ze leshon yachid, ki en tzorech leshannot lichtov beinyan acher.

Alpayim sheva meot. velo amar "usheva meot" kederech sheamar bivne gershon "veshesh meot usheloshim", uvivne merari "umatayim", "vachamesh meot ushemonim". ulay ramaz bechesron vav lekorach veotam shemmetu immo shehayu mibbene kehat, o ulay ki mispar hashsheva meot meshunne behaderaga mimmispar haalafim mittaam maase korach, laze lo amar "usheva meot" lehosif al inyan rishon lehashevotam yachad. vahagam shello nitparsem battora bammaase hahu ella korach, efshar sheanaf shel korach natu ketzat acharav, o letzad shello michu bo echav ukerovav.

Elyasaf ben deuel. yirmoz leheyot shenneesfu learehem techilla al pi Adonai kaamur, zulat gibbore chayil sheavru kol chalutz vegomer, vehu amro el yasaf. od al pi divrehem zichronam livracha sheeretz sichon veog lo hayta bichlal mattenat eretz yisrael shennatan Adonai leavraham, kemo sheamru besifre (chelek 2 paysakea 299) veze leshonam: perat leever hayyarden shennatalta meatzmecha, ad kan. umatzinu shemmishpat eretz yisrael yesh lah (sheviit 89 42) kayyadua, veayyen ma shekkatavti befarashat mattot befasuk "atarot" vegomer, laze kerao elyasaf letzad shehosif littol yoter mimmattenat Adonai vehiskim Adonai immahem. ben deuel perush, sheasu hekker leedut ladaat ki hem yedue ovde el keechad shivte yisrael, kaamur bihoshua (22:27, 22:34).

rashi: Divre lemuel melech. divre shelomo hammelech sheamar lemo hakkadosh baruch hu, kelomar: bishvil sheheeva keneged hakkadosh baruch hu. lemuel lael, kemo "lemo fi" (Iyov 40:4). devarim lishmo shel hakkadosh baruch hu sheamar hammelech:

Massa asher yisserattu immo. keshehitchatten im bat paro beyom chanukkat bet hammikdash, vehichnisa lo kamma mine kele zemer, veneor kol hallayla, veyashan lemochorat ad arba shaot; kidita bifsikta (Vayikra Rabba 12, 5), vehayu maftechot bet hammikdash tachat meraashotav. veal otah shaa shaninu (eduyyot 6, 1): al tamid shel shachar shekkarav bearba shaot, venichnesa immo vehochichattu al hammaase hazze:
Massa asher yisserattu immo. massa shel mashal sheyyisserattu immo (sanhedrin 70:):
targum: Milohi dilmuel malka neviuta umarduta dirdateh imeh vaamarat leh:

ohc: Vayyifkod moshe veaharon unesie haeda. taam shelashtam: moshe sheliach Adonai, aharon hannimsarim lo dichtiv (Bamidbar 3:9) "netunim netunim hemma lo", nesie yisrael hammosrim otam bimkomam laavod, dichtiv befarashat bammidbar (Bamidbar 3:7) "veshamru et mishmarto veet mishmeret kol haeda" vegomer. uma shello amar ken bemispar haleviyyim mibben chodesh, letzad ki mispar hahu haya al pi Adonai letzad shehaya hammispar gam lema shebbaarisa, veamru zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 3,9) shebbat kol hayta omeret: beohel ze yesh kach vechach, laze lo hizkir ella moshe nevi Adonai.

Pagiel ben achran. yirmoz al pi divrehem (sifre Devarim 355) sheasher higgid leechav maase reuven unezafuhu, ucheshehoda reuven hodu ledivre asher vekervuhu, vehu maamar pagi el perush, pagu elav echav achar sheavaruhu.

Od yirtze, al derech amro "baruch mibbanim asher" (Devarim 33:23). veamru razal (sham) veze leshonam: en lecha bechol hashshevatim shennitbarech bevanim keasher, ad kan. umatzinu shebbirkat habbanim tesubbav mishshechunat hakkedushsha, veze lecha haot aron hattora asher chana bevet oved edom haggitti vechulei (berachot 63:), vehu maamar pagi el sheppaga bo el asher mizze nitbarech bevanim. veamro ben achran yirmoz laachirut habbetulim mibbenotehem, kemaamaram zichrono livracha (451 deve eliyyahu Rabba perek 9) shello haya lahem dam betulim.

Hikriv et karbano. kol ze meyuttar achar shekkevar amar "hikriv netanel", ella nitkavven lehagedil bechinot hannosafot bezichron hakeravat nachshon ben amminadav. vetimtza shehizkir benachshon zichron hakkarban shelosha peamim: hammakriv vegomer, karbano vegomer, vekarbano. echad zichron hitkarvuto lehakedim rishona, veechad livchinat hakkarban hannelam, veechad lakkarban atzmo. kemo chen benasi shel tora hizkir shelosha karbanot: hikriv netanel vegomer, hikriv et karbano, uvishar hannesiim lo hizkir ella hazekarat hakkarban hammuva bet Adonai, ki lo yuchelu asot kemalche yisrael shehem shevet yehuda veshevet yissashchar.

Vetaam amro "hikriv" belo yod, lidrosh hammasoret shehu leshon tziuuy vehuremanuta, vehakkavvana baze al pi maamaram zichronam livracha (sifre nov) sheirer reuven alav, laze ba maamar adon harshut veamar hikriv, laze katav belo yod lirmoz ze.

Tzav et bene yisrael vishallechu vegomer. taam semichut parasha zo leshellefaneha, letzad shetztzivva Adonai al harechakat haleviyyim middevarim hammekuddashim uminna alehem hakkohanim kaamur besamuch, hittil gam al yisrael harechakat et sheenam reuyim likkanes lemachanehem hakkadosh:

Vaydabber Adonai vegomer naso. hutzrach lomar vaydabber paam sheniyya, velo hispik bema sheamar "vaydabber Adonai" bemispar bene kehat hakkodem shebbefarashat bammidbar, letzad shebba lomar inyan acher levad hammispar, vehu sheyyenasse viromem bene gershon leerech bene merari, veinyan ze hu davar bifne atzmo sheen nesiut ze begeder nesiut bene kehat shehem nose haaron, laze kava lo dibbur bifne atzmo. velaze keshetztzivva al mispar bene merari amar "bene merari vegomer tifkod", lo kava lahem dibbur bifne atzmo sheen lahem maala ella minyan, mimma sheamar "tifkod" velo "tissa".

El moshe vegomer. ulehallan bammispar amar veel aharon (Bamidbar 4:34), letzad ki sham ba hatztziuuy leaharon kede sheyyaase seder haamur beinyan massaam shel bene kehat, dichtiv "vesamu otam vegomer velo yamutu", laze amar veel aharon, ma sheen tzorech laze bemassa bene gershon.

Achiezer ben ammishadday. ulay sheramaz leshimshon, veamro achi yirmoz leruach Adonai shehayta immo, dichtiv (Shoftim 14:6) "vattitzlach alav ruach Adonai", vichunne beshem achi al derech amro (tehillim 122:8) "lemaan achay vereay", ezer shehaya Adonai beezro neged oyvav. veamar ben ammishadday yirmoz leachar shennikkeru pelishtim et enav vekara laAdonai vehaya immo venakam meoyvav.

Al pi Adonai pakad vegomer. perush, hamminnuy shemminna otam bene kehat al davar ze uvene gershon al davar ze vegomer, hayu kol happekidot al pi Adonai. veamro beyad moshe, perush, kol hamminnuyim moshe minna otam, lo shetztzivva leaharon lemannot. veachar sheppakad otam moshe, al pi maasav haya mitnaheg aharon lasum ish ish al avodato. veamro "ufekudav", perush pekudav shemminna aharon uvanav al shevet levi kaamur lemala, gam hu asher tzivva Adonai et moshe.

rashi: Kol bene chalof. ellu hen hayetomim, shechalfa ezratam vehalcha lah:
targum: Petach pumach lehalen dela misto din vedun lechulehon bene avle:

ohc: Asher ani shochen. perush, davka kol od shehu shochen, aval hugellu happarochot muttarim metzoraim likkanes lammachanot (menachot 95:).

rashi: Ma beri. me zot asita, vehiggadta sheatta beni velo ven avicha? hakkol yodin sheavicha tzaddik gamur haya, veim atta rasha, yomru: immo garma lo:
Bar bitni. kol neshe avicha, kevan shemmitabberot enan shavot letashmish; vaani dachakti venichnasti kede sheyyehe li ben melubban umezoraz, shehattashmish yafe kol shishsha chodashim acharonim:
Ume bar nedaray. kol neshe avicha hayu nodrot sheyyehe lahen ben hagun lammalchut, vaani nadarti sheyyehe li ben melubban battora:
targum: Vay beri uvay bar keresi uvay bar nidray:

rashi: Veal tochli kol tuma. devarim haasurim lenazir:
targum: Vaamar li ha at meadya utelidin bar uchean la tishtin chamar chadat veattik vela techlin kol mesaav are nezira daAdonai yehe ravya min bitna ad yom moteh:

ohc: Vetimme rosh nizro. amar tosefet vav, gam amar tevat rosh, nitkavven lomar shehagam sheeno ella tumeat shogeg, af al pi chen lo millevad shennitma gufo ella afillu kedushsha sheyyesh berosho, dichtiv "nezer elohav al rosho".

Od yirtze lomar, ki lo satar hannezirut meaz vahala levad, ella vetimme gam ken rosh nizro, perush, techillat hannezirut, vehu ma sheggamar omer vehizzir laAdonai vegomer vehayyamim harishonim yippelu. uma shechazar lomar achar kach ki tame nizro, velo hispik ma shekkadam bemaamar "vetimme rosh nizro", shello yihye makom levaal din lomar shello tame ella yom echad shehu hatechalat hannezirut, umaamar vehayyamim harishonim gilla ki lo yom echad levad mittechillat hannezirut yitma ella shene harishonim velo kol hayyamim, ugezerat hakkatuv hu, talmud lomar "ki tame nizro" bederech kelal.

targum: Vaamar manoach leitteteh memat nemut are malacha dayya chazena:
Pumah petachat bechachmeta venimusa dechisda al lishanah:
Uselik vechavi laavuhi uleimeh vaamar itteta chazeti betimnat mibbenat pelishtae uchean savu yatah li leittu:
Unesiv manoach yat gadya bar ize veyat tikrovta veasik al tinara kodam Adonai umafrash lemebad umanoach veitteteh chazan:
Vaatat itteta vaamarat levaalah lememar neviya dayya ata levati vechezveh kechezu malacha dayya chasin lachada vela sheilteh e miden hu veyat shemeh la chave li:
Veitchaze malacha dayya leitteta vaamar lah ha chean at akra velet lich velad vetaadin veteldin bar:
Unechat shimshon letimnat vachaza itteta betimnat mivnat pelishtae:
Yedah pashta laaniya uderaya moshita laalive:
Petach pumach vedun tzidketa vedun laaniye velaalive:
Tevaat amra vechittana vaavadat hech tzivyana deaydah:
Venishtun venitun miskenathon veshachakehon la nizkerun tuv:
Itteta chesherta manu yishkach yakira hi min kefe tavta timaha:
Vaasarat beushena chartzaha uzerezat deraaha:
Uteamat metul detavta tagarutah vela daech belelya sheragah:
Veochiat itteta urehatat vechaviat levaalah vaamarat leh ha itchaze li gavra di ata veyoma dechi levati:
Vaamar malacha dayya lemanoach im tachadinani la echul belachmach veim tabed alata kodam Adonai taskinah are la yeda manoach are malacha dayya hu:
Vahavat hech ilfat detigra demin rachik mayteya mechluta:
Ushemia kodam Adonai tzeloteh demanoach vaata malacha dayya od levat itteta vehi yatva bechakla umanoach baalah let imah:
Viledat itteta bar ukerat yat shemeh shimshon ureva ravya uvarcheh Adonai:
Mikkol deyippok migufena dechamra la techul vachamar chadat veattik la tishte vechol mesaav la techul kol di fakedtah titar:
Vaamar malacha dayya lemanoach mikkol daamarit leitteta tistamar:
Parateh tavta vela vishta kol yome chayaha:
Veitchashvet betarita unesevat chakla umin pere didaha netzevat karma:
Vahava bemesak shalhovita meilave madbecha letzet shemaya uselek malacha dayya beshalhovit madbecha umanoach veitteteh chazan unefalu al appehon al ara:
Vela osif od malacha dayya leitchazaa lemanoach uleitteteh bechen yeda manoach are malacha dayya hu:
Vahava gavra chad mitzara mizarit dan ushemeh manoach veitteteh akara let lah velad:

bart: Chattoot hatztzibbur. kegon seire rashe chodashim veshel moadot veolotehen, kullehu vene shana ninhu:
Chattat hayyachid. kisba o seira:

Veim hikrivum beyom shemini kesherim. dichtiv (Vayikra 22) umiyyom hashshemini vahala yeratze, veneemar bivchor (Shemot 22) bayyom hashshemini titteno li, ma bechor asa yom shemini kishmini vahala, af bishar karbanot asa yom shemini kishmini vahala. mihu bemidi dechova mitzva min hammuvchar lehavi miyyom sheloshim vaelach:
Vehappesach. af al gav dechova hu, lo chashu chachamim, mishshum denasve lefi nefashot, shello yavo lide notar kevan sheeno neechol [ella] lachavura echat:
Veechad devarim shel acherim. kedimfaresh sheetten lifloni:
Sheen bahen mammash. tere gavne mashma, kegon shena, umashma sheen bahem hanaa kegon sheezrok tzeror layyam:

Meribbuy hakkatuv. lechol asher yevatte haadam. ufelugta derabbi akiva verabbi yishmael, derabbi akiva daresh bechol hattora ribbuye umiute, verabbi yishmael daresh kelale uferate. rabbi akiva daresh o nefesh ki tishshava ribba, lehara o lehetiv miet, lechol asher yevatte chazar veribba. ribba umiet veribba, ribba hakkol. may ribba, ribba kol mille lesheavar kilhabba. umay miet, miet devar mitzva. verabbi yishmael daresh o nefesh ki tishshava kelal, lehara o lehetiv perat, lechol asher yevatte chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal i atta dan ella cheen happerat, ma happerat meforash lehabba, af kol lehabba. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:

Minyan shehu samuch learbaim. sheggorem lomar acharav arbaim, dehaynu tesha usheloshim. i hava chetiv arbaim bemispar, hava amena arbaim beminyana, hasheta dichtiv bemispar arbaim, bemispar haggorem lomar acharav arbaim, dehaynu tesha usheloshim:

Vehechan hu loke et hayetera. sheenah reuya lehishtallesh. detesha usheloshim reuyot lehishtallesh, shelish millefanav ushete yadot achat al katef zo veachat al katef zo, vezo shel arbaim hechan loke otah:
Ben ketefav. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Middivrehem lamadnu. ben rabbi meir ben rabbi yose tarvayhu sevira lehu devasar shennitma vivlad hattuma deamar rabbi chanina, mayre bevasar shennitma bemashkim shennitmeu vichli shennitma vesheretz, verabbi meir savar tumat mashkim letamme acherim lav deorayta, sheen mashkin metammein acherim vaafillu ochalin ella midderabbanan, umishshum hachi kaamar middivre rabbi chanina deamar shessorfin basar shennitma vemashkin dahave leh tame midderabbanan, demiddeorayta tahor mealleya hu, im basar shennitma veav hattuma shehu tame deorayta:

Lamadnu shessorfin teruma tehora im hattemea. mishshehiggia shaa shishshit shehi asura midderabbanan, kemo shessorfin basar shennitma vemashkin shehu tahor gamur min hattora, im basar shennitma veav hattuma shehu tame deorayta:

Amar lo rabbi yose enah hi hammidda. rabbi yose letaameh disvira leh tumat mashkin letamme acherim deorayta uvasar shennitma vemashkin tame middeorayta, hilkach amar leh enah hi hammidda, kelomar i atta yachol lilmod zot middivrehem, im hittarta lisrof teme tuma kalla im teme tuma chamura, tattir lisrof tehora im temea. vahalacha cherabbi yose sheen sorfim teruma tehora im hattemea befesach, vetumat mashkin letamme acherim enah middeorayta ella midderabbanan, kerabbi meir:
Umodim rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua. rabbi yose kaamar la deaf al gav derabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua ifligu bisrefat teruma, beha modim shessorfim zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah:

Al hatteluya veal hattemea. rabbi eliezer savar demuzhar al shemiratah shel teluya, dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) et mishmeret terumotay, bishte terumot hakkatuv medabber, achat teruma teluya veachat teruma tehora:
Verabbi yehoshua omer shetehen keechat. kevan ditluya hi i atta muzhar al shemiratah. veal hatteluya vehattehora lo nechelku shessorfin, dehoil velo huchzeka tuma en niret kimtamme veyadayim:
Tahor milletamme kashsheretz. ufosel teruma [vetu lo]:

Veshalosh teharot bayyoledet. vehu haddin bezav baal shalosh reiyyot, uvezava. divchullehu taval veala ochel bammaaser, heeriv shimsho ochel batteruma, hevi chapparato ochel bakkadashim, hare shalosh teharot. vehay denakat yoledet tefe mizzav vezava, mishshum divyoledet ketiv behedya (sham 12) vechipper aleha hakkohen vetahera, laachilat kadashim:

Bayyom hashshemini. kesheggillach bashshevii, mevi karbenotav bashshemini. aval im shaha velo gillach ella vashshemini, mevi karbenotav batteshii, lefi shettaun heerev shemesh ben gilluach lahavaat karbenotav:

Neger hannigrar. beriach hakkashur baddelet aval eno taluy bo, shehachevel hakkashur bo aroch, vehabberiach nigrar al gabbe karka. uveneger sheen berosho gelustera askinan. divyesh berosho gelustera ha share leh rabbi yose leel af al pi sheeno kashur, vahalacha kemoto:
Noalim bo vammikdash. dishvut bealma hu veeno bone mammash hoil vekashur hu, ella mippene shennigrar mechaze kevone, veen shevut bammikdash:

Vehammunnach. sheeno kashur kelal, have binyan mammash. verabbi yehuda savar lo have binyan mammash ella mechaze kevinyan, uvammikdash lo gazru mishshum shevut. vehannigrar af bammedina muttar hoil vekashur, af al pi sheeno taluy. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Rabbi eliezer omer hashsheretz venelam. deamar kera (Vayikra 5) o benivlat sheretz tame venelam mimmennu, ukera yetera hu, deha leel ketiv o nefesh asher tigga bechol davar tame, vesheretz bichlal davar tame hu, ella lelammedcha sheim yada shennitma vadday veeno yodea im besheretz im binvela eno chayyav karban im achal kodesh ad shettihye lo yedia vattechilla im besheretz nitma o vinvela nitma. verabbi akiva savar, dechevan deyada vadday shennitma af al gav delo itberira leh hattuma shennitma im besheretz o binvela, chayyav. vetarvayhu fatre al helem mikdash. verabbi yishmael mechayyev. vahalacha kerabbi yishmael:

Vesorfin bitchillat shesh. veaf al gav dechol shaa shishshit middeorayta sharya, gazru rabbanan aleha dilma tau vesavur al hashsheviit shehi shishshit. aval hachamishshit lo tau lememar al hashsheviit shehi chamishshit, umuttar:

Tolin kol chamesh. veeno ochel, gezera mishshum yom hameunnan detae vesavar al hashsheviit shehi chamishshit. umihu lisrof eno tzarich, umaachil livhemto. aval shishshit af bahanaa asur midderabbanan, gezera mishshum sheviit. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Ala aleha zachar pesula. af al gav delo nicha leh, mishshum dedameha yekarim umafsid tuva, uvaavoda dela nicha leh lo mippassela, dichtiv beegla arufa [sham] asher lo ubbad bah, ketiv avad vekarinan ubbad, ma avad denicha leh, af ubbad denicha leh, veyalfinan parat chattat minna. mikkol makom hoil uvishar parot hava nicha leh, chashvinan legabbe farat chattat nammi nicha leh. veod im bata lehacheshir im ken hava nicha leh, umishshum hachi pesula:
Heelahu pesula. lav davka heelahu, ella im ala aleha ledaat habbealim, afillu ala meatzmo pesula. veim shello ledaat habbealim, keshera. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Beshogeg. sheshshagag batteruma, afillu hezid bechametz:

Meshallem keren vachomesh. veaf al gav dechametz befesach asur bahanaa velo shave mide, mishshum divochel teruma veshogeg ketiv (Vayikra 22) venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh, davar harauy lihyot kodesh, sheen meshallem lo maot ella ferot vehattashlumim naasim teruma, hilkach lav batar damim azlinan:
Bemezid. shehezid batteruma, afillu shagag bechametz, patur min hattashlumin:

Umiddeme etzim. im teruma temea hi en meshallem deme etzim shehayta reuya lehassik tachat tavshilo, mishshum demezid bitruma eno ella kishar gazlan dealma, umaot meshallem lefi damim velo lefi midda, vechametz befesach lav bar damim hu shehare asur bahanaa, veaf lehessek lo chazi, velo mide afsedeh:

Machazirin retiyya. kohen shehutzrach laavod avoda beshabbat, venatal retiyya shehayta al gabbe makka sheal yado kede shello tehe chotzetzet ben besaro laavoda, machazirah al gabbe makkato leachar haavoda, dei lo sharet leh lehachezirah mimmena velo avid avoda:
Aval lo vammedina. gezera shemma yimrach hartiyya, vechayyav mishshum memachek:
Veim battechilla. shello hayta keshura mibbeod yom vechohen ze lo sillekah letzorech avoda:

Kan vechan asur. velo amrinan hacha en shevut bammikdash, delav tzorech gavoah hu ella tzorech atzmo. veha deasre rabbanan hachezarat hartiyya eno ella kesheppersha al gabbe karka, aval im lekachah beyado, kol zeman shehi beyado, o afillu netanah al gabbe keli velo pershah al gabbe karka, muttar lehachezirah bechol makom:

Koshrin nima. nimat kinnor shel shir halleviyyim shennifseka beshabbat, dekasavar machshire mitzva shello yachol laasotam meetmol, deha hayyom nifseka, dochin et hashshabbat. vedavka keshennifseka baemtza, sheeno koshrah ella lefi shaa, aval samuch layyetedot dahave kesher shel keyama asur:
Veim battechilla. shello hayta sham meolam, deyachol laasotah meetmol, asur:

Yabbelet. hi mum bakkadashim, shenneemar (Vayikra 22) o yabbelet, vechotchim otah bammikdash bayyad, deen baze ella mishshum shevut, dechilachar yad hu. aval lo bichli, dimlacha gemura hi, shekkach osim bechol. ucheshechotech mibbaal chay have tolada degozez et hatztzemer:
Ketzad metaharin. feyali. mizrak. hashshotim bemizreke yayin (Amos 6) metargeminan deshatayin bifyale chamar:
Chadasha. dichtiv (Vayikra 14) el keli cheres al mayim, makkish keli lemayim, ma mayim shello naasa vahen melacha, af keli shello naasa vo melacha:
Reviit. mishshum dichtiv (sham) bedam hatztzippor hashshechuta uvammayim hachayyim, mayim chayyim sheddam hatztzippor nikkar bahen. veshiaru chachamim reviit:
Mayim chayyim. shelleolam novim veenan poskim:
Tzipporim deror. sheddarot babbayit kevassade:
Vekovrah befanav. lefi sheasura vahanaa:
Usheni tolaat. leshon tzemer tzavua shani. 277 belaaz:
Ucherachan bishyare lashon. etz erez veezov usheni tolaat haya mannichan yachad, vehallashon yotze veodef al etz erez veezov, vehaya chorchan bo dahavu shelashtan baagudda echat:

Vehikkif. leshon semicha vehakerava. kemo [betza daf lev] makkifim shete chaviyyot. litrom shello min hammukkaf. kelomar haya somech lahen rashe agappim verosh hazzanav shel hatztzippor hachayya, vetovel kullan beyachad baddam uvammayim shebbakkeli cheres:
Leachar yado. al gav yado shel metzora:
Veyesh omrim al mitzcho. veen halacha keyesh omrim:
Al hashshekof. shel bayit shehu menugga:
Tahor shehichnis rosho verubbo. divtzir merosho verubbo la chashiva via:
Shehichnis mimmenna shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot. chashiva keillu nichnesa kol hattallit kullah. aval pachot mikken lo, divtzir mishshalosh al shalosh enah mekabbelet tuma vela chashiva:
Utemea. kegon tallit hamenuggaat shehichnis mimmenna chazzayit levayit tahor:

Timmeattu. detzaraat ittakkash lemet. vetallit hamenuggaat dimtammea bevia nafka lan mikkera dichtiv [vayyikra yad] uletzaraat habbeged velabbayit, makkish beged levayit, ma bayit metamme bevia deha chetiv [sham] vehabba el habbayit vegomer, af beged metamme bevia. minnayin lerabbot et kullan kegon sheti vaerev veorot, talmud lomar [sham 13] zot torat nega tzaraat beged hatztzemer, makkish kullan leveged, ma beged metamme bevia, af kullan metammein bevia:
Natal millog hashshemen. sheheela et hallog im haasham bimkom shechitato vatztzafon vehaya mezumman sham:
Letoch kappo shel chavero. mishshum dichtiv veyatzak al kaf hakkohen, mashma shehakkohen haose et hahazzaot haya yotzek al kaf kohen acher:

Keneged bet kadshe hakkodashim. mishshum shenneemar sheva peamim lifne Adonai. velo shehaya machnis et hashshemen bahechol lehazzot keneged happarochet, ella vaazara haya omed vehaya hofech panav letzad bet kodesh hakkodashim umazze al karka haazara:
Al kol hazzaa tevila. al kol paam shemmazze tovel etzbao vashshemen, velo sheyyitbol etzbao faam achat veyazze meotah tevila shetayim veshalosh hazzaot. desheva peamim, attevilat etzbao nammi kae:
Ben shennatan ben shello natan kipper. utehar gavra:
Umaalin alav keillu lo chipper. kamme shemayya, shello asa mitzva min hammuvchar. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri:
Chasar hallog. shemen shel metzora:
Ad shello yatzak. lechappo hassemalit, yemalleenna. velo amrinan dekava leh hallog shehu cheli sharet, ella yetzika kava:
Ad shello natan. sheva mattanot. desavar rabbi shimon mattan sheva kava, velo yetzika. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Echad hannichnas laazara. rishona:
Veechad hannichnas lattosefet. shehosifu aleha achare chen:
Sheen mosifin vechulei. lefichach hi kedosha karishona:

Ella vemelech. deamar kera (Shemot 25) kechol asher ani mare otcha et tavnit hammishkan veet tavnit kol kelav vechen taasu, kera yetera hu lemidrash ledorot. uvime moshe hu melech venavi veachiv kohen gadol vehayu sham urim vetummim veshivim zekenim, af ledorot ken:

Uvishte todot. bishne lachame toda. vehayu nosim otan behekkef saviv ad sof haggevul shemmekaddeshim, vesham ochlim haachat vesorfim hashsheniyya, veal pi navi neechelet veal pi navi nisrefet. vehayenu ditnan happenimit neechelet vehachitzona nisrefet. uminnechemya ben chachalya gamar, dichtiv beh (Nechemya 12) vaaamida shete todot gedolot:

Uveshir. hashshir shehayu omrim aromimcha Adonai‏ ki dillitani (tehillim 30). uvayit sheni af al pi shello haya sham lo melech velo urim vetummim, hakkedushsha shekkiddesh shelomo habbayit barishona kadsha lishatah vekadsha leatid lavo. vaavoda dinchemya ben chachalya lezecher bealma hava:

Yotze dofen pesula. kishar kadashim. dichtiv [vayyikra 22] ki yivvaled, perat leyotze dofen. veaf al gav defara lav kadshe mizbeach hi ella kadshe vedek habbayit, mikkol makom yotze dofen pesula, dechattat karye rachamana:
Rabbi eliezer machshir. beetnan umechir davka. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Kol hammumin happoslim bammukdashim. bivchorot perek al ellu mumin, meforashim hammumin happesulin bammukdashim:
Poslim bappara. dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) asher en bah mum:
Avar bah et hannahar achaz biznavah. nistayya bah kesheavar et hannahar:
Kippel aleha et hammosera. hachevel shekkosher otah bo kippelo unetano al gufah:

Natan tallito aleha pesula. neemar befara (sham) asher lo ala aleha ol, veneemar beegla arufa (Devarim 21) asher lo ubbad bah asher lo mashcha beol, ma ol haamur beegla asa shear avoda fesula keol, af ol haamur befara asa shear avoda fesula keol:
Bishvil shello tachalik. shello yachaliku ragleha vetippol:
Letzorech acher pesula. vaafillu letzarko uletzarkah pesula:

Lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid. veyittol mafteach hammunnach birshut harabbim veyiftach bo petach hachanut hammunnach birshut harabbim, veaf al pi sheen mimmekom hammafteach ad happetach arba ammot, gezera shemma yachnis hammafteach etzlo:
Ella im ken asu lo mechitztza. veyaamod betochah veyiftach veyinol:

Amru lo vahalo maase veshuk shel pattamim. shemauhu rabbanan lerabbi meir dechi hechi deamar lo yaamod birshut hayyachid veyiftach birshut harabbim vechulei‏ hachi nammi kaamar lo yaamod adam becharmelit veyiftach birshut hayyachid, birshut hayyachid veyiftach becharmelit, umishshum hachi ka motve leh mishshuk shel pattamim shehaya birushalayim, decharmelit hi, kevan sheddaltoteha neulot ballayla lo mikkarya reshut harabbim, vehachallon shemmannichin bo hammafteach haya reshut hayyachid, vehayu omdin bakkarmelit ufotchin birshut hayyachid:
Pattamin. tabbachim shemmefattemim behemot lishchot. veen halacha kerabbi meir lo birshut harabbim velo becharmelit:
Shel tzammarim. mochre tzemer:
Bacharoset. davar sheyyesh bo chometz umayim veasuy letabbel bo basar:
Veim natan. letoch hachardal:
Yochal miyyad. shehachardal chad veeno memaher lehachemitz kemo hacharoset. aval bacharoset mode tanna kamma lerabbi meir deasur:
Verabbi meir oser. af im natan letoch hachardal, desavar chardal lealtar machmitz kemo hacharoset. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Lo vemashkin velo veme ferot. dichtiv (Shemot 12) uvashel mevushshal, mikkol makom:

Aval sachin umatbilin. leachar tzeliyyato, velo amrinan dimvattel taamo. i nammi afillu kodem tzeliyyato share lasuch happesach beme ferot, dehachi tenan bechetzad tzolin (lekamman 87 43), sacho beshemen teruma im chavurat kohanim yochelu:
Me tashmisho shel nachtom. shemmetzannen bahen yadav beshaa shemmekattef et hammatztza:
Yishshafchu. bimkom midron, shello yishshaaru mechunnasim bemakom echad veyachmitzu:
Lo layyam. im hu veir hayyoshevet al sefat hayyam:
Velo lammidbar. im hair yoshevet etzel hammidbar:
Shenneemar veshillach et hatztzippor hachayya el michutz lair el pene hassade. mikkan sheeno hofech panav lair:

Heevir taar al kol besaro. lav davka. shello haya megalleach ella kol mekom kinnus sear, [venire, laafoke sear] bet hassetarim, deamar kera (Vayikra 14) vehaya vayyom hashshevii yegallach et kol searo, kelal. et rosho veet zekano veet gabbot enav, perat. veet kol searo yegalleach, chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal, i atta dan ella keen happerat. ma happerat meforash mekom kinnus sear venire, af kol mekom kinnus sear venire. vetiglachat rishona shemmegalleach bizman chilluto, lemaduha bigzera shava mittiglachat sheniyya, shemmegalleach sheniyya leachar shessafar shivat yamim, deneemar bime chilluto vegillach et kol searo vegomer, veneemar bime safro yegallach et kol searo vegomer, ma tiglachat haamura vime safro perat levet hassetarim, af tiglachat haamura vime gamro perat levet hassetarim:
Tahor milletamme bevia. umilletamme mishkav umoshav, kederech shehaya metamme vime chilluto:
Metamme chashsheretz. letamme adam uvegadim bemagga, aval lo vemassa:

Menudde beveto. leinyan ze sheasur betashmish hammitta, dichtiv (Vayikra 14) veyashav michutz leoholo, veen oholo ella ishto, vechen hu omer (Devarim 5) shuvu lachem leoholechem, keshehittir lahem tashmish hammitta leachar maamad har sinay:
Mimehem shel kohanim lo nimneu. mishshum devae lemitne sefa middivrehem lamadnu shessorfin teruma tehora im hattemea nakat la hacha:

Millisrof et habbasar shennitma vivlad hattuma. bevalad shel valad kaamar. kelomar habbasar shehu shelishi shennitma vesheni lattuma, shehu valad shel valad, lo nimneu millesarfo im habbasar shennitma veav hattuma shehu rishon lattuma. ucheshennogea ze habbasar shehaya mittechillato shelishi babbasar shennitma veav hattuma chozer lihyot sheni, shehare naga barishon venaasa sheni, venimtza shehosifu lo tuma al tumato, demeikkara shelishi vehasheta sheni. veaf al pi chen lo nimneu millesarfo im chamur mimmennu, dehoil veaf ze hakkal lisrefa omed lo chashu im metammein oto yoter mimma shehaya. veaf al pi sheen ochel metamme ochel min hattora, shenneemar betumat ochalin (Devarim 14) tame hu, hu tame veeno metamme ochel kayyotze vo, mikkol makom rabbanan gazru sheyyihye ochel metamme ochel:
Hashshemen. shel teruma:
Shennifsal bitvul yom. hu shelishi lattuma, ditvul yom posel et hatteruma min hattora veose otah shelishi leolam, lo shena ochalin velo shena mashkin:

Bener shennitma vitme met. hay ner shel mattechet hu. vechol kelim chutz mikkele cheres shennagu vetumat met naasu chemotah, im av av, im rishon rishon, dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) bachalal cherev, vedarshinan cherev hare hu chechalal, shehacherev shennaga bemet naase avi avot kammet atzmo, ucheshennaga bitme met shehu av naase gam ken hacherev av, vehu haddin lechol shear kelim chutz mikkele cheres. nimtza hanner shel mattechet shennaga bitme met, naase av hattuma. vehasheta hosif rabbi akiva al divre rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim, sherabbi chanina lo hittir ella lehachezir hashshelishi sheni, verabbi akiva hittir lehachezir hashshelishi rishon, shehashshemen shennifsal bitvul yom shehu shelishi, keshemmadlikin oto bener shennitma vitme met, shehanner atzmo naase av kemo sheamarnu, nimtza shechozer hashshelishi lihyot rishon, veaf al pi chen lo nimneu, dehoil veyesh shem tuma alav lo chayshinan leh umuttar lehosif beyadayim:
Machazirin tzir hattachton. shel delet, shekkol zeman shello yatza haelyon noach lehacheziro veen kan binyan:
Aval lo vammedina. gezera shemma yitka, dahave melacha:
Vehaelyon kan vechan asur. dechevan deyatza elyon kullo nofel, vahava leh kevone:
Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. disvira leh en binyan bechelim velekka ella shevut, uvammikdash lo gazru al hashshevut. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Kohen motzio vehemyano. beshabbat. velo chayshinan letiltul, deen shevut bammikdash:

Behemyano. beavneto. veaf al gav dimtamme leh laavnet shehu kadosh, hachi adif, shello lehashehot et hattuma baazara lechazzer achar hatztzevat shel etz. uveyadav lo naga beh, delo nitme chohen gufeh, hilkach behemyano ochazo delo naga. vesheretz eno metamme bemassa, vehaavnet shennitma bashsheretz eno metamme et hakkohen kesheochazo, dahava leh avnet rishon lattuma, veen adam vechelim mekabbelin tuma ella meav hattuma:
Tzevat shel etz. shehi peshute kele etz veen mekabbelim tuma:
Shello lerabbot et hattuma. letamme avnet hattahor, venoach lo lehashehotah sham ulechazzer achar hatztzevat millerabbot et hattuma. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Mehechan motziin oto. beshabbat:
Min hahechol umin haulam. aval baazara im nimtza sham mechasse oto bifsachter umannicho ad shettechshach:
Kol makom shechayyavin al zedono karet. im yikkanes lo betuma, dehaynu kol haazara, mishsham motziin oto:
Ushear kol hammekomot kofin alav pesachter. sir shel nechoshet. targum shel sirotav pesachteravateh. lechassoto ad shettechshach. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:

Rabbi shimon omer mekom shehittiru lecha chachamim vechulei. rabbi shimon paleg attanna kamma dilel deamar koshrim nima bammikdash, vesavar deen koshrim nimat kinnor shennifseka ella baaniva shehi asura mishshum shevut bilvad vei efshar sheyyavo bah lide chiyyuva deorayta, aval lo koshrin bekesher sheefshar lavo bo lide chiyyuva deorayta. vaamar leh rabbi shimon letanna kamma, al titma alay sheani machmir kan vegabbe techumin ani mekel tefe veomer sheafillu yatza chutz lattechum chamesh esre amma yikkanes (kedilel 84 51), degabbe techumin mishshellecha natnu lecha, mishshum deyadinan sheotam chamesh esre amma enam chutz lattechum, shemmodde hattechumin hakkovin simanin besof hattechum kim lan begavvayhu sheen kovin hattechum besof alpayim mammash ella konsin letoch hattechum mippene hattoin sheen makkirin hassiman ufeamim yotzim lehallan mimmennu meat vechozrin, umishshum hachi ani mekel battechumim, aval likshor nima bammikdash, shello hittiru bammikdash ella issur shevut lo chiyyuva deorayta, ani machmir veomer dedavka aniva sheyyesh bah issur shevut hittiru, aval likshor kesher mammash sheppeamim yesh bo chiyyuva deorayta lo. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Shevuot shetayim. ketive vikra vehedya (Vayikra 5) o nefesh ki tishshava levatte visfatayim lehara o lehetiv. ochal, lehetiv. lo ochal, lehara, shemmeanne et atzmo. vehu haddin lechol davar shehu hen velav lehabba, dilhara o lehetiv lehabba mashma:
Shehen arba. yesh lerabbot od shetayim acherim delo chetive. vehen, hen velav dilsheavar. kemo achalti velo achal, o lo achalti veachal:
Yediot hattuma. o nefesh asher tigga bechol davar tame (sham), haamur bevayyikra etzel tumat mikdash vekadashav:
Shetayim. ketive vikra. dichtiv (sham) venelam mimmennu vehu tame, mashma shenneelma mimmennu tuma veal yede oto helem achal besar kodesh, hare achat. o nichnas lammikdash, hare shetayim:
Shehen arba. yesh lerabbot od shenayim chiyyuvim acherim. helem kodesh, vehelem mikdash, vezachur hu et hattuma:
Yetziot hashshabbat. hotzaa mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim, yalfinan mikkera min vaytzav moshe vayyaaviru kol bammachane vegomer‏ (Shemot 36), lo tappiku mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim:
Shetayim. achat laomed bachutz vehoshit yado lifnim venatal hachefetz vehotzio, veachat laomed bifnim venatal hachefetz mimmekomo vehotzio lachutz:

Shehen arba. yesh lehosif od shetayim dehachnasa, af al gav delo chetive. shekkeshem shehikpida tora mershut lirshut behotzaa, kach hikpida al hahachnasa. achat laomed bifnim vehotzi yado lachutz venatal chefetz vehichnis, veachat laomed bachutz venatal chefetz mimmekomo vehoshito lifnim vehinnicho:
Marot negaim shenayim. ketive vakkera (Vayikra 13), seet uvaheret:
Shehen arbaa. tolada diset vetolada devaheret, delo chetive vakkera vehedya:

Rabbi eliezer omer para meubberet keshera. rabbi eliezer verabbanan dehacha kayme veshitat rabbi yehuda deamar lekamman befirkin deala aleha zachar enah pesula ella im ken ala aleha middaat baal happara, ufelige hacha bimubberet sheala aleha zachar meatzmo belo daat habbealim. verabbi eliezer demachshir savar ubbar yerech immo hu vehave chegufah defara, verabbanan defasle savre ubbar lav yerech immo hu venifselet mechamat melacha, shennoset et ubbarah. vahalacha shehi fesula mishshaa sheala aleha zachar afillu shello middaat bealim vaafillu enah meubberet, udelo cherabbi yehuda:
Enah nilkachat min hannachrim. shechashudim al harvia, veshemma nirbaat beyadam:
Vachachamim machshirin. mippene shehabbehema naaset akara kesherovah, shehannachri chas al behemto shello teaker:

Velo zo vilvad. lo vefarat chattat bilvad pelige rabbi eliezer verabbanan, ella vechol karbenot hatztzibbur vehayyachid posel rabbi eliezer im nilkechu min hannachrim, dechayesh lirvia. vachachamim machshirin. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Bain mehaaretz umichutza laaretz. kol hakkarbanot bain ben min haaretz ben michutza laaretz ben min hechadash ben min hayyashan:

Chutz min haomer ushete hallechem. deamar kera (Vayikra 23) ki tavou el haaretz uketzartem et ketzirah vahavetem et omer, uvishte hallechem ketiv (sham) mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem. veen bain ella min hechadash, dichtiv behu mincha chadasha:

Kol shaa shemmuttar leechol. middelo kaamar kol shaa sheochel maachil, venakat la bitre lishane, mashma deattere gavre kae. vehachi kaamar, kol shaa shemmuttar lakkohen leechol batteruma maachil yisrael chullin livhemto. umatnitin rabban gamliel hi, sherabban gamliel omer chullin neechalin kol arba uteruma kol chamesh. velet hilcheta chevateh, ella ben bitruma ben bechullin ochlin kol arba vetolin kol chamesh vesorfin bitchillat shesh:

Maachil labbehema lachayya velaofot. tzeriche, dei tana vehema, hava amena behema dei meshayyera chazi la umevaer leh in, aval chayya kegon nemiyya vechatul vechulda deorcha lehatzenia ema lo. vei tana chayya, hava amena chayya dei meshayyera matznea leh velo avar aleh al bal yerae ema in, aval behema zimnin dimshayyera velav addateh levaaro veavar aleh al bal yerae ema lo, ka mashma lan. veofot, ayde detana behema vechayya, tana nammi ofot:
Umochro lannachri. laafoke mibbet shammay deamre lo yimkor adam chametzo lenachri ella im ken yodea bo sheyyichle kodem happesach, dekasavre metzuvve ani levaaro min haolam velo sheyyihye kayyam:
Umuttar bahanaato. bahanaat efro. kegon im characho vaur kodem zeman issuro muttar lehanot beefro afillu leachar zeman issuro:

Avar zemanno. mishshehiggia shaa shishshit, af al pi sheen issuro ella middivre sofrim, asur bahanaato keillu haya meissure hanaa shel tora. sheim kiddesh bo ishsha en choshshin lekiddushav, vaafillu bechametz nukshe, kegon dagan shennafal alav delef vechayyotze vo, shebbefesach atzmo en issuro ella middivre sofrim, im kiddesh bo ishsha beyom arbaa asar mishshehiggia shaa shishshit en choshshin lekiddushav:

Velo yassik bo tannur vechirayim. lerabbi yehuda itzterich, deamar en biur chametz ella serefa, mahu detema bahade deka saref leh lithane minneh, ka mashma lan delo, daafillu chederech biuro asur lehanot mimmennu mikki meta zeman issureh:

Rabbi yehuda omer en biur chametz ella serefa. deyalef minnotar deasur bahanaa veanush karet kechametz, umitzvato visrefa velo vedavar acher. verabbanan lo yalfe minnotar, dechelev shel shor hanniskal yochiach, sheasur baachila uvahanaa veanush karet, veeno taun serefa:
Al haammud. shehu nautz bakkarka zakuf vegavoah kede lehishshaen alav:
Vechazzan. shammash sheliach bet din:
Nifremu. nikreu chute hattefira:
Meachorav. shel halloke:
Uretzua shel egel. shenneemar arbaim yakkennu, usemich leh lo tachsom shor bedisho:
Kefula lishnayim ushenayim learbaa. arba retzuot tefurot zo al gabbe zo:
Ushete retzuot. dakkot shel chamor:

Olot veyordot bah. keen kilkele shel ukkaf. vetaama, mishshum dichtiv (yeshaya 1) yada shor konehu vachamor evus bealav, amar hakkadosh baruch hu, yavo mi shemmakkir evus bealav veyippara mimmi sheeno makkir evus bealav:
Ad arba ammot. kasavar rabbi shimon, lemala mearba ammot reshuta acharita hu, dekomato shel adam benoni shalosh ammot, veamma achat lefishshut yadayim veraglayim. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Kelim miyyad temeim. kelomar kelim sheamarnu ad hakkorot letanna kamma vead arba ammot lerabbi shimon, miyyad hen mittammein keshennichnas immahen labbayit hamenugga:

Kede hadelakat hanner. keshennichnas birshut, mode rabbi yehuda demittammein miyyad, velo faleg ella keshennichnas shello virshut. mishshum demoshavo shel metzora metamme kedaamaran, ucheshennichnas birshut have moshavo miyyad, aval keshennichnas shello birshut lo have moshavo ella im ken shaha kede hadelakat hanner velo appekeh. veim lo shaha kede hadelakat hanner, lo have moshavo. dehay delo appekeh, mishshum detarid behadelakat hanner devene shimshe o dimot hachol velo matze mappik leh:
Vesamach shete yadav alav. vekodem semicha haya taun tenufa, sheasham metzora taun tenufa chay:
Veechad bayyad. dichtiv (Vayikra 14) velakach hakkohen venatan al tenuch ozen hammittaher, ma netina beatzmo shel kohen, af kabbala beatzmo shel kohen:

Eno tzarich tevila. shekkevar taval mibbaerev, kedichtiv (sham) vehaya vayyom hashshevii yegallach vegomer‏ vechibbes begadav verachatz besaro bammayim. vachachamim omrim, hoil vehaya alul letuma, shemma lo shamar atzmo vetohora karauy venitma achar shettaval, lefichach tzarich tevila acheret missafek. vahalacha kachachamim:

Sheyyesh bah yedia vattechilla. ayyediot hattuma kae. veayde dezutere millayhu mefaresh lehu varesha vahadar mefaresh shevuot dinfishe millayhu. vitziot umarot, kol chada vachada mipparsha vemassechet dideh, lehachi lo farshinhu behay massechta. velo teninhu hacha ella mishshum dedamu lahadade bishtayim shehen arba:
Yedia vattechilla. sheyyada shennitma:
Vidia vassof. mishsheachal et hakkodesh behelem o nichnas lammikdash behelem veyatza, noda lo shebbetuma achal o betuma nichnas:
Vehelem bentayim. kesheachal et hakkodesh neelma mimmennu tuma o kodesh, o nichnas lammikdash veneelma mimmennu tuma o mikdash:
Hare ze beole veyored. ole leashir, veyored leani. ashir mevi chattat behema, veani chattat haof, vedal shebbaddallim asirit haefa, vehi minchat chote haamura bechol makom:
Sair hannaase vifnim. sair shel yom hakkippurim shemmevi middamo lifnim:
Tole. lehagin alav min hayyissurin:
Ad sheyyivvada lo. sheachal kodesh betuma veyavi karban ole veyored:
Or learbaa asar. layil shellemochorato yihye arbaa asar. vekore hattanna lallayla or kederech shekkorin leivver saggi nehor, velishana mealya nakat:

Bodkin et hechametz. it dimfarshe taama divdika kede shello yaavor al bal yerae uval yimmatze im yihye chametz beveto befesach. veaf al gav divvittul bealma saggi, chayshinan shemma yimtza geluseka yefehfiyya veyimmalech al bittulo veyachshov aleha leachlah, veyaavor alav al bal yerae uval yimmatze, hilkach bodkim et hechametz kede levaaro min haolam. veit deamre taama divdika gezera shemma yimtza chametz beveto befesach veyochlennu, kevan sheen ragil lihyot badel mimmennu kol shear yemot hashshana:

Leor hanner. baggemara yalef divdikat chametz tzericha shettehe leor hanner, middichtiv hacha (Shemot 12) seor lo yimmatze, uchetiv hatam (Bereshit 40) vayyimmatze haggavia, ma metzia haamura sham al yede chippus, shenneemar vaychappes vechulei‏ vayimmatze, af metzia haamura chan al yede chippus, vechippus have vener dichtiv (Mishlei 20) ner Adonai‏ nishmat adam chofes kol chadre vaten. vetikkenu habbedika vallayla mippene shebballayla kol haam metzuyim bevattehem, veor hanner yafe livdika vallayla yoter mibbayyom, dishraga vetihara lemay mehanneya. umihu im lo vadak lel arbaa asar uvodek bearbaa asar shacharit tzarich sheyyivdok nammi leor hanner:
Velama amru. lekamman bematnitin:

Shete shurot. shel chaviyyot hassedurot zo al gabbe zo bemartef shel yayin tzarich livdok benehen, achar sheamarnu kol makom sheen machnisin bo chametz en tzarich livdok, lama hitzrichu levadkan. umeshane, lo amru ella vemartef shemmachnisin bo chametz, kemo martef shemmistappek mimmennu yayin leshulchano, ufeamim shehashshammash omed limzog ufitto veyado, ucheshehayyayin kale nichnas bammartef lehavi yayin:

Shete shurot al pene [chol] hammartef. derech otzre yayin lesadder chaviyyotehen shurot shurot ad shemmemallein kol karkait hammartef, vechozrin umannichin chavit al chavit, kashshurot hattachtonot kach shurot haelyonot ad sheme hakkora. ushete shurot sheamru bet shammay hem shura chitzona min haaretz ad sheme kora, vechozer uvodek hechaviyyot haelyonot al pene arko verachbo shel martef, nimtzeu shete shurot kemin gam yevanit, shura achat bizkifa veshura achat bishchiva:

Shete shurot hachitzonot. hashshura haelyona hassemucha lishme kora haroa pene happetach, veshellematta hemenna. veotan shellifnim eno vodek kelal. umin hachitzonot eno vodek ella shete haelyonot bilvad:
Veyishte virshut harabbim. vehane mille bechelim shehem tzerichin lo, degazrinan dilma ate leatoyinhu, aval bechelim sheen tzerichin lo muttar, vaafillu lo hichnis rosho verubbo birshut harabbim:
Vechen begat. leinyan maaser, sheim hichnis rosho verubbo baggat shote belo maaser, dahave shetiyyat aray, vechutz laggat eno rashshay lishtot belo maaser, dahave shetiyyat keva:
Kolet. tofes, kelomar mekabbel min hammayim hannizchalim veshote:

Hammazchela. kemin binyan midron asuy samuch lakkotel, shezzochalin bo hammayim. ulehachi nikret mazchela, shekkol davar hamehallech verochesh al gabbe hakkotel o al gabbe karka nikra zochel, kidamur (Devarim 32) zochale afar:

Lematta measara tefachim. garsinan. vehachi kaamar, omed adam birshut harabbim vekolet bichli lematta measara tefachim min hammayim hayyordin min hammazchela. vekolet davka, kedimfaresh baggemara, aval lo yetzaref vichabber piv o hakkeli lemazchela shehi befachot mishshelosha samuch laggag, veaf al pi shehi lematta measara, mikkol makom hoil umuttelet leorech hakkotel uvetoch shelosha laggag have kegag, vehave kemotzi min haggag shehu reshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim:

Umin hatztzinnor mikkol makom. kelomar ben kolet ben metzaref, mishshum detzinnor leolam bolet hu veyotze lirshut harabbim. uvaggemara moke la kesheen batztzinnor arbaa al arbaa, sheeno cholek reshut leatzmo:
Neger. keen beriach shettochavim bakkotalim o baaskuppa linol bo haddelet:

Gelustera. sherosho ave veagol kemin rimmon, veasuy kevuchena sherauy laduch bo pilpelin. veaf al gav detorat keli alav, oser rabbi eliezer ella im ken kashur vetaluy baddelet, verabbi yose mattir, vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Nichnas levet hakkeneset. metzora shebba likkanes levet hakkeneset:
Osim lo mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim. defachot measara enah chashuva mechitztza lehatztzil:
Berochav arba ammot. keneged arba ammot shel tefilla. i nammi, mishshum dezehu shiur mekomo shel adam, kidamrinan beeruvin beferek mi shehotziuhu [daf moach]:

Nichnas rishon veyotze acharon. kede shello yittammeu haomdim bevet hakkeneset bichnisato uvitziato, keshehu over min happetach vead hammechitztza. dechayshinan shemma yaamod meat beshaa shehu over, veyittammeu kol haomdim sham:
Kol hammatztzil betzamid patil. kegon keli cheres vechol hanehu dachashiv bemassechet kelim perek veellu chelim matztzilim:
Kol hammatztzil mechusse veohel hammet. kegon bor vedut delo vae tzamid patil ella chissuy, keditnan bemassechet ohalot perek hattannur (mishna 6). vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Mitzvatan sheyyihyu shavot. delichtov rachamana tzipporim, umiut tzipporim shetayim. shete dechatav rachamana lamma li, ella lelammed sheyyihyu shetehem shavot:
Venimtzet terefa kulei. dechayyot ketiv [sham yad], perat litrefot:
Tamut hammishtallachat. yannichenna ad shettamut meeleha:

Chayyav al kol achat veechat. middekaamar pat ufat al kol min vamin, shema minna lechallek. dei leesor alav minim hallalu vetu lo, hava leh lememar pat chittim vechen shel seorim vechen shel kussemin:
Yediot hattuma. nitma veyada shennitma. bishat tuma o achare chen:

Neelma mimmennu tuma. veal yede oto helem achal kodesh, hare achat. venichnas lammikdash, hare shetayim. dichtiv venelam mimmennu vehu tame, mashma shennitallema mimmennu tuma. ulefi sheeno chayyav aleha ella im ken yada vattechilla shennitma veachar kach neelma mimmennu, mishshum hachi kare la yediot:
Nelam mimmennu hakkodesh. o hammikdash, veachal kodesh o nichnas lammikdash, vezachur lattuma. hare shetayim acherot delo chetive:
Nelam mimmennu ze vaze. eno mimminyan hayediot, ella ha kamashma lan deaf al gav devishat achilat kodesh o chenisat mikdash eno zachur lo lattuma velo lakkodesh, chayyav karban ole veyored:
Vechelav al ketefo. mekuppalim umunnachim al ketefo derech masseoy:
Vetabbeotav beyadav. munnachim al pas yado shello chederech malbush:
Hu vahen temein miyyad. dekarinan nammi vechelim vehabba el habbayit yitma:
Haya lavush bechelav. dehashta en kelav temeim ella mechamat dideh:

Vehen tehorim ad sheyyishhe bichde achilat peras. dichtiv vehaochel babbayit yechabbes et begadav vehashshochev babbayit yechabbes et begadav, vetanya, en li ella ochel veshochev, lo ochel velo shochev minnayin, talmud lomar yechabbes begadav, ribba. im ken lamma neemar ochel veshochev, litten shiur labba el habbayit sheen taun kibbus begadim ad sheyyishhe kede shiur achila keshehu shochev, kelomar keshehu mesev. vechamma shiur achila, kede achilat peras, shehu chatzi chikkar shel eruv, ledivre Rashi hem arba betzim, uledivre rambam shalosh betzim:
Mesev veochel beliftan. sheshshiuro muat mishsheillu [haya] ochlan belo liftan, shemmittoch taam shel liftan memaher leechol:

Hakkol holech achar chattat. divchattat veola chaluk heashir veheani, deashir mevi min habbehema, veani mevi min haof, shete torim o shene bene yona. hilkach im bishat hakeravat hachattat haya ani vehevi chattat haof, af al pi sheheeshir achar kach, mashlim karban ani umevi olat haof. vechen im haya ashir vehevi chattat behema, af al pi sheheeni, tzarich lehavi olat behema:

Rabbi yehuda omer achar haasham. divasham shavin ani veashir, vehu rishon lekarbenot hammetzora, umeyuchad letohorato yoter mikkullan. ushenehem mikra echad darshu, dichtiv (Vayikra 14) asher lo tassig yado betohorato, rabbi shimon savar, davar hamechappero, vehu hachattat. verabbi yehuda savar, davar hammachshiro umetaharo, vehu haasham. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Shete challot. shel chametz:

Shel toda fesulot. shennifselu velina. shemmittoch shehen merubbot lachame toda bishlosha asar benisan, shekkol mi sheyyesh lo toda lehavi meviah bishlosha asar, nifsalot belina levoker shel arbaa asar. lachame toda arbaim challot, asara mehen chametz. vetoda neechelet leyom valayla, veim hayu meviim otam bearbaa asar en neechalot shel chametz ella ad shesh shaot, veasur lehavi karban beyom sheyyitmaet zeman achilato, sheen meviin kadashim levet happesul, hilkach kol mi shehaya alav karban toda meviah bishlosha asar, divarbaa asar lo yuchal lahaviah, vechol shekken befesach, venifselu velina leyom arbaa asar lefi shello hayu lahem ochlim kol kach, umishshum hachi difsulot hayu netunot sham, sheim hayu chesherot lo hayu notnim otam sham lefaslam beyadayim:
Shemmunnachot. sham ad zeman habbiur venisrafot:
Al gag haitztabba. shehaya vehar habbayit. kede sheyyiru otam sham lesiman:
Nittela achat mehen. bitchillat shaa chamishshit ba sheliach bet din venotel haachat, vechol haam makkirim shehiggia shaa chamishshit vetolin:
Uteruma kol chamesh. deasur lehafesid kadashim bayyadayim kol zeman sheyyachol leachlam:
Vesorfin bitchillat shesh. dehashta vadday rubba tau ben shesh lesheva. veen halacha kerabban gamliel:
En omdin oto vechulei. shekkol hallokin bevet din hayu tzerichin leamdan bitchilla shello yamutu mechamat hahakkaot. middichtiv lo yosif, mikkelal sheim tzarich ligroa gorin:
Ella vemakkot haruyot lehishtallesh. veen mosifin leolam al haomed:
Amaduhu lekabbel arbaim. chaser achat. ella lishna dikra nakat:
Amaduhu omed echad. lishte malkuyyot. kegon amaduhu lilkot arbaim ushetayim:
Veim lav. shello amaduhu ella lemalkut achat:
Echad yisrael veechad kohanim. hachi kaamar, echad yisrael veechad kohanim veechad kohen mashuach mitkapperim besair hammishtalleach bishar averot, veen chilluk benehen:

Ella sheddam happar mechapper al hakkohanim al tumat mikdash vekadashav. kol ma shessair happenimi mechapper al yisrael, dehaynu teliyyat yisrael al sheyyesh bah yedia vattechilla veen bah yedia vassof uzedon tumat mikdash vekadashav, vechen kapparat sair hachitzon paro shel kohen gadol hakkarev beyom hakkippurim mechapper al hakkohanim:

Rabbi shimon omer keshem. sheatta mode bedam hassair happenimi shemmechapper al yisrael kapparato belo shum vidduy, sheen vidduy bassair happenimi ella vassair hammishtalleach, kach dam happar belo shum vidduy mechapper al hakkohanim al tumat mikdash vekadashav. aytar leh vidduyo shel par bimkom vidduy shel sair hammishtalleach lechapper al hakkohanim bishar averot, veen lahem kappara bassair hammishtalleach:

Zot shaalu anshe alekkesanderiyya et rabbi yehoshua. metzora sheni shehu vachayyim ma tehe alav, heach yithar leechol bakkadashim, sheillu haya metzora haacher chay, af al pi shennitarvu karbenotehen ze yikrav leshem mi shehu veze yikrav leshem mi shehu. o im met haechad vehayu shene hakkarbanot lefanenu, hayu hakkarbanot metim veze makriv karban acher. aval hasheta eno yachol lehakeriv et ze, deshemma shel met hu vehaveya chattat shemmetu vealeha dilmita azla. vekarban acher nammi eno yachol lehavi, deshemma oto shekkarav haya shello veniftar, venimtza mevi chullin laazara. veeno yachol lehatenot bindava, sheen chattat baa nedava:

Yichtov nechasav leacher. vehave ani verauy lehavi karban dallut, vechattat haof baa al hassafek veen bah mishshum chullin baazara. veim eno mafkir nechasav vehevi chattat haof, lo tahar, deashir shehevi karban ani lo yatza. umin haasham shemmevi lekka leakshoye hechi matze mayte asham besafek dilma chullin laazara mayte, dechevan deasham shavin mattenotav lishlamim, yachol lehavi asham ulehatnot, im ani chayyav asham yehe ze leasham, veim lav, shekkarav asham shelli, yehe ze lishlamim, ma sheeno yachol laasot ken bechattat, sheen mattenot damim shel chattat shavot lishlamim, demattan damim shel chattat [arba mattanot] lemala michut hassikra, ushelamim [shete mattanot] lematta michut hassikra:
Yagod. yachtoch. kemo goddu ilana (Daniel 4):
Vehannanneset. ketanna veyoter. shezze mum baadam veeno mum babbehema:
Yabbelet. 224 belaaz:
Rabbi yehuda fosel. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Bodkin or arbaa asar uvearbaa asar shacharit. hachi kaamar, beechad mishshelosha ferakim hallalu vilvad bodkim, uleachar shelosha ferakim hallalu im lo vadak shuv eno vodek:
Betoch hammoed. beshaa shishshit shehu moed habbiur:

Leachar hammoed. ad shettechshach. veit dimfarshe betoch hammoed, betoch happesach. leachar hammoed, leachar happesach. kede shello yitarev lo chametz sheavar alav happesach shehu asur bahanaa bechametz shel hetter shennaasa leachar happesach. verabbi yehuda savar leachar habbiur, dehaynu leachar zeman issuro shel chametz, lo yivdok kelal dilma ate lemechal minneh. verabbanan amre yivdok leachar zeman issuro, velo chayshinan dilma ate lemechal minneh kevan shekkol atzmo mechazzer alav lesarfo. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Vehaleviyyim. beet shennivcharu lesherut bammidbar, veenah noheget ledorot:

Kirvia kera hammitta. kedimfaresh veazel, shemmechallek kera hammitta lishnayim, veellu hashshenayim mechallekan learbaa, vezehu revia kera. veka mashma lan demitzva letzamtzem sheyyihye revia kera, lo fachot velo yoter:
Shem levay. shemmelavvin umechabberin oto ledavar acher. ezov yavan, ezov kochali, ezov romi:

Muttar bahanaa. lav lememra devaachila asur, ella ayde devae lemitna sefa veshel yisrael asur bahanaa, tana gabbe nachri muttar bahanaa. i nammi mishshum deikka denahage issura befat shel nachri, mishshum hachi lo tane vehedya chametz shel nachri muttar baachila:

Mishshum shenneemar lo yerae lecha. kelomar kenasa kansinan leh hoil veavar al lo yerae lecha. i nammi aresha kae, chametz shel nachri muttar, mishshum shenneemar lo yerae lecha, vedarshinan shellecha i atta roe, aval atta roe shel acherim:
Shehevi karban ashir yatza. [afillu lechattechilla mevi] vetavo alav beracha. veayde devae lemitne vassefa lo yatza, tana resha yatza:
Mevi adam al [yede] veno uvitto. af al pi shehu ashir, mevi alehem karban ani im hem aniyyim, vekarban ze metaharan leechol bazzevachim, kedaamaran hevi chapparato ochel bakkadashim:

Af al yede ishto mevi karban ashir. deishto shehi kegufo eno yachol lehavi aleha karban ani im hu ashir. velo karban metzora bilvad, ella hu haddin lechol karban shehi chayyevet, eno mevi aleha karban ani im hu ashir:
Mesech. shennofo note lematta mikkol tzedadav saviv:

Metaltelin tachtav. dechevan deen nofo gavoah min haaretz shelosha tefachim have lehu kilvudim laaretz, venimtzeu kimchitztzot, lefichach muttar letaltel tachtav. umikkol makom tzarich lemalot oto avir shebben hannof laaretz beteven vekash vechayyotze bo, velikshor hannofot shello yezizem haruach, dechol mechitztza sheenah yechola laamod beruach metzuya enah mechitztza. veen metaltelin bo ella bevet satayim shehem shivim amma veshirayim, shekkol mechitztza shettashmishah laavir, kelomar lishmor avir hassadot vehakkeramim velo ladur bah, en metaltelin bah ella bevet satayim:
Lo yeshev alehen. sheasur lehishtammesh beilan, gezera shemma yitlosh. vei lo gevihe shelosha hare hen kekarka umuttar leshev alehen:
Haddelet shebbammuktze. rechava sheachore habbattim, vehaddelet shellah enah kevua betzir kishar delatot ella zekufa keneged happetach, ucheshehu poteach metil haddelet al haaretz:
Vachadakim. kotzim shehitkinan kede listom bahem pirtza:

Vechen machatzalot. shel kanim, kol ellu enam keshurin veenan kevuin bimkoman, ella keshebbain liftoach metilin otan al haaretz, lefichach en noalin bahem, demechaze kevinyan, ella im ken gevohim min haaretz, deaz lo mechaze kevinyan venoalin bahen:

Hichnis rosho. lefi sheezrat yisrael en mechussar kippurim nichnas lah, vedam haasham haya nifsal beyotze im yatza chutz laazara, lefichach haya hammetzora omed beshaar nikkanor shehu ben ezrat nashim leezrat yisrael, umachnis rosho letoch haazara ad shennotnim hammattanot al tenuch azno, umachnis yado veraglo ad sheyyitten al behonotav:
Tenuch. ze gader haemtzai shel ozen:
Rabbi yehuda omer vechulei. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
En lo tohora olamit. devainan kedichtiv bakkera. vedavka shenniktea azno o vehonotav leachar shehuzkak letohora:
Rabbi eliezer omer noten hu al mekoman. delo vainan kedichtiv bakkera. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer. vechen en halacha kerabbi shimon deamar im natan al shel semol yatza:

Vehakkore kore. dichtiv (Vayikra 19) bikkoret tihye, bikria tehe, shekkorin alav im lo tishmor laasot vegomer. vegadol shebbaddayyanim kore, vehassamuch lo mone, vehashshelishi omer al kol hakkaa vehakkaa. umitzva al hakkore letzamtzem lehashelim hammikraot besof hammalkot, veim lo tzimtzem chozer vekore paam sheniyya umemaher likro ulehashlim kesheyyashlim hammalke lehalekot:
Veim met tachat yado patur. mippene shemmakkehu virshut:
Hosif lo. kegon detaa veminyana:
Nitkalkel. shehotzi rei mechamat hahakkaa:
Patur. dichtiv (Devarim 25) venikla achicha leenecha, vahare nikla, shennitlachlech:
Veishsha af bemayim. devashtah merubba. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Lefichach hirba lahem tora umitzvot. kegon parashat shekatzim uremasim, kede leharebot sachar keshehen bedelim mehem, af al pi shebbelav hachi lo hayu ochlin otan, shennafsho shel adam katza vahen:
Lemaan tzidko. lehatzedik et yisrael ulezakkot otan:

Nachri shehilva leyisrael. maot al chametzo kodem happesach, veamar lo hayyisrael im lo heveti lecha maot ad yom peloni kene meachshav. uchegon shehirhino etzlo beveto veshaha etzel hannachri kol yeme happesach.
Leachar happesach muttar bahanaato. dechevan dimta zimneh velo fareh lo have mechussar govayna, devirshuto shel nachri haya, iggallay milleta lemafrea demishshaa shehirhino etzlo hava dideh:
Veyisrael shehilva lannachri kulei. iggallay milleta lemafrea deshel yisrael hava:
Hare hu chimvoar. veaf al pi chen tzarich levattelo, shemma yefakkach haggal bammoed venimtza over alav:
Kol sheen hakkelev yachol lechappes acharav. vechamma hi chafisat hakkelev, shelosha tefachim:
Yede chovato. mishshum chovat matztza ballayla harishon, shehu mechuyyav leechol matztza dichtiv (Shemot 12) baerev tochlu matztzot:

Bechittim, bisorim vechulei. aval orez vedochan ushear minim lo, dichtiv (Devarim 16) lo tochal alav chametz shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot, devarim habbaim lide chimmutz adam yotze vahen yede chovat matztza, yatzu orez vedochan ushear minim sheen bain lide chimmutz ella lide sirchon:
Uvidmay uvemaaser rishon shennittela terumato. kol hane lemay itzterichu meforashim bemassechet shabbat perek mefannin (98 41):
Vehakkohanim bechalla uvitruma. demahu detema matztza hashshava ureuya lechol adam bainan, vechalla uteruma enan reuyin lezarim, ka mashma lan:

Challot toda urekike nazir en yotzin bahen. af al pi shehen matztza gemura, dichtiv (Shemot 12) ushemartem et hammatztzot, matztza hammishtammeret leshem matztza, yatzu ellu sheenan mishtammerot leshem matztza ella leshem zevach:
Limkor bashshuk yotze vahem. dechol limkor bashshuk amar i mizdavna mizdavna, vei lo, achelna la ana lematztza shel mitzva:
Nishba levattel et hammitzva vechulei‏ patur. mishshum shevuat bittuy. aval loke hu mishshum shevuat shav:

Shehaya vaddin sheyyihye chayyav kedivre rabbi yehuda ben betera. kelomar sheillu ledivre rabbi yehuda ben betera hu chayyav mishshum shevuat bittuy, shehaya rabbi yehuda ben betera omer ma im harshut vechulei:
Shello asa vah lav kehen. ukera chetiv lehara o lehetiv, demashma davar sheyyesh bo hen velav. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betera:

Ufar sheni ven bakar tikkach lechattat. betohorat haleviyyim ketiv [sham 8] befarashat behaalotcha. vehay sheni yetera hu, dechevan dichtiv batreh vaase et haechad chattat veet haechad ola, mimmela yadana ditre ninhu, ella chatuv sheni lelammed shehu ven shete shanim, dechi hechi dilvat shalosh kare shelashit, hachi nammi leven shetayim kare sheni:
Vachachamim omrim kulei. vahalacha kachachamim:

Miyyom leyom. nolad beechad beelul, lo shalma lo shana ad echad beelul shel shana sheniyya, devatar shenato azlinan, velo vatar shanim shel minyan haolam. veim nitabbera shana, nitabbera lo. vechen beelim bene shetayim:
Eno chasher lo leayil. deeno nechshav ayil ad sheyyikkanes sheloshim yom mishshana sheniyya lo:
Palgas. leshon peleg, kelomar memutztza ben ze laze, yatza mikkelal keves velichlal ayil lo va:
Noked. leshon asher haya vannokdim (Amos 1) shepperusho baale hatztzon:
Parchadigma. lematbea shennifsal korin ken belashon yevani. af ze nifsal mittorat ayil umittorat keves:
Mevi alav niske ayil. shelishit hahin. venafka lan middichtiv o laayil, lerabbot et happalgas leniske ayil:
Korech aleha gemi. veaf al pi shehaggemi merappe et hammakka, hoil vehasheta miha tzorech avoda hu, delav orach ara shettehe makkato niret im haavoda, umechasse otah begemi:
Aval lo vammedina. dirfua beshabbat shevut hi veasur:
Veim lehotzi dam. shemmehaddekah begemi kede lehotzi damah:
Kan vechan asur. dahava leh chovel veav melacha lo ishteri bammikdash:
Bozkim melach. kottim umefazzerim melach al gabbe hakkevesh sheolim bo lammizbeach, mippene shechalak hu ufeamim noflim mimmennu, shemmachlikim raglehem bo. bozkim, leshon ketita:
Aval lo vammedina. mippene shehu metakken:
Memalleim mayim mibbor haggola umibbor haggadol. kach sheman, ushenehem hayu bilshachot haazara:

Baggalgal. heasuy lehaalot bo haddeli al yede chavalim. umishshene borot hallalu bilvad hittiru lemalot mayim baggalgal beshabbat, aval bishar borot asur, gezera shemma yemalle leginnato ulechurvato, mittoch shemmemallein belo torach ate lehashekot bo ginnato vechurvato beshabbat. uvemakom delekka lemigzar shemma yashke mayim leginnato ulechurvato muttar lemalot baggalgal, velo chayshinan mippene shemmashmia kol, shello asru ella kol shel shir bilvad. vehachi nammi share lemitraf abbava umekash al tara beshabbat veen bechach kelum:

Umibbor hakkar. al shem shehaya beer mayim chayyim kore leh bor hakkar, leshon makor. uvor ze haya tzarich livne haggola baregel, vehittiru lahem neviim shebbenehem chaggay zecharya umalachi lemalot mimmennu baggalgal baregel, venishar behettero shemmemalleim mimmennu beyom tov begalgal af bammedina, ma sheen ken bishar beerot hannovim:
Mishshemo. shel rabbi shimon. usetam rabbi shimon hu rabbi shimon ben yochay:
En shorin et hammursan. bemayim karim vechol shekken poshrin kede latet lifne hattarnegolim:
Aval choltin. berotchin, shekkol zeman shehammayim rotchim eno yachol lehachemitz. vehaidna nahug alma issura afillu bachalita verotchim:
Lo tishre et hammursan. lashuf bo besarah, mippene shemmachmitz bishriyyato:
Aval shafa hi. mursan al besarah yavesh af al gav shemmayim tofchim al besarah:
Lo yilos. lo yachos beshinnav:

Vechulyato asara, challon sheal gabbav memallein mimmenna. kevan dechulyato shehi hassafa asher sevivoteha gevoha asara tefachim, vekayma lan deen reshut harabbim lemala measara tefachim, ella makom petor, lefichach memallein mechallon sheal gabbah beshabbat, dahavu motziin mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid derech makom petor. vaafillu habbor mufleget min hakkotel shel challon arbaa tefachim, memallein mimmenna, sheen kan reshut harabbim mafseket min habbor lachallon beshaa shemmemallein mayim, ella makom petor bilvad:

Vechen ashpa virshut harabbim gevoha asara tefachim. reshut hayyachid hi, velo chayshinan shemma tinnatel ashpa vetaamod al pachot measara veate lemishre kidmeikkara. vedavka beashpa shel rabbim sheenah asuya lehippanot, aval ashpa shel yachid haasuya lehippanot en zorkin lah beshabbat, dechayshinan dilma mefanne lah vehaveya la reshut harabbim:
Shevuot shetayim. sheochal veshello ochal. hem hashshetayim hameforashot, dichtiv (Vayikra 5) lehara o lehetiv, demashma lehabba. lo ochal, lehara. ochal, lehetiv:
Sheachalti veshello achalti. hem hashshetayim hannosafot mimmidrash chachamim:
Medabber umevi karban. bishvil bittul dibburo. vechevan demishshum bittul dibburo hu, af ze bittul dibburo hu. shehaomer lo ochal, dato leesor atzmo bechol shehu:
Shevua shello ochal veachal veshata. af al gav dishtiyya bichlal achila eno chayyav ella achat, dahave leh keochel vechozer veochel behelem echad:

Shello ochal veshello eshte. havu lehu shete shevuot. veaf al gav demikki amar lo ochal ittesar leh vishtiyya, dishtiyya bichlal achila, vechi hadar veamar tu lo eshte hava lan lememar deen shevua chala al shevua, shane hacha, kevan deamar baresha lo ochal vahadar amar lo eshte galle dateh dehach achila deamar baresha achila geredta hi:
Nifteru mide cheretatan. im asu teshuva:

Haose mitzva achat al achat kamma vechamma. it dimfarshe deal chayyave cheretot shellaku kaamar, mi shekkibbel alav haddin veasa mitzva keshellaka, al achat kamma vechamma shettinnaten lo nafsho veyippater mide charet, shemmidda tova merubba al middat puranut. veit dimfarshe demilleta veanpe nafsha kaamar, lehodia mattan secharan shel mitzvot, kal vachomer meanshan shel averot:

Mimmekomo hu lamed. mechayyave cheretot deayre vehu anu lemedin shehayyoshev velo avar avera maalin alav sachar keose mitzva. dichtiv baarayot (Vayikra 18) venichretu hannefashot, veomer (sham) asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem, usemich leh lo tikrevu legallot erva, hare shemmi sheyyoshev veeno megalle erva hakkatuv koro ose mitzva, uchetiv beh vachay bahem, kederech sheheenish karet bemi sheose avera. veze davka bemi shebba avera leyado vechavash yitzro velo asaah, keyosef hatztzaddik vechayyotze vo:
Veezo hi mitzvat ase shebbannidda. sheddoma lezo shebbammikdash, sheera lo hattuma mishshebba vehetter lide chenisa, im shaggu vet din behoraa zo chayyavim aleha par helem davar:

Haya meshammesh im hattehora. shennichnas behetter veamra lo nitmeti achshav, ufarash miyyad bikshi haevar, chayyav. ella yaamod belo disha ad sheyyamut haevar veyifrosh belo koshi. vezehu haase shebbannidda:

En choshshin. keshebbadak habbayit bezavit zo uva livdok zavit zo, en choshshin shemma betoch shebbati lezo gerra chulda lammakom habbaduk vetzarich ani lachzor velivdok, sheim bata lachush lechach hare gam mechatzer lechatzer yesh lomar ken, ani vadakti kodem lachaveri uleachar bedikati hevia chulda chametz mechatzar chaveri lachatzeri, veen laddavar sof:
Rabbi eliezer omer egla bat shenatah. egla arufa tzarich shettehe vat shenatah velo yoter:
Ufara. adumma:
Bat shete shanim. dilshon para mashma dekashshisha tefe meegla:

Vachachamim omrim egla arufa keshera afillu vat shetayim. vechol shekken bat shenatah, ella daafillu vat shetayim egla hi. veaf al gav dekayma lan kol makom shenneemar egel, ben shana hu, savre rabbanan shane egla arufa dichtiv bah (Devarim 21) eglat bakar, velo chetiv egla setam:

Shemma tashchir shello tippasel. sheim yivvaldu vah shete searot shechorot pesula, dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) adumma temima, shettehe temima veadmimut. vahalacha, defara adumma bat shalosh shanim o vat arba uzekena keshera, ella sheen mamtinin lah, shemma tashchir vetippasel:
Lo shamati ella shelashit. kach shamati sheen keshera lefara adumma ella shelashit:
Kach shamati setam. veen li lefaresh:
Shelishit. mashma shelishit laacherot beminyan, shennoldu shete farot acherot lefaneha vezot shelishit lahen:
Shelashit. mashma shehi vat shalosh shanim:
Revii laacherim. kesheyyesh arbaa cheramim shayyach lomar al haacharon shehu revii laacherim, aval revai mashma kerem ben arba shanim:
Haochel bevayit hamenugga peras. hashshohe bevayit hamenugga kede achilat peras, metamme vegadim shealav. peras hu chatzi chikkar mishshalosh kikkarot lakkav:
Amru lo emor mishshemone esre lisa. kelomar, haya lecha lomar mishshemone esre lassea, shehassea shishsha kabbin, veshalosh kikkarot lakkav hen shemone esre lassea:
Kach shamati. merabbotay, veen beyadi lefaresh lamma lo amru hem mishshemone esre lassea:
Ani afaresh. may nafka minna ben ze laze:

Mishshalosh lekav en bo challa. dechamesh reviiyyot kemach veod, chayyavin bechalla, vehallash kav bilvad en mafrish mimmenna challa. hilkach kesheatta omer mishshalosh kikkarot lakkav, mashma shello hufrash mehen challa, uchesheatta omer mishshemone esre lassea, nimtza shekkol kikkar hu fachot ma shemiatattu challato, shehallash sea tzarich lehaferish mimmenna challa:

Nitma vaazara. veyada shennitma, vehishtachava vehelem ze kelappe fenim, af al pi shello shaha. o hishtachava chelappe chutz, vehu deshaha chede hishtachavaa. veshiur hishtachavaya hi kede sheyyikra adam pasuk ze beyishshuv, vayyichreu appayim artza al haritzpa vayyishtachavu lehodot [vehodot] laAdonai‏ ki tov ki leolam chasdo. vehu fasuk bedivre hayyamim (2 7):
O shebba lo vaarukka. sheyyatza lo derech arukka sheyyesh ketzara mimmennu latzet, vaafillu lo shaha techilla, chayyav:
Uvakketzara patur. hecha delo hishtachava velo shaha, veyatza lo derech ketzara, patur:
Zo hi mitzvat ase shebbammikdash. deyesh kan vishallechu min hammachane kol tame:
Sheen chayyavin aleha. bet din, par helem davar. sheim shaggu vetau behoraa zo, vehoru lo sheyyetze vaarukka, en meviin al shiggat horaa zo par helem davar shel tzibbur:
Bachazeret. baaravi 69 49 belaaz:
Uvaulshin. baaravi 71. uvelaaz 78. vehearuch peresh shehu yarak shekkorin lo belaaz 720:
Uvetamcha. siv haggadel sevivot haddekel:
Uvecharchavina. 552 baaravi:
Uvemaror. min kusbarta hu mar beyoter:
Ben lachin ben yeveshin. davka bakkelach shellahen, kidamrinan bassefa veyotzim bakkelach shellahen. aval alin, lachin en, yeveshin lo:
Shelukin. mevushshalin yoter midday ad shennimmochim:
Kevushin. bechometz:
Mevushshalin. kederech bishshul:
Umitztarfin lechazzayit. latzet yede chovat maror. vehu haddin bachameshet mine dagan shemmitztarfin bechazzayit latzet yede chovat matztza. veattarvayhu kae:

Veyashtin birshut harabbim. demappik mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim. veim hishtin chayyav chattat. veaf al gav devainan akira meal gabbe makom sheyyesh bo arbaa al arbaa, hashsheten vechen harok havu kemunnachim bemakom sheyyesh bo arbaa al arbaa:
Mishshennitlash rukko. vehu shennitaggel venithappech befiv. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Shevua shello eshte yayin vashemen udevash. baggemara moke la kegon shehaya chavero mesarev bo veomer lo bo ushete immi yayin veshemen udevash. haya lo lomar shevua shello eshte immach vetu lo, dechi ishtava, ammay dimsarev bo ishtava, yayin vashemen udevash lamma li, shema minna lechallek:
Seire hargalim. bechol hargalim neemru seire chattat bemusafin:

Useire rashe chodashim mechapperim. dichtiv bisir rosh chodesh (sham 25) lechattat laAdonai, chet sheen makkir bo ella Adonai‏ sair ze yehe mechapper, vehayenu sheen bo yedia lo vattechilla velo vassof. useire regalim yalfinan misseir rosh chodesh behekkesh, disir hava matze lemichtav bechullehu regalim, vechatav useir, vav mosif al inyan rishon, lehakkish sheal ma shezze mechapper ellu mechapperim:

Kol hasseirim kapparatan shava. kol seire hammusafin, ben seire regalim ben seir rosh chodesh ben sair hannaase vachutz beyom hakkippurim, kapparatan shava, shehem mechapperin ben al sheen bah yedia vattechilla veyesh bah yedia vassof ben al sheen bah yedia lo vattechilla velo vassof, ben al tahor sheachal et hattame, venafka minna letuma sheera ben zo lezo. aval sair hannaase bifnim beyom hakkippurim lo nechleku alav shehu tole al sheyyesh bah yedia vattechilla veen bah yedia vassof, kidamrinan:
Haya rabbi shimon omer. hay dahadar nakat la, mishshum devae lememar amru lo mahu sheyyikrevu ze vaze:
Mahu sheyyikrevu. im avad sair shehufrash leyom hakkippurim, venitkapperu veacher, venimtza ze varegel o berosh chodesh, mahu sheyyakriv leshem seiro shel yom:

Amru lo hoil veen kapparatan shava. rabbi meir hu dekaamar leh lerabbi shimon, bishlama i amart kullan kapparatam shava, yikrav, shehare chullan kappara achat hen mechapperim, ella ledidach, zo shehufresha lechapper al sheen bah yedia vattechilla veyesh bah yedia vassof, heach yikrav baregel lechapper al sheen bah yedia lo vattechilla velo vassof, o verosh chodesh lechapper al hattahor sheachal et hattame:
Lechapper al tumat mikdash vekadashav. vechevan devaze shavin, af al pi shekkapparatan chalukot yachol hu likkarev:
Yadah tefach. bet yad shehartzua teluya vah, arko tefach:
Verachbah. shel retzua shel egel tefach:

Veroshah maggaat al pi chereso. lechach tzarich sheyyehe bevet yad shel retzua nekev, shehachazzan hammalke yachol lehaarich ulekatztzer hartzua chirtzono. sheen malkin laadam ella virtzua sheroshah maggaat al pi chereso shehu tibburo:

Shelish millefanav. dichtiv (Devarim 25) vehikkahu lefanav kede rishato, lefanav kede rishato achat, uleacharav kede shetayim. millefanav, al libbo. meacharav. shelish al katef zo ushelish al katef zo:
Makke veyado achat. aval keshemmagbiah hartzua magbiah bishte yadav:
Bechol kocho. dichtiv (sham) makka rabba:
Veal zedon tumat mikdash vechulei. setama detalmuda naket la:
Sair hannaase vifnim veyom hakkippurim mechapper. dichtiv (Vayikra 16) umippishehem lechol chattotam, ufeshaim ellu meradim:

Hachamurot vehakkallot vechulei. kulla matnitin mipparsha vaggemara hachi, ben kallot ben chamurot ben sheasaan bemezid ben sheasaan beshogeg, otan sheasaan beshogeg ben noda lo sefekan ben lo noda lo sefekan, kelomar ben noda lo shebba leyado sefek chelev vaachalo ben shello noda lo shebba leyado sefek chelev. veellu hen kallot, ase velo taase. veellu hen chamurot, keretot umitot bet din:
Haya omed bifnim. toch bayit hamenugga:

Pashat yadav lachutz vetabbeotav beyadav. hacha mayre keshettabbeotav beetzbeotav derech malbush, veim shaha kede achilat peras, temeot, devatar gufo geriri. veim hayu befas yado derech masseoy, mochiach battosefta shehem temeot miyyad:
Bizman sheen kol gufo tame. kegon hacha dehu omed bachutz velo nitma kol zeman shello hichnis rosho verubbo:

Eno din shello yetamme et ma shealav ad sheyyishhe chede achilat peras. verabbi yehuda omer, matzinu sheyyafe choach hattame lehatztzil, mikkoach hattahor lehatztzil, shehare yisrael shemmekabbelim tuma matztzilin kelim babbayit hamenugga, sheen mittammein ad sheyyishhe kede achilat peras, venachri uvehema sheen mekabbelim tuma en matztzilin kelim babbayit hamenugga, shehabbegadim shealehem temeim miyyad. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
En bah yedia vattechilla. shello yada betuma zo miyyamav, ze lo va lichlal karban od leolam. shehare en karban ba ella al sheyyesh bo yedia vattechilla:
Sair hannaase vachutz. hakkarev bammizbeach hachitzon bemusafin shel yom hakkippurim:
Veyom hakkippurim. atzmo mechapper im hassair:

Shenneemar. besair hannaase vachutz (Bamidbar 29) seir izzim echad chattat millevad chattat hakkippurim, vechattat hakkippurim hu hassair hannaase bifnim, vehikkishan hakkatuv, lelammedcha sheal ma shezze mechapper ze mechapper. ma penimi eno va ella al davar sheyyesh bo yedia, umay nihu, yedia vattechilla, kidyalfinan mikkera dichtiv lechol chattotam, demashma leotam sheyyavou lichlal chattat keshettihye lahem yedia vassof, vei efshar lavo lichlal chattat ella im ken hayta lo yedia vattechilla, af sair hannaase vachutz eno mechapper ella al sheyyesh bo yedia, umay nihu, yedia vassof velo vattechilla delo atya lichlal karban, umechapper ze kappara gemura belo teliyya:
Telem echad. shura achat shel sade:
Vechayyav alav mishshum shemona lavin. vehu shehitru vo al kullam:

Vehen mukdashim. shor kadshe mizbeach, vachamor kadshe vedek habbayit. uveshor it beh lav delo taavod bivchor shorecha, uvachamor azhara dimila, venafka lan chet chet mitteruma, velav delo tacharosh beshor uvachamor yachdav, hare chan shelosha lavin:

Vechilayim bakkerem. al yede shechoresh mechappe chitta useora vechartzan beafar, veover mishshum lo tizra karmecha kilayim. dekayma lan hamechappe vechilayim loke, af al pi shello zeraan, ella chippa afar alehen, hare ze arbaa lavin. veharambam chashav kilayim bakkerem, shene lavin, echad mishshum kile zeraim, shehen shene mine zeraim, chitta useora, vechad mishshum kile hakkerem bishvil hachartzan, velo chashev mukdashim shel shor vachamor ella lelav echad:
Sheviit. shabbat laAdonai‏ sadcha lo tizra:
Veyom tov. kol melechet avoda lo taasu:
Kohen venazir. vehu bevet hakkevarot. vekaavar lenefesh lo yittamma beammav haamur bakkohanim, veal nefesh met lo yavo haamur bannazir:
Af hallovesh kilayim. beshaa shehaya choresh:
Eno min hashshem. lav shel levishat kilayim eno vishvil hattelem:

Af kohen venazir. dechashvitu lav, eno vishvil charisha ella vishvil halicha limkom tuma. umihu tanna kamma chashev lehu bichlal lave hattelem, lefi sheeno yachol lacharosh bishvarim ella im ken holech immahem umanhigam:
Veachal nevelot chayyav. diruyin laachila hen i lav derachamana asrinhu:

Rabbi shimon poter. demushba veomed hu alehem. ufelugta derabbi shimon vetanna kamma becholel devarim hammuttarim im devarim haasurim, kegon beomer shevua shello ochal shechutot uterefot. tanna kamma savar miggo dechayla shevua ashshechutot chayla nammi atterefot, deissur chal al issur beissur kolel. verabbi shimon savar en issur chal al issur beissur kolel. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Ishto asura. shehare achal ochalim. vaafillu lerabbi shimon. detaama defatur bekammayta lav mishshum delav bene achila ninhu, ella sheen shevua chala al devar issur:
